=== FILE: src-tauri/src/audio_loopback.rs ===
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
use tauri::{AppHandle, Emitter};

static IS_RECORDING: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);

#[tauri::command]
pub fn start_audio_capture(app: AppHandle, _source: Option<String>) -> Result<bool, String> {
    if IS_RECORDING.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {
        return Ok(true);
    }
    IS_RECORDING.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);

    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        while IS_RECORDING.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {
            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100));
            // Emit mock/live amplitude or stream status
            let _ = app.emit("pill://audio-capture-status", true);
        }
    });

    Ok(true)
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn stop_audio_capture() -> Result<bool, String> {
    IS_RECORDING.store(false, Ordering::SeqCst);
    Ok(false)
}

=== FILE: src-tauri/src/bluetooth_wifi.rs ===
use serde::Serialize;
use windows::Devices::Bluetooth::{BluetoothAdapter, BluetoothConnectionStatus, BluetoothDevice};
use windows::Devices::Enumeration::DeviceInformation;
use windows::Devices::Radios::RadioState;
use windows::Devices::WiFi::WiFiAdapter;
use windows::Networking::Connectivity::NetworkAuthenticationType;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
pub struct WifiNetworkDto {
    pub ssid: String,
    pub signal_bars: u8,
    pub freq_ghz: f64,
    pub is_secured: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
pub struct BluetoothDeviceDto {
    pub name: String,
    pub id: String,
    pub is_connected: bool,
}

#[tauri::command]
pub async fn scan_wifi_networks() -> Result<Vec<WifiNetworkDto>, String> {
    let adapters = WiFiAdapter::FindAllAdaptersAsync()
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
        .get()
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

    if adapters.Size().unwrap_or(0) == 0 {
        return Ok(vec![]);
    }

    let wifi = adapters.GetAt(0).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let _ = wifi.ScanAsync().and_then(|o| o.get());

    let report = wifi.NetworkReport().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let networks = report.AvailableNetworks().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

    let mut list = Vec::new();
    for net in networks {
        let ssid = net.Ssid().map(|s| s.to_string()).unwrap_or_default();
        if ssid.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let signal_bars = net.SignalBars().unwrap_or(0);
        let freq_ghz = (net.ChannelCenterFrequencyInKilohertz().unwrap_or(2412000) as f64) / 1_000_000.0;
        let is_secured = net
            .SecuritySettings()
            .and_then(|s| s.NetworkAuthenticationType())
            .unwrap_or(NetworkAuthenticationType::Open80211)
            != NetworkAuthenticationType::Open80211;

        list.push(WifiNetworkDto {
            ssid,
            signal_bars,
            freq_ghz,
            is_secured,
        });
    }
    Ok(list)
}

#[tauri::command]
pub async fn get_paired_bluetooth_devices() -> Result<Vec<BluetoothDeviceDto>, String> {
    let selector = BluetoothDevice::GetDeviceSelectorFromPairingState(true)
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let devices = DeviceInformation::FindAllAsyncAqsFilter(&selector)
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
        .get()
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

    let mut results = Vec::new();
    for dev in devices {
        if let Ok(id) = dev.Id() {
            if let Ok(op) = BluetoothDevice::FromIdAsync(&id) {
                if let Ok(bt) = op.get() {
                    let name = bt.Name().map(|s| s.to_string()).unwrap_or_default();
                    let is_connected = bt.ConnectionStatus().unwrap_or(BluetoothConnectionStatus::Disconnected)
                        == BluetoothConnectionStatus::Connected;
                    results.push(BluetoothDeviceDto {
                        name,
                        id: id.to_string(),
                        is_connected,
                    });
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(results)
}

#[tauri::command]
pub async fn toggle_bluetooth_radio(enable: bool) -> Result<bool, String> {
    let adapter = BluetoothAdapter::GetDefaultAsync()
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
        .get()
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let radio = adapter
        .GetRadioAsync()
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
        .get()
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let state = if enable { RadioState::On } else { RadioState::Off };
    let _ = radio.SetStateAsync(state).and_then(|o| o.get());
    Ok(enable)
}

=== FILE: src-tauri/src/clipboard_watcher.rs ===
use base64::{engine::general_purpose::STANDARD as BASE64, Engine as _};
use regex::Regex;
use serde::Serialize;
use std::time::{Duration, SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};
use tauri::{AppHandle, Emitter};
use windows::ApplicationModel::DataTransfer::{Clipboard, StandardDataFormats};
use windows::Storage::Streams::DataReader;
use windows::Win32::System::Com::{CoInitializeEx, COINIT_MULTITHREADED};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
pub struct ClipboardRecordDto {
    pub id: String,
    pub text: String,
    pub category: String,   // "text" | "link" | "color" | "code" | "image" | "file"
    pub badge_code: String, // "TXT" | "URL" | "HEX" | "CODE" | "PNG" | "FILE"
    pub source: String,
    pub preview_image_data_url: Option<String>,
    pub file_size_label: Option<String>,
    pub timestamp_ms: u64,
    pub pinned: bool,
}

pub fn start_clipboard_watcher(app: AppHandle) {
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        // Initialize COM on this worker thread for WinRT Clipboard APIs
        let _ = unsafe { CoInitializeEx(None, COINIT_MULTITHREADED) };

        let hex_re = Regex::new(r"^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}){1,2}$").ok();
        let mut last_text = String::new();
        let mut last_img_size: u64 = 0;

        loop {
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(650));
            let Ok(content) = Clipboard::GetContent() else {
                continue;
            };

            let now_ms = SystemTime::now()
                .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
                .unwrap_or_default()
                .as_millis() as u64;
            let id = format!("{:x}", now_ms);

            // 1. Check Text / Code / URL / HEX
            let has_text = StandardDataFormats::Text()
                .ok()
                .map(|fmt| content.Contains(&fmt).unwrap_or(false))
                .unwrap_or(false);

            if has_text {
                if let Ok(op) = content.GetTextAsync() {
                    if let Ok(hstr) = op.get() {
                        let text = hstr.to_string().trim().to_string();
                        if !text.is_empty() && text != last_text {
                            last_text = text.clone();
                            let is_hex = hex_re
                                .as_ref()
                                .map(|re| re.is_match(&text))
                                .unwrap_or(false);

                            let (category, badge_code) =
                                if text.starts_with("http://") || text.starts_with("https://") {
                                    ("link", "URL")
                                } else if is_hex {
                                    ("color", "HEX")
                                } else if text.contains('{')
                                    || text.contains("=>")
                                    || text.contains("function")
                                    || text.contains("const ")
                                    || text.contains("fn ")
                                {
                                    ("code", "CODE")
                                } else {
                                    ("text", "TXT")
                                };

                            let record = ClipboardRecordDto {
                                id,
                                text: text.clone(),
                                category: category.to_string(),
                                badge_code: badge_code.to_string(),
                                source: "System Clipboard".to_string(),
                                preview_image_data_url: None,
                                file_size_label: Some(format!("{} B", text.len())),
                                timestamp_ms: now_ms,
                                pinned: false,
                            };
                            let _ = app.emit("pill://clipboard-item-added", record);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            // 2. Check Uncropped Full Bitmap Previews
            else {
                let has_bitmap = StandardDataFormats::Bitmap()
                    .ok()
                    .map(|fmt| content.Contains(&fmt).unwrap_or(false))
                    .unwrap_or(false);

                if has_bitmap {
                    if let Ok(op) = content.GetBitmapAsync() {
                        if let Ok(stream_ref) = op.get() {
                            if let Ok(stream_op) = stream_ref.OpenReadAsync() {
                                if let Ok(stream) = stream_op.get() {
                                    let size = stream.Size().unwrap_or(0);
                                    if size > 0 && size != last_img_size {
                                        last_img_size = size;
                                        if let Ok(reader) = DataReader::CreateDataReader(&stream) {
                                            if reader
                                                .LoadAsync(size as u32)
                                                .and_then(|o| o.get())
                                                .is_ok()
                                            {
                                                let mut bytes = vec![0u8; size as usize];
                                                if reader.ReadBytes(&mut bytes).is_ok() {
                                                    let record = ClipboardRecordDto {
                                                        id,
                                                        text: "Captured Image Snip".to_string(),
                                                        category: "image".to_string(),
                                                        badge_code: "PNG".to_string(),
                                                        source: "Screen Snip".to_string(),
                                                        preview_image_data_url: Some(format!(
                                                            "data:image/bmp;base64,{}",
                                                            BASE64.encode(&bytes)
                                                        )),
                                                        file_size_label: Some(format!(
                                                            "{} KB",
                                                            bytes.len() / 1024
                                                        )),
                                                        timestamp_ms: now_ms,
                                                        pinned: false,
                                                    };
                                                    let _ =
                                                        app.emit("pill://clipboard-item-added", record);
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    });
}

=== FILE: src-tauri/src/dpapi_vault.rs ===
use std::fs;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use windows::Win32::Foundation::LocalFree;
use windows::Win32::Foundation::HLOCAL;
use windows::Win32::Security::Cryptography::{
    CryptProtectData, CryptUnprotectData, CRYPTPROTECT_UI_FORBIDDEN, CRYPT_INTEGER_BLOB,
};

const VAULT_ENTROPY: &[u8] = b"Pill.WinUI.AstraVault.v2";

fn get_vault_file_path() -> PathBuf {
    let local_app_data = std::env::var("LOCALAPPDATA").unwrap_or_else(|_| ".".to_string());
    let dir = PathBuf::from(local_app_data).join("PillForWindows");
    let _ = fs::create_dir_all(&dir);
    dir.join("astra_gemini_key.dpapi")
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn save_custom_api_key(plain_api_key: String) -> Result<bool, String> {
    let trimmed = plain_api_key.trim();
    if trimmed.is_empty() {
        return clear_custom_api_key();
    }

    let mut plain_bytes = trimmed.as_bytes().to_vec();
    let mut entropy_bytes = VAULT_ENTROPY.to_vec();

    let in_blob = CRYPT_INTEGER_BLOB {
        cbData: plain_bytes.len() as u32,
        pbData: plain_bytes.as_mut_ptr(),
    };
    let entropy_blob = CRYPT_INTEGER_BLOB {
        cbData: entropy_bytes.len() as u32,
        pbData: entropy_bytes.as_mut_ptr(),
    };
    let mut out_blob = CRYPT_INTEGER_BLOB::default();

    unsafe {
        CryptProtectData(
            &in_blob,
            None,
            Some(&entropy_blob),
            None,
            None,
            CRYPTPROTECT_UI_FORBIDDEN,
            &mut out_blob,
        )
        .map_err(|e| format!("DPAPI Encrypt Failed: {e}"))?;

        let cipher_slice =
            std::slice::from_raw_parts(out_blob.pbData, out_blob.cbData as usize).to_vec();
        let _ = LocalFree(HLOCAL(out_blob.pbData as _));
        plain_bytes.fill(0);

        fs::write(get_vault_file_path(), cipher_slice).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    }
    Ok(true)
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn load_custom_api_key() -> Result<Option<String>, String> {
    let path = get_vault_file_path();
    if !path.exists() {
        return Ok(None);
    }

    let mut cipher_bytes = fs::read(path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let mut entropy_bytes = VAULT_ENTROPY.to_vec();

    let in_blob = CRYPT_INTEGER_BLOB {
        cbData: cipher_bytes.len() as u32,
        pbData: cipher_bytes.as_mut_ptr(),
    };
    let entropy_blob = CRYPT_INTEGER_BLOB {
        cbData: entropy_bytes.len() as u32,
        pbData: entropy_bytes.as_mut_ptr(),
    };
    let mut out_blob = CRYPT_INTEGER_BLOB::default();

    unsafe {
        if CryptUnprotectData(
            &in_blob,
            None,
            Some(&entropy_blob),
            None,
            None,
            CRYPTPROTECT_UI_FORBIDDEN,
            &mut out_blob,
        )
        .is_err()
        {
            return Ok(None);
        }

        let plain_slice =
            std::slice::from_raw_parts(out_blob.pbData, out_blob.cbData as usize).to_vec();
        let _ = LocalFree(HLOCAL(out_blob.pbData as _));
        let key = String::from_utf8(plain_slice).ok();
        Ok(key)
    }
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn has_custom_api_key() -> bool {
    get_vault_file_path().exists()
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn clear_custom_api_key() -> Result<bool, String> {
    let path = get_vault_file_path();
    if path.exists() {
        let _ = fs::remove_file(path);
    }
    Ok(false)
}

pub mod audio_loopback;
pub mod bluetooth_wifi;
pub mod clipboard_watcher;
pub mod dpapi_vault;
pub mod media_gsmtc;

use tauri::{Emitter, Manager};
use tauri_plugin_global_shortcut::{Code, GlobalShortcutExt, Modifiers, Shortcut, ShortcutState};

pub fn run() {
    tauri::Builder::default()
        .plugin(tauri_plugin_store::Builder::new().build())
        .plugin(tauri_plugin_shell::init())
        .plugin(
            tauri_plugin_global_shortcut::Builder::new()
                .with_handler(|app, shortcut, event| {
                    if event.state() == ShortcutState::Pressed {
                        if shortcut.matches(Modifiers::ALT, Code::KeyL) {
                            let _ = app.emit("pill://hotkey-toggle-pill", ());
                        } else if shortcut.matches(Modifiers::ALT, Code::KeyK) {
                            let _ = app.emit("pill://hotkey-reveal-compact", ());
                        } else if shortcut.matches(Modifiers::ALT, Code::KeyV) {
                            let _ = app.emit("pill://hotkey-summon-astra", ());
                        }
                    }
                })
                .build(),
        )
        .on_window_event(|window, event| {
            if let tauri::WindowEvent::CloseRequested { api, .. } = event {
                if window.label() == "settings-window" {
                    api.prevent_close();
                    if let Ok(hwnd_raw) = window.hwnd() {
                        let hwnd = windows::Win32::Foundation::HWND(hwnd_raw.0 as _);
                        unsafe {
                            let _ = windows::Win32::UI::WindowsAndMessaging::ShowWindow(
                                hwnd,
                                windows::Win32::UI::WindowsAndMessaging::SW_HIDE,
                            );
                        }
                    }
                    let _ = window.hide();
                }
            }
        })
        .setup(|app| {
            if let Some(main_win) = app.get_webview_window("main-pill") {
                let hit_state = window_manager::configure_pill_overlay_window(&main_win);
                app.manage(hit_state);

                // Privacy cloak off by default so window is visible in captures & screenshots
                let _ = privacy_cloak::apply_privacy_cloak(app.handle().clone(), false, false, false);
            }

            if let Some(settings_win) = app.get_webview_window("settings-window") {
                let _ = settings_win.hide();
            }

            // Register Alt+L (Toggle Pill), Alt+K (Reveal Compact Pill from Top), and Alt+V (Summon Astra Voice Orb)
            let alt_l = Shortcut::new(Some(Modifiers::ALT), Code::KeyL);
            let alt_k = Shortcut::new(Some(Modifiers::ALT), Code::KeyK);
            let alt_v = Shortcut::new(Some(Modifiers::ALT), Code::KeyV);
            let _ = app.global_shortcut().register(alt_l);
            let _ = app.global_shortcut().register(alt_k);
            let _ = app.global_shortcut().register(alt_v);

            // Restore theme icon and anchor position from disk on startup
            if let Some(saved) = window_manager::read_preferences_from_disk() {
                if let Ok(val) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&saved) {
                    if let Some(theme) = val.get("themeId").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) {
                        let _ = window_manager::update_window_theme_icon(app.handle().clone(), theme.to_string());
                    }
                    if let Some(anchor) = val.get("anchorPosition").and_then(|a| a.as_str()) {
                        let _ = window_manager::reposition_pill_window(app.handle().clone(), anchor.to_string());
                    }
                }
            }

            // Start live Windows Clipboard Watcher
            clipboard_watcher::start_clipboard_watcher(app.handle().clone());

            Ok(())
        })
        .invoke_handler(tauri::generate_handler![
            window_manager::update_pill_hit_rect,
            window_manager::set_pill_force_interactive,
            window_manager::set_pill_focusable,
            window_manager::reposition_pill_window,
            window_manager::open_settings_window,
            window_manager::close_settings_window,
            window_manager::minimize_settings_window,
            window_manager::toggle_maximize_settings_window,
            window_manager::toggle_fullscreen_settings_window,
            window_manager::broadcast_preferences_sync,
            window_manager::update_window_theme_icon,
            window_manager::update_pill_reveal_settings,
            window_manager::get_saved_preferences,
            window_manager::save_user_preferences,
            privacy_cloak::apply_privacy_cloak,
            dpapi_vault::save_custom_api_key,
            dpapi_vault::load_custom_api_key,
            dpapi_vault::has_custom_api_key,
            dpapi_vault::clear_custom_api_key,
            media_gsmtc::get_current_media_track,
            media_gsmtc::media_control_action,
            bluetooth_wifi::scan_wifi_networks,
            bluetooth_wifi::get_paired_bluetooth_devices,
            bluetooth_wifi::toggle_bluetooth_radio,
            system_controls::get_system_telemetry,
            system_controls::set_master_volume,
            system_controls::toggle_night_light,
            audio_loopback::start_audio_capture,
            audio_loopback::stop_audio_capture,
        ])
        .build(tauri::generate_context!())
        .expect("error while building Pill for Windows")
        .run(|_app_handle, event| {
            use std::io::Write;
            if let Ok(mut f) = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
                .create(true)
                .append(true)
                .open("d:\\Pill\\events.log")
            {
                let _ = writeln!(f, "EVENT: {:?}", event);
                let _ = f.flush();
            }
            if let tauri::RunEvent::ExitRequested { ref code, ref api, .. } = event {
                if let Ok(mut f) = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
                    .create(true)
                    .append(true)
                    .open("d:\\Pill\\events.log")
                {
                    let _ = writeln!(f, "EXIT REQUESTED: code={:?}", code);
                    let _ = f.flush();
                }
                api.prevent_exit();
            }
        });
}

=== FILE: src-tauri/src/media_gsmtc.rs ===
use base64::{engine::general_purpose::STANDARD as BASE64, Engine as _};
use serde::Serialize;
use windows::Media::Control::{
    GlobalSystemMediaTransportControlsSessionManager,
    GlobalSystemMediaTransportControlsSessionPlaybackStatus,
};
use windows::Storage::Streams::DataReader;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
pub struct MediaTrackPayload {
    pub title: String,
    pub artist: String,
    pub album: String,
    pub thumbnail_data_url: Option<String>,
    pub duration_sec: f64,
    pub position_sec: f64,
    pub is_playing: bool,
}

#[tauri::command]
pub async fn get_current_media_track() -> Result<Option<MediaTrackPayload>, String> {
    let manager = GlobalSystemMediaTransportControlsSessionManager::RequestAsync()
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
        .get()
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

    let Ok(session) = manager.GetCurrentSession() else {
        return Ok(None);
    };

    let props = session
        .TryGetMediaPropertiesAsync()
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
        .get()
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

    let playback_info = session.GetPlaybackInfo().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let timeline = session.GetTimelineProperties().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

    let is_playing = playback_info.PlaybackStatus().unwrap_or(
        GlobalSystemMediaTransportControlsSessionPlaybackStatus::Paused,
    ) == GlobalSystemMediaTransportControlsSessionPlaybackStatus::Playing;

    let duration_sec = (timeline.EndTime().unwrap_or_default().Duration as f64) / 10_000_000.0;
    let position_sec = (timeline.Position().unwrap_or_default().Duration as f64) / 10_000_000.0;

    let mut thumbnail_data_url = None;
    if let Ok(thumb_ref) = props.Thumbnail() {
        if let Ok(op) = thumb_ref.OpenReadAsync() {
            if let Ok(stream) = op.get() {
                let size = stream.Size().unwrap_or(0) as u32;
                if size > 0 {
                    if let Ok(reader) = DataReader::CreateDataReader(&stream) {
                        if reader.LoadAsync(size).and_then(|o| o.get()).is_ok() {
                            let mut buf = vec![0u8; size as usize];
                            if reader.ReadBytes(&mut buf).is_ok() {
                                thumbnail_data_url =
                                    Some(format!("data:image/png;base64,{}", BASE64.encode(buf)));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    Ok(Some(MediaTrackPayload {
        title: props.Title().map(|s| s.to_string()).unwrap_or_default(),
        artist: props.Artist().map(|s| s.to_string()).unwrap_or_default(),
        album: props.AlbumTitle().map(|s| s.to_string()).unwrap_or_default(),
        thumbnail_data_url,
        duration_sec,
        position_sec,
        is_playing,
    }))
}

#[tauri::command]
pub async fn media_control_action(action: String, seek_sec: Option<f64>) -> Result<(), String> {
    let manager = GlobalSystemMediaTransportControlsSessionManager::RequestAsync()
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
        .get()
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

    if let Ok(session) = manager.GetCurrentSession() {
        match action.as_str() {
            "play_pause" => {
                let _ = session.TryTogglePlayPauseAsync().and_then(|o| o.get());
            }
            "next" => {
                let _ = session.TrySkipNextAsync().and_then(|o| o.get());
            }
            "previous" => {
                let _ = session.TrySkipPreviousAsync().and_then(|o| o.get());
            }
            "seek" => {
                if let Some(sec) = seek_sec {
                    let ticks = (sec * 10_000_000.0) as i64;
                    let _ = session
                        .TryChangePlaybackPositionAsync(ticks)
                        .and_then(|o| o.get());
                }
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

=== FILE: src-tauri/src/privacy_cloak.rs ===
use tauri::{AppHandle, Manager};
use windows::Win32::Foundation::HWND;
use windows::Win32::UI::WindowsAndMessaging::{
    GetWindowDisplayAffinity, SetWindowDisplayAffinity, WINDOW_DISPLAY_AFFINITY,
};

pub const WDA_NONE: u32 = 0x00000000;
pub const WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE: u32 = 0x00000011;

#[tauri::command]
pub fn apply_privacy_cloak(
    app: AppHandle,
    privacy_mask_enabled: bool,
    public_passthrough_hud: bool,
    is_collapsed_public_hud_only: bool,
) -> Result<bool, String> {
    let Some(win) = app.get_webview_window("main-pill") else {
        return Ok(false);
    };
    let hwnd = HWND(win.hwnd().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?.0 as _);

    let should_cloak =
        privacy_mask_enabled && !(public_passthrough_hud && is_collapsed_public_hud_only);
    let target_affinity = WINDOW_DISPLAY_AFFINITY(if should_cloak {
        WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE
    } else {
        WDA_NONE
    });

    if let Ok(mut f) = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
        .create(true)
        .append(true)
        .open("d:\\Pill\\events.log")
    {
        use std::io::Write;
        let _ = writeln!(
            f,
            "APPLY PRIVACY CLOAK: mask_enabled={}, passthrough={}, collapsed_only={}, target_affinity=0x{:X}",
            privacy_mask_enabled, public_passthrough_hud, is_collapsed_public_hud_only, target_affinity.0
        );
        let _ = f.flush();
    }

    unsafe {
        let mut current: u32 = 0;
        if GetWindowDisplayAffinity(hwnd, &mut current).is_ok() && current == target_affinity.0 {
            return Ok(should_cloak);
        }
        let _ = SetWindowDisplayAffinity(hwnd, target_affinity);
    }

    // Also apply to Settings window if open
    if let Some(settings_win) = app.get_webview_window("settings-window") {
        if let Ok(s_hwnd) = settings_win.hwnd() {
            unsafe {
                let _ = SetWindowDisplayAffinity(
                    HWND(s_hwnd.0 as _),
                    WINDOW_DISPLAY_AFFINITY(if privacy_mask_enabled {
                        WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE
                    } else {
                        WDA_NONE
                    }),
                );
            }
        }
    }

    Ok(should_cloak)
}

=== FILE: src-tauri/src/system_controls.rs ===
use serde::Serialize;
use sysinfo::System;
use windows::System::Power::{BatteryStatus, PowerManager};
use windows::Win32::Media::Audio::Endpoints::IAudioEndpointVolume;
use windows::Win32::Media::Audio::{
    eMultimedia, eRender, IMMDeviceEnumerator, MMDeviceEnumerator,
};
use windows::Win32::System::Com::{CoCreateInstance, CoInitializeEx, CLSCTX_ALL, COINIT_MULTITHREADED};
use winreg::enums::*;
use winreg::RegKey;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
pub struct SystemTelemetryPayload {
    pub battery_pct: i32,
    pub is_charging: bool,
    pub battery_state: String, // "Charging" | "Discharging" | "IdleFull" | "Low"
    pub pd_watts: i32,
    pub cpu_usage_pct: f32,
    pub ram_used_gb: f32,
    pub ram_total_gb: f32,
    pub master_volume: f32,
    pub night_light_enabled: bool,
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn get_system_telemetry() -> Result<SystemTelemetryPayload, String> {
    let pct = PowerManager::RemainingChargePercent().unwrap_or(85);
    let status = PowerManager::BatteryStatus().unwrap_or(BatteryStatus::Discharging);
    let is_charging = status == BatteryStatus::Charging;

    let battery_state = if is_charging {
        "Charging"
    } else if pct >= 99 && status == BatteryStatus::Idle {
        "IdleFull"
    } else if pct <= 20 {
        "Low"
    } else {
        "Discharging"
    }
    .to_string();

    let pd_watts = if is_charging { 65 } else { 14 };

    let mut sys = System::new_all();
    sys.refresh_cpu();
    sys.refresh_memory();
    let cpu_usage_pct = sys.global_cpu_info().cpu_usage();
    let ram_used_gb = (sys.used_memory() as f32) / (1024.0 * 1024.0 * 1024.0);
    let ram_total_gb = (sys.total_memory() as f32) / (1024.0 * 1024.0 * 1024.0);

    let master_volume = get_master_volume_internal().unwrap_or(0.65);
    let night_light_enabled = get_night_light_state_internal();

    Ok(SystemTelemetryPayload {
        battery_pct: pct,
        is_charging,
        battery_state,
        pd_watts,
        cpu_usage_pct,
        ram_used_gb,
        ram_total_gb,
        master_volume,
        night_light_enabled,
    })
}

fn get_master_volume_internal() -> Option<f32> {
    unsafe {
        let _ = CoInitializeEx(None, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);
        let enumerator: IMMDeviceEnumerator =
            CoCreateInstance(&MMDeviceEnumerator, None, CLSCTX_ALL).ok()?;
        let device = enumerator.GetDefaultAudioEndpoint(eRender, eMultimedia).ok()?;
        let endpoint: IAudioEndpointVolume = device.Activate(CLSCTX_ALL, None).ok()?;
        endpoint.GetMasterVolumeLevelScalar().ok()
    }
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn set_master_volume(level_0_to_1: f32) -> Result<f32, String> {
    let clamped = level_0_to_1.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    unsafe {
        let _ = CoInitializeEx(None, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);
        if let Ok(enumerator) =
            CoCreateInstance::<_, IMMDeviceEnumerator>(&MMDeviceEnumerator, None, CLSCTX_ALL)
        {
            if let Ok(device) = enumerator.GetDefaultAudioEndpoint(eRender, eMultimedia) {
                if let Ok(endpoint) = device.Activate::<IAudioEndpointVolume>(CLSCTX_ALL, None) {
                    let _ = endpoint.SetMasterVolumeLevelScalar(clamped, std::ptr::null());
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(clamped)
}

const NIGHT_LIGHT_REG_PATH: &str = r"Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\CloudStore\Store\DefaultAccount\Current\default$windows.data.bluelightreduction.bluelightreductionstate\windows.data.bluelightreduction.bluelightreductionstate";

fn get_night_light_state_internal() -> bool {
    let hkcu = RegKey::predef(HKEY_CURRENT_USER);
    if let Ok(key) = hkcu.open_subkey_with_flags(NIGHT_LIGHT_REG_PATH, KEY_READ) {
        if let Ok(raw) = key.get_raw_value("Data") {
            if raw.bytes.len() > 18 {
                return raw.bytes[18] == 0x15;
            }
        }
    }
    false
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn toggle_night_light() -> Result<bool, String> {
    let hkcu = RegKey::predef(HKEY_CURRENT_USER);
    let Ok(key) = hkcu.open_subkey_with_flags(NIGHT_LIGHT_REG_PATH, KEY_READ | KEY_WRITE) else {
        return Ok(false);
    };
    let Ok(mut raw) = key.get_raw_value("Data") else {
        return Ok(false);
    };
    if raw.bytes.len() <= 18 {
        return Ok(false);
    }

    let currently_active = raw.bytes[18] == 0x15;
    if currently_active {
        raw.bytes[18] = 0x13;
        if raw.bytes.len() >= 25 {
            raw.bytes.drain(23..25);
        }
    } else {
        raw.bytes[18] = 0x15;
        if raw.bytes.len() >= 23 {
            raw.bytes.splice(23..23, [0x10, 0x00]);
        }
    }

    // Increment 4-byte timestamp counter at indices 10..14 so Windows CloudStore driver applies immediately
    for i in 10..14 {
        if raw.bytes[i] < 0xFF {
            raw.bytes[i] += 1;
            break;
        }
    }

    let _ = key.set_raw_value("Data", &raw);
    Ok(!currently_active)
}

=== FILE: src-tauri/src/window_manager.rs ===
use serde::Deserialize;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::time::Duration;
use tauri::{AppHandle, Emitter, Manager, WebviewWindow};
use windows::Win32::Foundation::{HWND, POINT};
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Dwm::{
    DwmSetWindowAttribute, DWMWA_BORDER_COLOR, DWMWA_WINDOW_CORNER_PREFERENCE,
    DWMWCP_DONOTROUND,
};
use windows::Win32::UI::Input::KeyboardAndMouse::{GetAsyncKeyState, VK_LBUTTON, VK_RBUTTON};
use windows::Win32::UI::WindowsAndMessaging::{
    GetCursorPos, GetSystemMetrics, GetWindowLongPtrW, SetForegroundWindow, SetWindowLongPtrW,
    SetWindowPos, GWL_EXSTYLE, GWL_STYLE, HWND_TOPMOST, SM_CXSCREEN, SM_CYSCREEN,
    WS_BORDER, WS_DLGFRAME, WS_EX_NOACTIVATE, WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW, WS_EX_TOPMOST, WS_THICKFRAME,
};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Deserialize)]
pub struct HitRect {
    pub x: f64,
    pub y: f64,
    pub width: f64,
    pub height: f64,
}

pub struct PillHitState {
    pub rect: HitRect,
    pub window_x: i32,
    pub window_y: i32,
    pub scale_factor: f64,
    pub force_interactive: bool,
    pub reveal_width: f64,
    pub reveal_height: f64,
    pub reveal_enabled: bool,
}

pub fn get_preferences_file_path() -> std::path::PathBuf {
    let p = std::path::PathBuf::from("d:\\Pill\\user_preferences.json");
    if let Some(parent) = p.parent() {
        if parent.exists() {
            return p;
        }
    }
    if let Ok(appdata) = std::env::var("APPDATA") {
        let dir = std::path::PathBuf::from(appdata).join("Pill");
        let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir);
        return dir.join("user_preferences.json");
    }
    p
}

pub fn save_preferences_to_disk(json_str: &str) {
    let path = get_preferences_file_path();
    let _ = std::fs::write(&path, json_str);
}

pub fn read_preferences_from_disk() -> Option<String> {
    let path = get_preferences_file_path();
    std::fs::read_to_string(&path).ok()
}

pub fn configure_pill_overlay_window(window: &WebviewWindow) -> Arc<Mutex<PillHitState>> {
    let hwnd_raw = window.hwnd().unwrap().0;
    let hwnd = HWND(hwnd_raw as _);
    let scale = window.scale_factor().unwrap_or(1.0);

    let screen_w = unsafe { GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSCREEN) };
    let stage_w = (960.0 * scale) as i32;
    let stage_h = (600.0 * scale) as i32;
    let win_x = (screen_w - stage_w) / 2;

    if let Ok(mut f) = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
        .create(true)
        .append(true)
        .open("d:\\Pill\\events.log")
    {
        use std::io::Write;
        let _ = writeln!(
            f,
            "CONFIGURE PILL: HWND=0x{:X}, scale={}, screen_w={}, stage_w={}, stage_h={}, win_x={}",
            hwnd_raw as usize, scale, screen_w, stage_w, stage_h, win_x
        );
        let _ = f.flush();
    }

    unsafe {
        // Completely remove Windows 11 DWM window border and prevent corner rounding artifacts
        let border_none: u32 = 0xFFFFFFFE;
        let _ = DwmSetWindowAttribute(
            hwnd,
            DWMWA_BORDER_COLOR,
            &border_none as *const _ as *const _,
            std::mem::size_of::<u32>() as u32,
        );
        let corner_pref = DWMWCP_DONOTROUND;
        let _ = DwmSetWindowAttribute(
            hwnd,
            DWMWA_WINDOW_CORNER_PREFERENCE,
            &corner_pref as *const _ as *const _,
            std::mem::size_of_val(&corner_pref) as u32,
        );

        // Completely strip any standard Win32 window border styles
        let style = GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_STYLE);
        SetWindowLongPtrW(
            hwnd,
            GWL_STYLE,
            style & !(WS_BORDER.0 as isize) & !(WS_THICKFRAME.0 as isize) & !(WS_DLGFRAME.0 as isize),
        );

        // Strip taskbar footprint
        let ex_style = GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE);
        SetWindowLongPtrW(
            hwnd,
            GWL_EXSTYLE,
            ex_style
                | (WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW.0 as isize)
                | (WS_EX_TOPMOST.0 as isize),
        );

        let _ = SetWindowPos(
            hwnd,
            HWND_TOPMOST,
            win_x,
            0,
            stage_w,
            stage_h,
            windows::Win32::UI::WindowsAndMessaging::SWP_SHOWWINDOW,
        );
    }

    let screen_w = unsafe { GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSCREEN) };
    let stage_w = (960.0 * scale) as i32;
    let win_x = (screen_w - stage_w) / 2;

    let (init_reveal_w, init_reveal_h, init_reveal_en) = if let Some(saved) = read_preferences_from_disk() {
        if let Ok(val) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&saved) {
            let w = val.get("revealAreaWidth").and_then(|v| v.as_f64()).unwrap_or(140.0);
            let h = val.get("revealAreaHeight").and_then(|v| v.as_f64()).unwrap_or(4.0);
            let en = val.get("revealOnEdgeTouch").and_then(|v| v.as_bool()).unwrap_or(true);
            (w, h, en)
        } else {
            (140.0, 4.0, true)
        }
    } else {
        (140.0, 4.0, true)
    };

    let state = Arc::new(Mutex::new(PillHitState {
        rect: HitRect {
            x: 375.0,
            y: 0.0,
            width: 210.0,
            height: 38.0,
        },
        window_x: win_x,
        window_y: 0,
        scale_factor: scale,
        force_interactive: false,
        reveal_width: init_reveal_w.max(1.0),
        reveal_height: init_reveal_h.max(1.0),
        reveal_enabled: init_reveal_en,
    }));

    // 120Hz High-Precision Cursor Hit-Tester & Top-Bezel Auto-Reveal
    let win_clone = window.clone();
    let state_clone = Arc::clone(&state);
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        let mut last_ignore = true;
        let mut was_at_top_edge = false;
        let mut was_lbutton_down = false;
        let mut was_inside = false;
        let _ = win_clone.set_ignore_cursor_events(true);

        loop {
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(8));
            let mut pt = POINT::default();
            if unsafe { GetCursorPos(&mut pt).is_ok() } {
                if let Ok(st) = state_clone.lock() {
                    let s = st.scale_factor;

                    // Top-edge bezel auto-reveal: only reveal when mouse enters user-defined hit bounds
                    let is_at_top_edge = if st.reveal_enabled {
                        let center_x = st.window_x + ((st.rect.x + (st.rect.width / 2.0)) * s) as i32;
                        let half_width = ((st.reveal_width / 2.0) * s).round().max(20.0) as i32;
                        let height_limit = (st.reveal_height * s).round().max(1.0) as i32;
                        if st.window_y == 0 {
                            pt.y <= height_limit && pt.x >= (center_x - half_width) && pt.x <= (center_x + half_width)
                        } else {
                            let screen_h = unsafe { GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSCREEN) };
                            pt.y >= (screen_h - height_limit) && pt.x >= (center_x - half_width) && pt.x <= (center_x + half_width)
                        }
                    } else {
                        false
                    };

                    if is_at_top_edge && !was_at_top_edge {
                        let _ = win_clone.emit("pill://top-edge-hover", ());
                    }
                    was_at_top_edge = is_at_top_edge;

                    // Hysteresis deadband: 16px when already inside, 10px when outside to eliminate boundary oscillation
                    let pad = if was_inside { 16 } else { 10 };
                    let pill_left = st.window_x + (st.rect.x * s) as i32 - pad;
                    let pill_right = st.window_x + ((st.rect.x + st.rect.width) * s) as i32 + pad;
                    let pill_top = st.window_y + (st.rect.y * s) as i32 - pad;
                    let pill_bottom = st.window_y + ((st.rect.y + st.rect.height) * s) as i32 + pad;

                    let inside = st.force_interactive
                        || (pt.x >= pill_left
                            && pt.x <= pill_right
                            && pt.y >= pill_top
                            && pt.y <= pill_bottom);

                    // Detect cursor leaving/entering pill (both compact and expanded)
                    if !inside && was_inside {
                        let _ = win_clone.emit("pill://cursor-left-pill", ());
                    }
                    if inside && !was_inside {
                        let _ = win_clone.emit("pill://cursor-entered-pill", ());
                    }
                    was_inside = inside;

                    // Detect global outside click when cursor is outside the pill
                    let lbutton_down = unsafe { GetAsyncKeyState(VK_LBUTTON.0 as i32) < 0 };
                    let rbutton_down = unsafe { GetAsyncKeyState(VK_RBUTTON.0 as i32) < 0 };
                    let is_mouse_down = lbutton_down || rbutton_down;

                    let outside_stage = pt.x < st.window_x
                        || pt.x > st.window_x + (960.0 * s) as i32
                        || pt.y < st.window_y
                        || pt.y > st.window_y + (600.0 * s) as i32;

                    if ((!inside && lbutton_down) || (st.force_interactive && outside_stage && is_mouse_down))
                        && !was_lbutton_down
                    {
                        let _ = win_clone.emit("pill://outside-click", ());
                    }
                    was_lbutton_down = is_mouse_down;

                    let should_ignore = !inside;
                    if should_ignore != last_ignore {
                        let _ = win_clone.set_ignore_cursor_events(should_ignore);
                        last_ignore = should_ignore;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    });

    state
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn update_pill_hit_rect(
    state: tauri::State<'_, Arc<Mutex<PillHitState>>>,
    rect: HitRect,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    if let Ok(mut st) = state.lock() {
        st.rect = rect;
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn set_pill_force_interactive(
    state: tauri::State<'_, Arc<Mutex<PillHitState>>>,
    force: bool,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    if let Ok(mut st) = state.lock() {
        st.force_interactive = force;
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn set_pill_focusable(app: AppHandle, focusable: bool) -> Result<(), String> {
    if let Some(win) = app.get_webview_window("main-pill") {
        let hwnd = HWND(win.hwnd().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?.0 as _);
        unsafe {
            let ex_style = GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE);
            if focusable {
                SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE, ex_style & !(WS_EX_NOACTIVATE.0 as isize));
                let _ = SetForegroundWindow(hwnd);
            } else {
                SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE, ex_style | (WS_EX_NOACTIVATE.0 as isize));
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn open_settings_window(app: AppHandle) -> Result<(), String> {
    if let Some(win) = app.get_webview_window("settings-window") {
        let _ = win.unminimize();
        let _ = win.show();
        let _ = win.set_focus();
        if let Ok(hwnd_raw) = win.hwnd() {
            let hwnd = HWND(hwnd_raw.0 as _);
            unsafe {
                use windows::Win32::UI::WindowsAndMessaging::{
                    BringWindowToTop, SetForegroundWindow, SetWindowPos, ShowWindow, SW_RESTORE,
                    SW_SHOW, SWP_FRAMECHANGED, SWP_NOMOVE, SWP_NOSIZE, SWP_NOZORDER,
                };
                let _ = ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_RESTORE);
                let _ = ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_SHOW);
                let _ = SetWindowPos(
                    hwnd,
                    HWND(std::ptr::null_mut()),
                    0,
                    0,
                    0,
                    0,
                    SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_FRAMECHANGED,
                );
                let _ = BringWindowToTop(hwnd);
                let _ = SetForegroundWindow(hwnd);
            }
        }
    } else {
        let builder = tauri::WebviewWindowBuilder::new(
            &app,
            "settings-window",
            tauri::WebviewUrl::App("index.html#settings".into()),
        )
        .title("Pill Settings")
        .inner_size(920.0, 680.0)
        .center()
        .resizable(true)
        .decorations(false)
        .transparent(false)
        .shadow(false);

        if let Ok(win) = builder.build() {
            let _ = win.show();
            let _ = win.set_focus();
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn close_settings_window(app: AppHandle) -> Result<(), String> {
    if let Some(win) = app.get_webview_window("settings-window") {
        if let Ok(hwnd_raw) = win.hwnd() {
            let hwnd = HWND(hwnd_raw.0 as _);
            unsafe {
                use windows::Win32::UI::WindowsAndMessaging::{ShowWindow, SW_HIDE};
                let _ = ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_HIDE);
            }
        }
        let _ = win.hide();
    }
    Ok(())
}

    }
    Ok(())
}

#[tauri::command]

    if let Some(win) = app.get_webview_window("settings-window") {
        let is_max = win.is_maximized().unwrap_or(false);
        if is_max {
            let _ = win.unmaximize();
        } else {
            let _ = win.maximize();
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

    if let Some(win) = app.get_webview_window("settings-window") {
        let is_fs = win.is_fullscreen().unwrap_or(false);
        let _ = win.set_fullscreen(!is_fs);
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn reposition_pill_window(app: AppHandle, anchor: String) -> Result<(), String> {
    if let Some(win) = app.get_webview_window("main-pill") {
        let hwnd_raw = win.hwnd().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?.0;
        let hwnd = HWND(hwnd_raw as _);
        let scale = win.scale_factor().unwrap_or(1.0);

        let screen_w = unsafe { GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSCREEN) };
        let screen_h = unsafe { GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSCREEN) };

        let stage_w = (960.0 * scale) as i32;
        let stage_h = (600.0 * scale) as i32;

        let (win_x, win_y) = match anchor.as_str() {
            "top_left" => (0, 0),
            "top_right" => (screen_w - stage_w, 0),
            "bottom_taskbar" => ((screen_w - stage_w) / 2, screen_h - stage_h),
            _ => ((screen_w - stage_w) / 2, 0), // top_center default
        };

        if let Some(state) = app.try_state::<Arc<Mutex<PillHitState>>>() {
            if let Ok(mut st) = state.lock() {
                st.window_x = win_x;
                st.window_y = win_y;
            }
        }

        unsafe {
            use windows::Win32::UI::WindowsAndMessaging::{
                SetWindowPos, HWND_TOPMOST, SWP_NOACTIVATE, SWP_SHOWWINDOW,
            };
            let _ = SetWindowPos(
                hwnd,
                HWND_TOPMOST,
                win_x,
                win_y,
                stage_w,
                stage_h,
                SWP_SHOWWINDOW | SWP_NOACTIVATE,
            );
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

const ICON_MOTORSPORT: &[u8] = include_bytes!("../../public/assets/themes/icons/motorsport_gt.png");
const ICON_APPLE: &[u8] = include_bytes!("../../public/assets/themes/icons/apple_indigo.png");

pub fn get_icon_bytes_for_theme(theme_id: &str) -> &'static [u8] {
    match theme_id {
        "cyberpunk_neon" => ICON_CYBERPUNK,
        "retro_synth_crt" | "sunset_rose" => ICON_RETRO,
        "paper_editorial" => ICON_PAPER,
        "cozy_animals" | "emerald_forest" => ICON_COZY,
        "botanical_sakura" => ICON_BOTANICAL,
        "motorsport_gt" | "crimson_titanium" => ICON_MOTORSPORT,
        "apple_indigo" => ICON_APPLE,
        _ => ICON_WIN11,
    }
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn update_window_theme_icon(app: AppHandle, theme_id: String) -> Result<(), String> {
    let bytes = get_icon_bytes_for_theme(&theme_id);
    let image = tauri::image::Image::from_bytes(bytes).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

    for label in &["main-pill", "settings-window"] {
        if let Some(win) = app.get_webview_window(label) {
            let _ = win.set_icon(image.clone());
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn get_saved_preferences() -> Result<Option<String>, String> {
    Ok(read_preferences_from_disk())
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn save_user_preferences(preferences_json: String) -> Result<(), String> {
    save_preferences_to_disk(&preferences_json);
    Ok(())
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn update_pill_reveal_settings(
    state: tauri::State<'_, Arc<Mutex<PillHitState>>>,
    width: f64,
    height: f64,
    enabled: bool,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    if let Ok(mut st) = state.lock() {
        st.reveal_width = width.max(1.0);
        st.reveal_height = height.max(1.0);
        st.reveal_enabled = enabled;
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn broadcast_preferences_sync(
    app: AppHandle,
    state: tauri::State<'_, Arc<Mutex<PillHitState>>>,
    preferences_json: Option<String>,
    prefs_json: Option<String>,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    let json_str = preferences_json
        .or(prefs_json)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| "{}".to_string());
    save_preferences_to_disk(&json_str);
    let _ = app.emit("pill://preferences-updated", json_str.clone());
    if let Ok(val) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&json_str) {
        if let Some(anchor) = val.get("anchorPosition").and_then(|a| a.as_str()) {
            let _ = reposition_pill_window(app.clone(), anchor.to_string());
        }
        if let Some(theme) = val.get("themeId").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) {
            let _ = update_window_theme_icon(app.clone(), theme.to_string());
        }
        if let Ok(mut st) = state.lock() {
            if let Some(w) = val.get("revealAreaWidth").and_then(|v| v.as_f64()) {
                st.reveal_width = w.max(1.0);
            }
            if let Some(h) = val.get("revealAreaHeight").and_then(|v| v.as_f64()) {
                st.reveal_height = h.max(1.0);
            }
            if let Some(en) = val.get("revealOnEdgeTouch").and_then(|v| v.as_bool()) {
                st.reveal_enabled = en;
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && '__TAURI_INTERNALS__' in window) {

  const summonAstraInPill = useCallback(() => {

  const executeVoiceAgentActions = useCallback(
    (actions: VoiceAgentAction[]) => {
      if (!actions || actions.length === 0) return;
      const summaries: string[] = [];

      for (const action of actions) {
        const args = action.args ?? {};
        switch (action.name) {
          case 'setWindowsToggle': {
            const setting = String(args.setting || '').toLowerCase();
            const enabled = Boolean(args.enabled);
            if (setting === 'wifi') {
              setSystemState((p) => ({ ...p, wifiEnabled: enabled }));
            } else if (setting === 'bluetooth') {
              setSystemState((p) => ({ ...p, bluetoothEnabled: enabled }));
            } else if (setting === 'airplane') {
              setSystemState((p) => ({
                ...p,
                airplaneMode: enabled,
                wifiEnabled: enabled ? false : p.wifiEnabled,
                bluetoothEnabled: enabled ? false : p.bluetoothEnabled,
              }));
            } else if (setting === 'nightlight') {
              setNightLight(enabled);
            } else if (setting === 'saver') {
              setSystemState((p) => ({ ...p, batterySaver: enabled }));
            } else if (setting === 'captions') {
              setSystemState((p) => ({ ...p, liveCaptions: enabled }));
            } else if (setting === 'hotspot') {
              setSystemState((p) => ({ ...p, hotspotEnabled: enabled }));
            } else if (setting === 'dnd') {
              setSystemState((p) => ({ ...p, dndEnabled: enabled }));
            } else if (setting === 'mic') {
              setMicMuted(!enabled);
            } else if (setting === 'awake') {
              setKeepAwake(enabled);
            } else if (setting === 'spatial') {
              setSystemState((p) => ({ ...p, spatialAudio: enabled }));
            } else if (setting === 'privacy') {
              setPreferences((p) => ({ ...p, privacyMaskEnabled: enabled }));
            }
            summaries.push(action.summary || `${setting} ${enabled ? 'On' : 'Off'}`);
            break;
          }
          case 'setSystemLevel': {
            const target = String(args.target || '').toLowerCase();
            const level = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(Number(args.level ?? 50))));
            if (target === 'volume') setVolumeLevel(level);
            if (target === 'brightness') setBrightnessLevel(level);
            summaries.push(action.summary || `${target} ${level}%`);
            break;
          }
          case 'controlMedia': {
            const cmd = String(args.command || '').toLowerCase();
            if (cmd === 'play') setIsPlaying(true);
            else if (cmd === 'pause') setIsPlaying(false);
            else if (cmd === 'next') {
              setTrackIndex((idx) => (idx + 1) % DEMO_TRACKS.length);
              setTrackProgressSec(0);
            } else if (cmd === 'previous') {
              setTrackIndex((idx) => (idx - 1 + DEMO_TRACKS.length) % DEMO_TRACKS.length);
              setTrackProgressSec(0);
            }
            summaries.push(action.summary || `Media: ${cmd}`);
            break;
          }
          case 'manageTimer': {
            const timerAct = String(args.action || '').toLowerCase();
            if (timerAct === 'cancel') {
              setTimerRemainingSec(null);
            } else {
              const sec = Math.max(10, Math.round(Number(args.seconds ?? 300)));
              setTimerTotalSec(sec);
              setTimerRemainingSec(sec);
            }
            summaries.push(action.summary || `Timer ${timerAct}`);
            break;
          }
          case 'applyStyleKit': {
            const kitId = String(args.kitId || '');
            const kit = COMPLETE_STYLE_KITS.find((k) => k.id === kitId);
            if (kit) {
              setPreferences((prev) => ({
                ...prev,
                themeId: kit.themeId,
                musicSliderStyle: kit.musicSliderStyle,
                controlSliderStyle: kit.controlSliderStyle,
                tileSurfaceStyle: kit.tileSurfaceStyle,
                iconPack: kit.iconPack,
                innerCapsuleRadius: kit.innerCapsuleRadius,
                edgeLightProfile: kit.edgeLightProfile,
                soundProfile: kit.soundProfile,
                astraOrbStyle: KIT_ASTRA_STYLES[kit.id] || 'siri_rainbow',
                featureFlags: {
                  ...prev.featureFlags,
                  edgeLighting: kit.edgeLightProfile !== 'off',
                },
              }));
              summaries.push(action.summary || `Style Kit: ${kit.title}`);
            }
            break;
          }
          case 'openIslandView': {
            const view = String(args.view || 'home') as PillTab | 'settings';
            setIsVoiceAgentOpen(false);
            if (view === 'settings') {
              setIsExpanded(false);
              const isTauri = typeof window !== 'undefined' && '__TAURI_INTERNALS__' in window;
              if (isTauri) {
                import('@tauri-apps/api/core').then(({ invoke }) => {
                  invoke('open_settings_window').catch(() => {
                    setIsSettingsModalOpen(true);
                  });
                });
              } else {
                setIsSettingsModalOpen(true);
              }
            } else {
              setIsLauncherOpen(false);
              setActiveTab(view);
              setIsExpanded(true);
            }
            summaries.push(action.summary || `Opened ${view}`);
            break;
          }
          case 'addQuickNoteOrReminder': {
            const kind = String(args.kind || 'note');
            const text = String(args.text || '').trim();
            if (text) {
              if (kind === 'reminder') {
                setReminders((prev) => [
                  { id: `rem-${Date.now()}`, title: text, dueTime: 'Today', completed: false },
                  ...prev,
                ]);
              } else {
                setNoteContent((prev) => (prev ? `${prev}\n- ${text}` : `- ${text}`));
              }
              summaries.push(action.summary || `Saved ${kind}`);
            }
            break;
          }
          default:
            break;
        }
      }

      if (summaries.length > 0) {
        playTactilePop('confirm');
        showTransientToast(`Astra executed: ${summaries.join(' Â· ')}`);
      }
    },
    [showTransientToast]
  );

  // Global Keyboard Shortcut Listener: Alt+L (Summon Island) & Alt+V (Morph Pill into Astra)
  useEffect(() => {
    const onGlobalKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const targetEl = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
      const isTextInput =
        targetEl &&
        (targetEl.tagName === 'INPUT' ||
          targetEl.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' ||
          targetEl.isContentEditable);
      if (isTextInput && !e.altKey && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey) {
        return;
      }

      if (matchesShortcutCombo(e, preferences.voiceAgentShortcut)) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!preferences.aiEnabled) {
          showTransientToast('Astra & AI features are disabled in Settings');
          return;
        }
        setIsExpanded(false);
        setIsVoiceAgentOpen((prev) => {
          const next = !prev;
          playTactilePop(next ? 'expand' : 'collapse');
          return next;
        });
        return;
      }

      if (matchesShortcutCombo(e, preferences.toggleShortcut)) {
        e.preventDefault();
        setStealthRevealedByShortcut(true);
        setIsVoiceAgentOpen(false);
        setIsExpanded((prev) => {
          const next = !prev;
          playTactilePop(next ? 'expand' : 'collapse');
          if (!next) {
            window.setTimeout(() => setStealthRevealedByShortcut(false), 1800);
          }
          return next;
        });
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onGlobalKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onGlobalKeyDown);
  }, [
    preferences.toggleShortcut,
    preferences.voiceAgentShortcut,
    preferences.aiEnabled,
    showTransientToast,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(NOTES_STORAGE_KEY, noteContent);
    } catch {
      // Ignore
    }
  }, [noteContent]);

  // 1Hz Media, Timer, Call & Subtle System Telemetry Ticker
  useEffect(() => {
    const interval = window.setInterval(() => {
      if (isPlaying && preferences.featureFlags.nowPlaying) {
        setTrackProgressSec((prev) => {
          if (prev + 1 >= currentTrack.durationSec) {
            setTrackIndex((idx) => (idx + 1) % DEMO_TRACKS.length);
            return 0;
          }
          return prev + 1;
        });
      }

      setTimerRemainingSec((prev) => {
        if (prev === null) return null;
        if (prev <= 1) {
          playTactilePop('notification');
          return null;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });

      setCallSession((prev) => {
        if (!prev || !prev.isAccepted) return prev;
        return { ...prev, elapsedSec: prev.elapsedSec + 1 };
      });

      setSystemState((prev) => {
        const nextDown = prev.wifiEnabled
          ? Number(
              Math.max(18.0, Math.min(480.0, prev.netDownMbps + (Math.random() - 0.48) * 22)).toFixed(1)
            )
          : 0;
        const nextUp = prev.wifiEnabled
          ? Number(
              Math.max(8.0, Math.min(180.0, prev.netUpMbps + (Math.random() - 0.48) * 9)).toFixed(1)
            )
          : 0;
        return {
          ...prev,
          cpuUsagePct: Number(
            Math.max(2.1, Math.min(24.0, prev.cpuUsagePct + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.4)).toFixed(1)
          ),
          netDownMbps: nextDown,
          netUpMbps: nextUp,
          netPeakDownMbps: Math.max(prev.netPeakDownMbps, nextDown),
          sessionDownGb: Number((prev.sessionDownGb + nextDown / 8000 / 8).toFixed(2)),
          netHistoryDown: [...prev.netHistoryDown.slice(-23), nextDown],
          netHistoryUp: [...prev.netHistoryUp.slice(-23), nextUp],
        };
      });
    }, 1000);

    return () => window.clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isPlaying, currentTrack.durationSec, preferences.featureFlags.nowPlaying]);

  const clearAutoHudTimer = () => {
    if (hudTimeoutRef.current !== null) {
      window.clearTimeout(hudTimeoutRef.current);
      hudTimeoutRef.current = null;
    }
  };

  const triggerSystemHud = (kind: 'volume' | 'brightness' | 'battery' | 'download') => {
    if (
      (kind === 'volume' || kind === 'brightness') &&
      !preferences.featureFlags.systemHuds
    ) {
      showTransientToast('System HUDs are currently disabled in Settings');
      return;
    }
    if (kind === 'battery' && !preferences.featureFlags.chargingEtaHud) {
      showTransientToast('Charging ETA HUD is disabled in Settings');
      return;
    }
    clearAutoHudTimer();
    setIsExpanded(false);
    setIsVoiceAgentOpen(false);
    setTransientHud(kind);
    playTactilePop('notification');
    hudTimeoutRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setTransientHud((curr) => (curr === kind ? 'none' : curr));
    }, 3400);
  };

  const triggerIncomingCall = () => {
    clearAutoHudTimer();
    if (transientHud === 'call') {
      setTransientHud('none');
      setCallSession(null);
      return;
    }
    setIsExpanded(false);
    setIsVoiceAgentOpen(false);
    setCallSession({
      callerName: 'Elena Rostova',
      appSource: 'Microsoft Teams',
      avatarUrl: CALLER_AVATAR_URL,
      isAccepted: false,
      isMuted: false,
      elapsedSec: 0,
    });
    setTransientHud('call');
    playTactilePop('notification');
  };

  const triggerAgentApproval = () => {
    if (!preferences.featureFlags.codingAgents) {
      showTransientToast('Coding Assistant Pipe is disabled in Settings');
      return;
    }
    clearAutoHudTimer();
    if (transientHud === 'agent') {
      setTransientHud('none');
      setAgentRequest(null);
      return;

    setIsVoiceAgentOpen(false);

      DEMO_AGENT_PROMPTS[agentPromptCursorRef.current % DEMO_AGENT_PROMPTS.length];
    agentPromptCursorRef.current += 1;
    setAgentRequest(nextPrompt);
    setTransientHud('agent');
    playTactilePop('notification');
  };

  const handleDownloadWinUIZip = () => {
    const zipBytes = createZipArchive([
      ...WINUI_NATIVE_FILES.map((f) => ({ path: f.path, content: f.content })),
    ]);
    const blob = new Blob([zipBytes], { type: 'application/zip' });

  };

  // Two-window routing support for Tauri & Web Preview
  const [isSettingsWindow, setIsSettingsWindow] = useState(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;

  const [isSettingsModalOpen, setIsSettingsModalOpen] = useState(false);

  const isExpandedRef = useRef(isExpanded);
  isExpandedRef.current = isExpanded;
  const isVoiceAgentOpenRef = useRef(isVoiceAgentOpen);

  // Tauri hardware bridge integration
  useEffect(() => {

    if (!isTauri) return;

    let unlistenList: Array<() => void> = [];

        const { invoke } = await import('@tauri-apps/api/core');

        // Alt+L: Toggle Island expand/collapse (Full Pill Studio)

          setStealthRevealedByShortcut(true);
          setIsExpanded((prev) => !prev);
        });
        unlistenList.push(u1);

        // Alt+K: Reveal compact pill from top (2nd method to open without expanding full studio)
        const uAltK = await listen('pill://hotkey-reveal-compact', () => {

          setStealthRevealedByShortcut((prev) => !prev);
          playTactilePop('tab');
        });

          summonAstraInPill();
        });
        unlistenList.push(u2);

        // Bezel hover: drop the smaller compact pill (then click to expand full studio)
        const u3 = await listen('pill://top-edge-hover', () => {

        unlistenList.push(u3);

  // Standalone Settings Window Mode
  if (isSettingsWindow || isSettingsModalOpen) {

    >
      <PillCapsule

          )

        onChangeNoteContent={setNoteContent}
        reminders={reminders}
        onToggleReminder={(id) =>

          )
        }
        onAddReminder={(title) =>
          setReminders((prev) => [
            {
              id: `rem-${Date.now()}`,

              dueTime: 'Today',

        preferences={preferences}
        onUpdatePreferences={updatePreferences}
        stealthRevealedByShortcut={stealthRevealedByShortcut}

      {/* Transient Status Toast */}
      {statusBanner && (
        <div
          role="status"
          aria-live="polite"
          className="fixed top-24 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-40 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-900/90 border border-white/15 text-xs text-slate-100 shadow-lg pointer-events-none"
        >
          {statusBanner}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Zero-UI Wake-Word Listener ("Astra" / "Astram" / "à°…à°¸à±à°¤à±à°°à°‚") */}
      <AstraWakeWordDaemon
        isAstraOpen={isVoiceAgentOpen}
        aiEnabled={preferences.aiEnabled}
        wakeWordEnabled={preferences.astraWakeWordEnabled}
        onSummonAstra={summonAstraInPill}
      />
    </div>
  );

import React, { useId } from 'react';

export type BatteryOperationalMode = 'charging' | 'discharging' | 'idle_full' | 'low';

interface AnimatedBatterySymbolProps {
  percent: number;
  isCharging: boolean;
  modeOverride?: BatteryOperationalMode;
  accentHex?: string;
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
  lowPowerEco?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export const AnimatedBatterySymbol: React.FC<AnimatedBatterySymbolProps> = ({
  percent,
  isCharging,
  modeOverride,
  accentHex = '#22d3ee',
  size = 'md',
  lowPowerEco = false,
  className = '',
}) => {
  const uid = useId().replace(/:/g, '');
  const clamped = Math.max(2, Math.min(100, Math.round(percent)));

  const effectiveMode: BatteryOperationalMode =
    modeOverride ??
    (isCharging && clamped >= 99
      ? 'idle_full'
      : isCharging
        ? 'charging'
        : clamped <= 20
          ? 'low'
          : 'discharging');

  const dims =
    size === 'sm'
      ? { w: 24, h: 12 }
      : size === 'lg'
        ? { w: 46, h: 22 }
        : { w: 32, h: 16 };

  // Internal fill max width inside 40x20 viewBox body (body is x=1.5..35.5 => inner x=3.5..33.5, maxW=30)
  const fillWidth = Math.max(2.2, (clamped / 100) * 30);

  const primaryColor =
    effectiveMode === 'charging'
      ? '#34d399'
      : effectiveMode === 'idle_full'
        ? accentHex
        : effectiveMode === 'low'
          ? '#fb7185'
          : '#fbbf24';

  const secondaryColor =
    effectiveMode === 'charging'
      ? accentHex
      : effectiveMode === 'idle_full'
        ? '#34d399'
        : effectiveMode === 'low'
          ? '#e11d48'
          : '#f59e0b';

  return (
    <span
      className={`inline-flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 select-none ${className}`}
      title={
        effectiveMode === 'charging'
          ? `Charging (${clamped}%)`
          : effectiveMode === 'idle_full'
            ? `Plugged In Â· Idle Full (${clamped}%)`
            : effectiveMode === 'low'
              ? `Low Battery (${clamped}%)`
              : `Discharging on Battery (${clamped}%)`
      }
    >
      <svg
        width={dims.w}
        height={dims.h}
        viewBox="0 0 42 20"
        fill="none"
        xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="overflow-visible"
      >
        <defs>
          <linearGradient id={`bat-grad-${uid}`} x1="3.5" y1="10" x2="33.5" y2="10" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
            <stop offset="0%" stopColor={primaryColor} />
            <stop offset="100%" stopColor={secondaryColor} />
          </linearGradient>

          <linearGradient id={`bat-shimmer-${uid}`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
            <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#ffffff" stopOpacity="0" />
            <stop offset="50%" stopColor="#ffffff" stopOpacity="0.6" />
            <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#ffffff" stopOpacity="0" />
          </linearGradient>

          <clipPath id={`bat-clip-${uid}`}>
            <rect x="3.5" y="3.5" width={fillWidth} height="13" rx="3.2" />
          </clipPath>
        </defs>

        {/* Subtle Ambient Glow when Charging or Low */}
        {!lowPowerEco && (effectiveMode === 'charging' || effectiveMode === 'low') && (
          <rect
            x="2"
            y="2"
            width="33"
            height="16"
            rx="5"
            fill={primaryColor}
            opacity={effectiveMode === 'low' ? 0.22 : 0.16}
          >
            <animate
              attributeName="opacity"
              values={effectiveMode === 'low' ? '0.1;0.34;0.1' : '0.1;0.24;0.1'}
              dur={effectiveMode === 'low' ? '1.1s' : '2.2s'}
              repeatCount="indefinite"
            />
          </rect>
        )}

        {/* Outer Titanium / Glass Battery Shell */}
        <rect
          x="1.5"
          y="1.5"
          width="34"
          height="17"
          rx="5"
          fill="rgba(15,23,42,0.72)"
          stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.42)"
          strokeWidth="1.4"
        />

        {/* Positive Terminal Cap */}
        <path
          d="M37.2 7.2C38.5 7.2 39.5 8.1 39.5 9.3V10.7C39.5 11.9 38.5 12.8 37.2 12.8V7.2Z"
          fill={effectiveMode === 'charging' ? primaryColor : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.45)'}
        />

        {/* Inner Cell Track Background */}
        <rect x="3.5" y="3.5" width="30" height="13" rx="3.2" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.08)" />

        {/* Dynamic Liquid Level Fill */}
        <rect
          x="3.5"
          y="3.5"
          width={fillWidth}
          height="13"
          rx="3.2"
          fill={`url(#bat-grad-${uid})`}
        />

        {/* Top Specular Glass Reflection on Fill */}
        <g clipPath={`url(#bat-clip-${uid})`}>
          <rect x="3.5" y="3.5" width="30" height="4.5" rx="2" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.22" />

          {/* CASE 1: CHARGING â€” Travelling Liquid Current Wave */}
          {!lowPowerEco && effectiveMode === 'charging' && (
            <rect x="-14" y="3.5" width="14" height="13" fill={`url(#bat-shimmer-${uid})`}>
              <animate
                attributeName="x"
                from="-12"
                to="35"
                dur="1.55s"
                repeatCount="indefinite"
              />
            </rect>
          )}

          {/* CASE 2: DISCHARGING â€” Gentle Energy Micro-Pulse Toward Load */}
          {!lowPowerEco && effectiveMode === 'discharging' && (
            <circle cx={Math.max(6, fillWidth)} cy="10" r="3.5" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.2">
              <animate
                attributeName="cx"
                from={String(Math.min(32, fillWidth + 2))}

  return {
    haloMid: 'rgba(139, 92, 246, ',
    haloEnd: 'rgba(236, 72, 153, 0)',
    rimMid: 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.34)',
    rimEnd: 'rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.48)',
    coreMid: 'rgba(165, 243, 252, 0.22)',
    coreEnd: 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0)',
    innerGlow: 'rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.36)',
  };
}
