/**
 * N1. NARUTO RASENGAN (èžºæ—‹ä¸¸)
 * Swirling concentrated sphere of high-velocity chakra streams with brilliant white core.
 */
function drawNarutoRasengan(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  radius: number,
  phase: number,
  smoothEnergy: number
) {
  ctx.save();

  // Chakra Blue Aura
  const aura = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, radius * 0.2, cx, cy, radius * 1.15);
  aura.addColorStop(0, `rgba(103, 232, 249, ${(0.45 + smoothEnergy * 0.3).toFixed(3)})`);
  aura.addColorStop(0.55, `rgba(6, 182, 212, ${(0.3 + smoothEnergy * 0.25).toFixed(3)})`);
  aura.addColorStop(0.85, `rgba(37, 99, 235, ${(0.15 + smoothEnergy * 0.2).toFixed(3)})`);
  aura.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = aura;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius * 1.15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';

  // 8 High-Velocity Logarithmic Chakra Stream Loops
  const streams = 8;
  for (let s = 0; s < streams; s++) {
    const streamPhase = phase * 8.5 * (s % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1) + (s * Math.PI * 2) / streams;
    ctx.beginPath();
    const steps = 36;
    for (let st = 0; st <= steps; st++) {
      const u = (st / steps) * 2 - 1;
      const angle = u * Math.PI * 2 + streamPhase;
      const rVal = radius * (0.35 + (1 - Math.abs(u)) * 0.45 * (0.8 + smoothEnergy * 0.4));
      const x = cx + Math.cos(angle) * rVal;
      const y = cy + Math.sin(angle) * rVal * 0.75;
      if (st === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.strokeStyle = s % 2 === 0 ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75)' : 'rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.85)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6 + smoothEnergy * 1.5;
    ctx.shadowColor = '#22d3ee';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Brilliant White-Hot Concentrated Chakra Core Sphere
  const coreR = radius * (0.32 + smoothEnergy * 0.15);
  const core = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, coreR);
  core.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
  core.addColorStop(0.4, 'rgba(224, 242, 254, 0.95)');
  core.addColorStop(0.8, 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.6)');
  core.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = core;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, coreR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.restore();
}

/**
 * N2. NARUTO RASENSHURIKEN (é¢¨éãƒ»èžºæ—‹æ‰‹è£å‰£)
 * Concentrated Rasengan core enveloped by 4 gigantic razor-sharp rotating wind shuriken blades.
 */
function drawNarutoRasenshuriken(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  radius: number,
  phase: number,
  smoothEnergy: number
) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';

  // 4 Giant Spinning Aerodynamic Shuriken Wind Blades
  const bladeRot = phase * 12;
  const bladeR = radius * (0.92 + smoothEnergy * 0.22);

  for (let b = 0; b < 4; b++) {
    const bAngle = bladeRot + (b * Math.PI) / 2;
    const cosA = Math.cos(bAngle);
    const sinA = Math.sin(bAngle);
    const perpCos = -sinA;
    const perpSin = cosA;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);

    // Outer razor-sharp sweeping curve
    const tipX = cx + cosA * bladeR;
    const tipY = cy + sinA * bladeR;
    const wingX = cx + cosA * (bladeR * 0.65) + perpCos * (bladeR * 0.45);
    const wingY = cy + sinA * (bladeR * 0.65) + perpSin * (bladeR * 0.45);

    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx + perpCos * (bladeR * 0.2), cy + perpSin * (bladeR * 0.2), wingX, wingY);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx + cosA * (bladeR * 0.85) + perpCos * (bladeR * 0.15), cy + sinA * (bladeR * 0.85) + perpSin * (bladeR * 0.15), tipX, tipY);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx + cosA * (bladeR * 0.5), cy + sinA * (bladeR * 0.5), cx, cy);

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(165, 243, 252, 0.45)';
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
    ctx.shadowColor = '#06b6d4';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // Central Spinning Rasengan Sphere
  drawNarutoRasengan(ctx, cx, cy, radius * 0.48, phase * 1.5, smoothEnergy);

  ctx.restore();
}

/**
 * N3. NARUTO SHARINGAN (å†™è¼ªçœ¼)
 * Crimson red Uchiha iris, black pupil, concentric ring, and 3 rotating curved tomoe commas.
 */
function drawNarutoSharingan(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  radius: number,
  phase: number,
  smoothEnergy: number
) {
  ctx.save();

  // Crimson Red Iris Outer Glow
  const irisR = radius * 0.86;
  const iris = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, irisR);
  iris.addColorStop(0, '#ef4444');
  iris.addColorStop(0.75, '#dc2626');
  iris.addColorStop(1, '#7f1d1d');
  ctx.fillStyle = iris;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, irisR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Dark Outer Iris Perimeter Rim
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, irisR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#18181b';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.stroke();

  // Inner Black Concentric Ring where Tomoe reside
  const tomoeTrackR = irisR * 0.54;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, tomoeTrackR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#18181b';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;
  ctx.stroke();

  // Black Pupil in center
  const pupilR = irisR * 0.22;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, pupilR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#09090b';
  ctx.fill();

  // 3 Curved Tomoe (å·´) spaced at 120Â°
  const tomoeRot = phase * 2.2;
  for (let t = 0; t < 3; t++) {
    const angle = tomoeRot + (t * Math.PI * 2) / 3;
    const tx = cx + Math.cos(angle) * tomoeTrackR;
    const ty = cy + Math.sin(angle) * tomoeTrackR;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(tx, ty);
    ctx.rotate(angle + Math.PI / 2);

    // Tomoe round head
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, irisR * 0.11, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#09090b';
    ctx.fill();

    // Curved tapering comma tail
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(irisR * 0.08, 0);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(irisR * 0.18, -irisR * 0.12, 0, -irisR * 0.26);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -irisR * 0.1, -irisR * 0.08, 0);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#09090b';
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  // Specular Reflection Arc
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(cx - irisR * 0.28, cy - irisR * 0.32, irisR * 0.28, irisR * 0.14, -0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45)';
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.restore();
}

/**
 * N4. NARUTO MANGEKYO SHARINGAN & SUSANOO (ä¸‡è¯é¡å†™è¼ªçœ¼ãƒ»é ˆä½èƒ½ä¹Ž)
 * Geometric Mangekyo pinwheel iris framed by ethereal spectral violet Susanoo ribcage flames.
 */
function drawNarutoMangekyoSusano(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  radius: number,
  phase: number,
  smoothEnergy: number
) {
  ctx.save();

  // Ethereal Purple Susanoo Chakra Aura & Flames
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
  const susanooAura = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, radius * 0.3, cx, cy, radius * 1.15);
  susanooAura.addColorStop(0, `rgba(192, 132, 252, ${(0.45 + smoothEnergy * 0.35).toFixed(3)})`);
  susanooAura.addColorStop(0.6, `rgba(147, 51, 234, ${(0.3 + smoothEnergy * 0.25).toFixed(3)})`);
  susanooAura.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(126, 34, 206, 0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = susanooAura;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius * 1.15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // 4 Spectral Susanoo Rib Bones
  for (let r = 0; r < 4; r++) {
    const rAngle = (r * Math.PI) / 2 + Math.sin(phase * 2 + r) * 0.1;
    const ribR = radius * (0.88 + smoothEnergy * 0.2);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx, cy);
    ctx.rotate(rAngle);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(ribR * 0.3, -ribR * 0.7);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(ribR * 0.85, -ribR * 0.5, ribR * 0.65, ribR * 0.65);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(216, 180, 254, 0.75)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.8;
    ctx.shadowColor = '#c084fc';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';

  // Central Crimson Iris
  const irisR = radius * 0.58;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, irisR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#dc2626';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#18181b';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();

  // 3 Mangekyo Curved Pinwheel Blades (Sasuke / Itachi geometric pattern)
  const pinRot = phase * 2.8;
  for (let b = 0; b < 3; b++) {
    const pAngle = pinRot + (b * Math.PI * 2) / 3;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx, cy);
    ctx.rotate(pAngle);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(irisR * 0.7, -irisR * 0.3, 0, -irisR * 0.95);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-irisR * 0.2, -irisR * 0.4, 0, 0);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#09090b';
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // Central Black Core
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, irisR * 0.18, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#09090b';
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.restore();
}

/**
 * N5. NARUTO AKATSUKI RED CLOUD (æšã®é›²)
 * Iconic crimson cloud with crisp white border, dark blood-chakra swirls, and drifting red embers.
 */
function drawNarutoAkatsukiCloud(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  radius: number,
  phase: number,
  smoothEnergy: number
) {
  ctx.save();

  // Pulsing Crimson Shinobi Aura
  const aura = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, radius * 0.15, cx, cy, radius * 1.25);
  aura.addColorStop(0, `rgba(239, 68, 68, ${(0.4 + smoothEnergy * 0.3).toFixed(3)})`);
  aura.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(153, 27, 27, 0.22)');
  aura.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(220, 38, 38, 0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = aura;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius * 1.25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Authentic Official Akatsuki Crimson Cloud (Rendered with 100% fidelity to source)
  const akatsukiImg = getAkatsukiImage();
  const breathe = 1 + Math.sin(phase * 1.6) * 0.045 + smoothEnergy * 0.08;
  const targetW = radius * 1.7 * breathe;
  const targetH = targetW * (148 / 212); // authentic aspect ratio

  if (akatsukiImg && akatsukiImg.complete && akatsukiImg.naturalWidth > 0) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.65)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
    ctx.drawImage(akatsukiImg, cx - targetW / 2, cy - targetH / 2, targetW, targetH);
    ctx.restore();
  } else {
    // Fallback high-fidelity vector path with inward swirl hooks
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx, cy);
    const sc = (radius * 0.9 * breathe) / 36;
    ctx.scale(sc, sc);

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-18, 8);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(-26, 8, -26, -4, -14, -6);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(-14, -16, 2, -18, 10, -8);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(22, -10, 24, 4, 16, 10);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(14, 16, -2, 16, -6, 12);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(-10, 16, -16, 14, -18, 8);
    ctx.closePath();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#9b1136';
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.4 / sc;
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(-2, 2, 5, 0.4, Math.PI * 1.6);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.8 / sc;
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  // Drifting Crimson Shinobi Embers
  for (let e = 0; e < 6; e++) {
    const ePhase = phase * 2.2 + e * 1.3;
    const ex = cx + Math.sin(ePhase) * radius * 0.65;
    const ey = cy + radius * 0.55 - ((ePhase * 20) % (radius * 1.3));
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ex, ey, 1.8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ef4444';
    ctx.shadowColor = '#f87171';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
    ctx.fill();
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

/**
 * N6. NARUTO SHINOBI WHITE SMOKE CLOUD (å¤‰ã‚ã‚Šèº«ã®è¡“ãƒ»ç™½ç…™)
 * Stylized billowing white summon smoke with expanding swirls and curling wisps.
 */
function drawNarutoWhiteCloud(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  radius: number,
  phase: number,
  smoothEnergy: number
) {
  ctx.save();

  // Soft Silver-White Mist Aura
  const aura = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, radius * 1.1);
  aura.addColorStop(0, `rgba(248, 250, 252, ${(0.35 + smoothEnergy * 0.3).toFixed(3)})`);
  aura.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(203, 213, 225, 0.15)');
  aura.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = aura;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius * 1.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // 5 Billowing Overlapping Smoke Lobes
  const lobes = [
    { x: 0, y: -0.25, r: 0.42 },
    { x: -0.32, y: 0.05, r: 0.38 },
    { x: 0.32, y: 0.08, r: 0.36 },
    { x: -0.15, y: 0.28, r: 0.34 },
    { x: 0.18, y: 0.26, r: 0.32 },
  ];

  for (let i = 0; i < lobes.length; i++) {
    const l = lobes[i];
    const osc = Math.sin(phase * 1.8 + i) * radius * 0.05 * (1 + smoothEnergy);
    const lx = cx + l.x * radius + osc;
    const ly = cy + l.y * radius - osc;
    const lr = l.r * radius * (1 + smoothEnergy * 0.15);

    const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(lx - lr * 0.2, ly - lr * 0.25, 0, lx, ly, lr);
    grad.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
    grad.addColorStop(0.65, '#e2e8f0');
    grad.addColorStop(1, '#94a3b8');

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(lx, ly, lr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Curling Dissipation Smoke Spirals
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx + radius * 0.35, cy - radius * 0.3, radius * 0.16, 0.2, Math.PI * 1.5);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.restore();
}

/**
 * F1. FORMULA 1 STEERING WHEEL TELEMETRY DASHBOARD
 * Multi-segment LED rev shift lights (Green -> Amber -> Red -> Blue), digital gear readout [8], DRS indicator.
 */
function drawF1TelemetryHud(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  radius: number,
  phase: number,
  smoothEnergy: number
) {
  ctx.save();

  // Carbon-Fiber Bezel Plate
  const boxW = radius * 1.65;
  const boxH = radius * 1.35;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(cx - boxW / 2, cy - boxH / 2, boxW, boxH, 12);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#09090b';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();

  // Top Shift Rev Lights: 15 LEDs (5 Green, 5 Amber, 5 Red)
  const numLeds = 15;
  const ledSpacing = (boxW - 24) / numLeds;
  const activeCount = Math.round(smoothEnergy * (numLeds + 2));

  for (let i = 0; i < numLeds; i++) {
    const lx = cx - boxW / 2 + 12 + i * ledSpacing + ledSpacing / 2;
    const ly = cy - boxH / 2 + 14;
    const lit = i < activeCount;

    let col = '#22c55e'; // Green 0..4
    if (i >= 5 && i < 10) col = '#f59e0b'; // Amber 5..9
    if (i >= 10) col = '#ef4444'; // Red 10..14

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(lx, ly, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = lit ? col : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)';
    if (lit) {
      ctx.shadowColor = col;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
    } else {
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    }
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Central Big Digital Gear Readout [8]
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.round(radius * 0.52)}px monospace`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText('8', cx, cy + 4);

  // Speed Counter "335 KM/H"
  ctx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8';
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.round(radius * 0.18)}px monospace`;
  const speed = 320 + Math.round(smoothEnergy * 28);
  ctx.fillText(`${speed} KM/H`, cx, cy + boxH * 0.32);

  // DRS Status Indicator
  ctx.fillStyle = smoothEnergy > 0.4 ? '#22c55e' : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)';
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.round(radius * 0.15)}px sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillText('DRS ACTIVE', cx, cy - boxH * 0.14);

  ctx.restore();
}

/**
 * F2-F6. FORMULA 1 PIRELLI TYRE (Hard, Medium, Soft, Inter, Wet)
 * Authentic rotating tyre sidewall ring with bold compound lettering (H, M, S, I, W).
 */
function drawF1Tyre(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  radius: number,
  phase: number,
  smoothEnergy: number,
  compound: 'H' | 'M' | 'S' | 'I' | 'W'
) {
  ctx.save();

  const colors: Record<'H' | 'M' | 'S' | 'I' | 'W', { hex: string; name: string }> = {
    H: { hex: '#ffffff', name: 'HARD' },
    M: { hex: '#facc15', name: 'MEDIUM' },
    S: { hex: '#ef4444', name: 'SOFT' },
    I: { hex: '#22c55e', name: 'INTER' },
    W: { hex: '#3b82f6', name: 'WET' },
  };

  const { hex, name } = colors[compound];

  // Outer Black Tyre Tread
  const tyreR = radius * 0.88;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, tyreR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#18181b';
  ctx.fill();

  // If Intermediate or Wet, draw grooved water dispersion tread marks
  if (compound === 'I' || compound === 'W') {
    const grooves = 16;
    for (let g = 0; g < grooves; g++) {
      const gAngle = phase * 3 + (g * Math.PI * 2) / grooves;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx + Math.cos(gAngle) * (tyreR - 8), cy + Math.sin(gAngle) * (tyreR - 8));
      ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(gAngle) * tyreR, cy + Math.sin(gAngle) * tyreR);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  // Colored Pirelli Compound Sidewall Ring
  const sidewallR = tyreR * 0.72;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, sidewallR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.strokeStyle = hex;
  ctx.shadowColor = hex;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.stroke();

  // Rotating Wheel Rim in Center
  const rimR = sidewallR * 0.58;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, rimR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#09090b';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.stroke();

  // 5 Wheel Spokes
  for (let sp = 0; sp < 5; sp++) {
    const sAngle = phase * 4 + (sp * Math.PI * 2) / 5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(sAngle) * rimR, cy + Math.sin(sAngle) * rimR);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Bold Compound Letter in Center
  ctx.fillStyle = hex;
  ctx.font = `bold ${Math.round(radius * 0.32)}px sans-serif`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText(compound, cx, cy);

  ctx.restore();
}

/**
 * S1. SUN: Blazing Photospheric Star with Magnetic Loops & Coronal Prominences
 */
function drawSpaceSun(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  radius: number,
  phase: number,
  smoothEnergy: number
) {
  ctx.save();

  // Multi-tier Thermonuclear Corona Plasma Glow
  const corona = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, radius * 0.35, cx, cy, radius * 1.3);
  corona.addColorStop(0, `rgba(254, 240, 138, ${(0.75 + smoothEnergy * 0.25).toFixed(3)})`);
  corona.addColorStop(0.35, `rgba(249, 115, 22, ${(0.55 + smoothEnergy * 0.3).toFixed(3)})`);
  corona.addColorStop(0.7, `rgba(220, 38, 38, ${(0.3 + smoothEnergy * 0.25).toFixed(3)})`);
  corona.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(153, 27, 27, 0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = corona;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius * 1.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Arched Magnetic Prominence Loops (Coronal Mass Ejection Arches that erupt & loop back)
  const loops = 8;
  for (let f = 0; f < loops; f++) {
    const baseAngle = (f * Math.PI * 2) / loops + phase * 0.25;
    const span = 0.32 + Math.sin(phase * 2.5 + f) * 0.08;
    const a1 = baseAngle - span;
    const a2 = baseAngle + span;
    const loopH = radius * (0.8 + Math.sin(phase * 3 + f * 1.8) * 0.28 * (1 + smoothEnergy));

    const x1 = cx + Math.cos(a1) * (radius * 0.6);
    const y1 = cy + Math.sin(a1) * (radius * 0.6);
    const x2 = cx + Math.cos(a2) * (radius * 0.6);
    const y2 = cy + Math.sin(a2) * (radius * 0.6);
    const peakX = cx + Math.cos(baseAngle) * loopH;
    const peakY = cy + Math.sin(baseAngle) * loopH;

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(peakX, peakY, x2, y2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = f % 2 === 0 ? 'rgba(254, 240, 138, 0.9)' : 'rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.95)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.4;
    ctx.shadowColor = '#f97316';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Brilliant Yellow/White Photospheric Core
  const sunR = radius * 0.64;
  const sunGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx - sunR * 0.15, cy - sunR * 0.2, 0, cx, cy, sunR);
  sunGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
  sunGrad.addColorStop(0.35, '#fef08a');
  sunGrad.addColorStop(0.65, '#f59e0b');
  sunGrad.addColorStop(0.9, '#ea580c');
  sunGrad.addColorStop(1, '#991b1b');
  ctx.fillStyle = sunGrad;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, sunR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Convective Granulation Cells (Boiling Solar Surface Noise)
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, sunR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.clip();
  for (let g = 0; g < 12; g++) {
    const gAngle = g * 1.8 + phase * 0.6;
    const gDist = (Math.sin(g * 2.3 + phase) * 0.45 + 0.45) * sunR * 0.85;
    const gx = cx + Math.cos(gAngle) * gDist;
    const gy = cy + Math.sin(gAngle) * gDist;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(gx, gy, sunR * 0.22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = g % 2 === 0 ? 'rgba(254, 240, 138, 0.35)' : 'rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.25)';
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();

  ctx.restore();
}

/**
 * S2. EARTH: Hyper-Realistic 3D Rotating Blue Marble with Parallax Weather Clouds
 */
function drawSpaceEarth(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  radius: number,
  phase: number,
  smoothEnergy: number
) {
  ctx.save();
  const earthR = radius * 0.72;

  // Luminous Rayleigh Scattering Atmospheric Ring
  const atmo = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, earthR * 0.85, cx, cy, earthR * 1.22);
  atmo.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.65)');
  atmo.addColorStop(0.4, 'rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.35)');
  atmo.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(2, 6, 23, 0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = atmo;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, earthR * 1.22, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Deep Azure Ocean Sphere with 3D Specular Curvature
  const ocean = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx - earthR * 0.3, cy - earthR * 0.35, 0, cx, cy, earthR);
  ocean.addColorStop(0, '#38bdf8');
  ocean.addColorStop(0.28, '#1d4ed8');
  ocean.addColorStop(0.7, '#1e3a8a');
  ocean.addColorStop(1, '#020617');
  ctx.fillStyle = ocean;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, earthR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Clip to Earth Disc for Rotating Continents & Weather Clouds
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, earthR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.clip();

  // 3D Rotating Continents (Africa, Europe, Americas, Asia, Australia)
  const earthRot = phase * 0.35;
  const continents = [
    // Africa & Sahara
    { lon: 0.2, lat: 0.05, rx: 0.38, ry: 0.52, color: '#10b981', desert: '#f59e0b' },
    // Europe & Mediterranean
    { lon: 0.25, lat: 0.55, rx: 0.3, ry: 0.22, color: '#059669' },
    // Asia & Himalayas
    { lon: 1.1, lat: 0.42, rx: 0.58, ry: 0.38, color: '#10b981', desert: '#d97706' },
    // Australia & Pacific Islands
    { lon: 1.8, lat: -0.38, rx: 0.26, ry: 0.22, color: '#d97706' },
    // North America
    { lon: -1.4, lat: 0.5, rx: 0.45, ry: 0.34, color: '#10b981' },
    // South America & Amazon Rainforest
    { lon: -0.9, lat: -0.22, rx: 0.32, ry: 0.48, color: '#059669' },
  ];

  for (const land of continents) {
    const curLon = (((land.lon + earthRot) % (Math.PI * 2)) + Math.PI * 2) % (Math.PI * 2) - Math.PI;
    if (Math.cos(curLon) > 0) {
      const cosLat = Math.cos(land.lat);
      const projX = cx + Math.sin(curLon) * cosLat * earthR;
      const projY = cy - Math.sin(land.lat) * earthR;
      const foreshortenX = Math.max(0.12, Math.cos(curLon));
      const radX = land.rx * earthR * foreshortenX;
      const radY = land.ry * earthR;

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(projX, projY, Math.max(1, radX), Math.max(1, radY), 0.15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = land.color;
      ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35)';
      ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
      ctx.fill();

      // Desert biome accent
      if (land.desert) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(
          projX,
          projY - radY * 0.2,
          Math.max(1, radX * 0.65),
          Math.max(1, radY * 0.4),
          0.1,
          0,
          Math.PI * 2
        );
        ctx.fillStyle = land.desert;
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }
  }

  // 3D Rotating Weather Clouds (Swirling Cyclones & Trade-Wind Bands with Parallax)
  const cloudRot = phase * 0.48; // moves slightly faster than ground
  for (let c = 0; c < 5; c++) {
    const cLonBase = c * 1.25 + cloudRot;
    const curLon = ((cLonBase % (Math.PI * 2)) + Math.PI * 2) % (Math.PI * 2) - Math.PI;
    if (Math.cos(curLon) > 0) {
      const cLat = Math.sin(c * 1.7) * 0.45;
      const projX = cx + Math.sin(curLon) * Math.cos(cLat) * earthR;
      const projY = cy - Math.sin(cLat) * earthR;
      const foreshortenX = Math.max(0.15, Math.cos(curLon));

      // Swirling Cloud Band
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(projX, projY, earthR * 0.42 * foreshortenX, earthR * 0.12, 0.25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78)';
      ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)';
      ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  // Atmospheric Day/Night Twilight Terminator Shadow
  const term = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx - earthR, cy, cx + earthR, cy);
  term.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
  term.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.1)');
  term.addColorStop(0.85, 'rgba(180, 83, 9, 0.22)'); // sunset twilight rim
  term.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.85)');
  ctx.fillStyle = term;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, earthR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.restore();
  ctx.restore();
}

/**
 * S3. MOON: True 3D Rotating Lunar Sphere with Foreshortened Craters & Maria
 */
function drawSpaceMoon(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  radius: number,
  phase: number,
  smoothEnergy: number
) {
  ctx.save();
  const moonR = radius * 0.72;

  // Luminous Silver-Blue Moonlight Halo
  const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, moonR * 0.75, cx, cy, moonR * 1.25);
  glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.45)');
  glow.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2)');
  glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = glow;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, moonR * 1.25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // 3D Spherical Shading Base
  const surface = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx - moonR * 0.35, cy - moonR * 0.35, 0, cx, cy, moonR);
  surface.addColorStop(0, '#f8fafc');
  surface.addColorStop(0.4, '#e2e8f0');
  surface.addColorStop(0.75, '#94a3b8');
  surface.addColorStop(1, '#334155');
  ctx.fillStyle = surface;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, moonR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Clip to lunar disc for rotating 3D surface features
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, moonR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.clip();

  // True 3D Rotating Lunar Maria & Impact Craters
  // As the moon rotates (rot = phase * 0.45), features orbit smoothly across the 3D sphere
  const rotAngle = phase * 0.45;
  const lunarFeatures = [
    // Maria (Dark volcanic basalt plains)
    { name: 'Mare Tranquillitatis', lon: 0.3, lat: 0.15, rx: 0.35, ry: 0.28, isMare: true },
    { name: 'Mare Serenitatis', lon: 0.2, lat: 0.45, rx: 0.32, ry: 0.26, isMare: true },
    { name: 'Mare Imbrium', lon: -0.4, lat: 0.5, rx: 0.42, ry: 0.36, isMare: true },
    { name: 'Oceanus Procellarum', lon: -0.8, lat: 0.1, rx: 0.5, ry: 0.44, isMare: true },
    { name: 'Mare Fecunditatis', lon: 0.7, lat: -0.1, rx: 0.28, ry: 0.25, isMare: true },
    { name: 'Mare Crisium', lon: 1.0, lat: 0.3, rx: 0.22, ry: 0.18, isMare: true },
    // Major Impact Craters (with specular illuminated rims)
    { name: 'Tycho', lon: -0.15, lat: -0.65, rx: 0.14, ry: 0.14, isMare: false },
    { name: 'Copernicus', lon: -0.35, lat: 0.2, rx: 0.12, ry: 0.12, isMare: false },
    { name: 'Kepler', lon: -0.65, lat: 0.18, rx: 0.09, ry: 0.09, isMare: false },
    { name: 'Aristarchus', lon: -0.75, lat: 0.4, rx: 0.08, ry: 0.08, isMare: false },
    { name: 'Plato', lon: -0.2, lat: 0.75, rx: 0.1, ry: 0.08, isMare: false },
  ];

  for (const f of lunarFeatures) {
    // Current orbital angle on the rotating sphere
    const curLon = (((f.lon + rotAngle) % (Math.PI * 2)) + Math.PI * 2) % (Math.PI * 2) - Math.PI;
    // Orthographic spherical projection: visible when facing the camera (cos(curLon) > 0)
    if (Math.cos(curLon) > 0) {
      const cosLat = Math.cos(f.lat);
      const projX = cx + Math.sin(curLon) * cosLat * moonR;
      const projY = cy - Math.sin(f.lat) * moonR;
      const foreshortenX = Math.max(0.12, Math.cos(curLon));
      const radX = f.rx * moonR * foreshortenX;
      const radY = f.ry * moonR;

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(projX, projY, Math.max(1, radX), Math.max(1, radY), 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      if (f.isMare) {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(71, 85, 105, 0.48)';
        ctx.fill();
      } else {
        // Crater bowl with dark floor & bright sunlit rim
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.72)';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
        ctx.stroke();

        // Tycho ray system if Tycho crater
        if (f.name === 'Tycho') {
          ctx.beginPath();
          for (let ray = 0; ray < 6; ray++) {
            const rayA = (ray * Math.PI) / 3 + curLon * 0.2;
            const rLen = moonR * 0.45;
            ctx.moveTo(projX, projY);
            ctx.lineTo(projX + Math.cos(rayA) * rLen * foreshortenX, projY + Math.sin(rayA) * rLen);
          }
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.22)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Soft Terminator Shadow (Day/Night Crescent on the right side)
  const term = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx - moonR, cy, cx + moonR, cy);
  term.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
  term.addColorStop(0.65, 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.2)');
  term.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.75)');
  ctx.fillStyle = term;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, moonR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.restore();
  ctx.restore();
}

/**
 * S4. MARS: Crimson Red Planet with Dusty Surface and Polar Ice Cap
 */
function drawSpaceMars(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  radius: number,
  phase: number,
  smoothEnergy: number
) {
  ctx.save();
  const marsR = radius * 0.72;

  // Rust-Orange Atmosphere Haze
  const haze = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, marsR * 0.8, cx, cy, marsR * 1.15);
  haze.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.35)');
  haze.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(234, 88, 12, 0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = haze;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, marsR * 1.15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Mars Red Surface
  const surface = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx - marsR * 0.25, cy - marsR * 0.25, 0, cx, cy, marsR);
  surface.addColorStop(0, '#f97316');
  surface.addColorStop(0.5, '#c2410c');
  surface.addColorStop(1, '#7c2d12');
  ctx.fillStyle = surface;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, marsR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Dark Canyon Surface Features
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(cx, cy + marsR * 0.1, marsR * 0.55, marsR * 0.15, 0.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(67, 20, 7, 0.45)';
  ctx.fill();

  // White Polar Ice Cap
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(cx, cy - marsR * 0.88, marsR * 0.28, marsR * 0.1, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.restore();
}

/**
 * S5. MILKY WAY: Deep Space Rotating Spiral Galaxy
 */
function drawSpaceMilkyway(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  radius: number,
  phase: number,
  smoothEnergy: number
) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';

  // Cosmic Dust Glow
  const dust = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, radius * 1.15);
  dust.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${(0.6 + smoothEnergy * 0.3).toFixed(3)})`);
  dust.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.4)');
  dust.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25)');
  dust.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(99, 102, 241, 0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = dust;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius * 1.15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  // 2 Majestic Logarithmic Spiral Galaxy Arms
  const galRot = phase * 0.8;
  const numArms = 2;
  const starsPerArm = 24;

  for (let a = 0; a < numArms; a++) {
    const armBase = galRot + a * Math.PI;
    for (let s = 1; s <= starsPerArm; s++) {
      const frac = s / starsPerArm;
      const angle = armBase + frac * Math.PI * 2.8;
      const dist = frac * radius * 0.95;
      const sx = cx + Math.cos(angle) * dist;
      const sy = cy + Math.sin(angle) * dist * 0.65; // tilted perspective!

      const starR = (1 - frac * 0.5) * (1.5 + Math.sin(phase * 3 + s) * 0.6);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(sx, sy, Math.max(1, starR), 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = frac < 0.3 ? '#ffffff' : frac < 0.7 ? '#c084fc' : '#38bdf8';
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  // Brilliant Galactic Center Core
  const coreR = radius * (0.2 + smoothEnergy * 0.12);
  const core = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, coreR);
  core.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
  core.addColorStop(0.5, '#fef08a');
  core.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(253, 224, 71, 0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = core;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, coreR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.restore();
}

/* ==========================================================================
 * THEME STYLE KIT AVATARS
 * ======================================================================== */

function drawBotanicalSakura(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  radius: number,
  phase: number,
  smoothEnergy: number
) {
  const aura = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, radius * 1.15);
  aura.addColorStop(0, `rgba(244, 114, 182, ${(0.32 + smoothEnergy * 0.25).toFixed(3)})`);
  aura.addColorStop(0.65, `rgba(251, 113, 133, ${(0.15 + smoothEnergy * 0.15).toFixed(3)})`);
  aura.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(244, 114, 182, 0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = aura;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius * 1.15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  const petalRadius = radius * (0.62 + smoothEnergy * 0.22);
  const rotation = phase * 0.45;

  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const angle = (i * (Math.PI * 2)) / 5 + rotation;
    const cosA = Math.cos(angle);
    const sinA = Math.sin(angle);
    const perpCos = -sinA;
    const perpSin = cosA;

    const tipDist = petalRadius;
    const halfWidth = petalRadius * 0.54;
    const tipX = cx + cosA * tipDist;
    const tipY = cy + sinA * tipDist;
    const notchIndent = petalRadius * 0.16;

    const leftX = cx + cosA * (tipDist * 0.92) - perpCos * halfWidth;
    const leftY = cy + sinA * (tipDist * 0.92) - perpSin * halfWidth;
    const rightX = cx + cosA * (tipDist * 0.92) + perpCos * halfWidth;
    const rightY = cy + sinA * (tipDist * 0.92) + perpSin * halfWidth;

    const notchCenterX = tipX - cosA * notchIndent;
    const notchCenterY = tipY - sinA * notchIndent;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);

    ctx.bezierCurveTo(
      cx + perpCos * (halfWidth * 0.3) + cosA * (tipDist * 0.35),
      cy + perpSin * (halfWidth * 0.3) + sinA * (tipDist * 0.35),
      leftX - cosA * (tipDist * 0.2),
      leftY - sinA * (tipDist * 0.2),
      leftX,
      leftY
    );

    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(tipX - perpCos * (halfWidth * 0.25), tipY - perpSin * (halfWidth * 0.25), notchCenterX, notchCenterY);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(tipX + perpCos * (halfWidth * 0.25), tipY + perpSin * (halfWidth * 0.25), rightX, rightY);

    ctx.bezierCurveTo(
      rightX - cosA * (tipDist * 0.2),
      rightY - sinA * (tipDist * 0.2),
      cx - perpCos * (halfWidth * 0.3) + cosA * (tipDist * 0.35),
      cy - perpSin * (halfWidth * 0.3) + sinA * (tipDist * 0.35),
      cx,
      cy
    );

    ctx.closePath();

    const petalGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, petalRadius * 0.15, tipX, tipY, petalRadius * 0.85);
    petalGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92)');
    petalGrad.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(253, 164, 175, 0.88)');
    petalGrad.addColorStop(0.78, 'rgba(244, 114, 182, 0.82)');
    petalGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(244, 63, 165, 0.95)');

    ctx.fillStyle = petalGrad;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // Golden Stamen filaments
  ctx.save();
  const stamenCount = 10;
  for (let s = 0; s < stamenCount; s++) {
    const sAngle = (s * (Math.PI * 2)) / stamenCount + rotation * 1.5;
    const sLen = petalRadius * (0.28 + Math.sin(phase * 2 + s) * 0.05);
    const sx = cx + Math.cos(sAngle) * sLen;
    const sy = cy + Math.sin(sAngle) * sLen;

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
    ctx.lineTo(sx, sy);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(254, 240, 138, 0.75)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx, sy, 1.8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fef08a';
    ctx.shadowColor = '#facc15';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
    ctx.fill();
  }

  const coreGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, petalRadius * 0.18);
  coreGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
  coreGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#f472b6');
  coreGrad.addColorStop(1, '#db2777');
  ctx.fillStyle = coreGrad;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, petalRadius * 0.18, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  // Orbiting Petal Flakes
  for (let p = 0; p < 4; p++) {
    const orbAngle = phase * 0.9 + (p * Math.PI) / 2;
    const orbDist = radius * (0.82 + Math.sin(phase * 1.5 + p) * 0.15);
    const px = cx + Math.cos(orbAngle) * orbDist;
    const py = cy + Math.sin(orbAngle) * orbDist;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(px, py);
    ctx.rotate(orbAngle + phase);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, radius * 0.14, radius * 0.07, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(251, 113, 133, 0.82)';
    ctx.shadowColor = '#fb7185';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function drawCyberpunkHud(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  radius: number,
  phase: number,
  smoothEnergy: number
) {
  const halo = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, radius * 0.2, cx, cy, radius * 1.1);
  halo.addColorStop(0, `rgba(6, 182, 212, ${(0.22 + smoothEnergy * 0.25).toFixed(3)})`);
  halo.addColorStop(0.7, `rgba(236, 72, 153, ${(0.12 + smoothEnergy * 0.15).toFixed(3)})`);
  halo.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = halo;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius * 1.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.save();
  const brkDist = radius * 0.88;
  const brkLen = radius * 0.32;
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#22d3ee';
  ctx.shadowColor = '#06b6d4';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;

  // 4 Corner Brackets
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx - brkDist, cy - brkDist + brkLen);
  ctx.lineTo(cx - brkDist, cy - brkDist);
  ctx.lineTo(cx - brkDist + brkLen, cy - brkDist);
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx + brkDist - brkLen, cy - brkDist);
  ctx.lineTo(cx + brkDist, cy - brkDist);
  ctx.lineTo(cx + brkDist, cy - brkDist + brkLen);
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx + brkDist, cy + brkDist - brkLen);
  ctx.lineTo(cx + brkDist, cy + brkDist);
  ctx.lineTo(cx + brkDist - brkLen, cy + brkDist);
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx - brkDist + brkLen, cy + brkDist);
  ctx.lineTo(cx - brkDist, cy + brkDist);
  ctx.lineTo(cx - brkDist, cy + brkDist - brkLen);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Segmented Ring
  const ringR = radius * 0.72;
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#06b6d4';
  for (let s = 0; s < 4; s++) {
    const startA = phase * 1.2 + (s * Math.PI) / 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, ringR, startA, startA + Math.PI * 0.32);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Inner Hexagon
  const hexR = radius * (0.42 + smoothEnergy * 0.16);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(cx, cy);
  ctx.rotate(-phase * 1.8);
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let h = 0; h < 6; h++) {
    const hAngle = (h * Math.PI * 2) / 6;
    const hx = Math.cos(hAngle) * hexR;
    const hy = Math.sin(hAngle) * hexR;
    if (h === 0) ctx.moveTo(hx, hy);
    else ctx.lineTo(hx, hy);
  }
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#ec4899';
  ctx.shadowColor = '#f43f5e';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();

  // Core & Crosshairs
  const coreR = radius * (0.2 + smoothEnergy * 0.22);
  const coreGlow = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, coreR);
  coreGlow.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
  coreGlow.addColorStop(0.4, '#22d3ee');
  coreGlow.addColorStop(0.8, '#ec4899');
  coreGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(236, 72, 153, 0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = coreGlow;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, coreR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  const crossLen = radius * (0.24 + smoothEnergy * 0.18);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#facc15';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx - crossLen, cy);
  ctx.lineTo(cx + crossLen, cy);
  ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - crossLen);
  ctx.lineTo(cx, cy + crossLen);
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawFluentFluid(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  radius: number,
  phase: number,
  smoothEnergy: number
) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';

  const waves = [
    { r: 56, g: 189, b: 248, speed: 1.1, freq: 2.2, amp: radius * (0.35 + smoothEnergy * 0.35), offset: 0 },
    { r: 99, g: 102, b: 241, speed: -0.95, freq: 3.1, amp: radius * (0.32 + smoothEnergy * 0.3), offset: 1.5 },
    { r: 34, g: 211, b: 238, speed: 1.4, freq: 1.8, amp: radius * (0.38 + smoothEnergy * 0.4), offset: 2.8 },
  ];

  for (const w of waves) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    const steps = 40;
    for (let s = 0; s <= steps; s++) {
      const u = (s / steps) * 2 - 1;
      const x = cx + u * radius * 0.95;
      const env = Math.cos((u * Math.PI) / 2);
      const y = cy + Math.sin(u * Math.PI * w.freq + phase * w.speed + w.offset) * w.amp * env;
      if (s === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.lineWidth = radius * 0.22 * (0.8 + smoothEnergy * 0.4);
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${w.r}, ${w.g}, ${w.b}, ${(0.42 + smoothEnergy * 0.35).toFixed(3)})`;
    ctx.shadowColor = `rgb(${w.r}, ${w.g}, ${w.b})`;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  const core = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, radius * (0.3 + smoothEnergy * 0.2));
  core.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${(0.65 + smoothEnergy * 0.3).toFixed(3)})`);
  core.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4)');
  core.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = core;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius * (0.3 + smoothEnergy * 0.2), 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawRetroCassette(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  radius: number,
  phase: number,
  smoothEnergy: number
) {
  ctx.save();
  const aura = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, radius * 1.1);
  aura.addColorStop(0, `rgba(245, 158, 11, ${(0.25 + smoothEnergy * 0.2).toFixed(3)})`);
  aura.addColorStop(0.7, `rgba(236, 72, 153, ${(0.15 + smoothEnergy * 0.15).toFixed(3)})`);
  aura.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = aura;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius * 1.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  const spoolOffset = radius * 0.42;
  const spoolR = radius * 0.28;

  for (const dir of [-1, 1]) {
    const sx = cx + dir * spoolOffset;
    const sy = cy;

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx, sy, spoolR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#f59e0b';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();

    for (let sp = 0; sp < 3; sp++) {
      const spAngle = dir * phase * 2.5 + (sp * Math.PI * 2) / 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);
      ctx.lineTo(sx + Math.cos(spAngle) * spoolR, sy + Math.sin(spAngle) * spoolR);
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#fbbf24';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx, sy, spoolR * 0.35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ec4899';
    ctx.fill();
  }

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx - spoolOffset, cy + spoolR * 0.85);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx, cy + spoolR * 0.85 + Math.sin(phase * 8) * 4 * smoothEnergy, cx + spoolOffset, cy + spoolR * 0.85);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#f43f5e';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;
  ctx.stroke();

  const vuSegments = 9;
  for (let v = 0; v < vuSegments; v++) {
    const vAngle = Math.PI + 0.35 + (v * (Math.PI - 0.7)) / (vuSegments - 1);
    const lit = v / vuSegments <= smoothEnergy * 1.25;
    const vR = radius * 0.88;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx + Math.cos(vAngle) * vR, cy + Math.sin(vAngle) * vR, 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = lit ? (v > 6 ? '#ef4444' : v > 3 ? '#fbbf24' : '#10b981') : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
    ctx.shadowColor = lit ? '#fbbf24' : 'transparent';
    ctx.shadowBlur = lit ? 6 : 0;
    ctx.fill();
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawPaperInkEnso(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  radius: number,
  phase: number,
  smoothEnergy: number
) {
  ctx.save();
  const ensoR = radius * 0.74;

  ctx.beginPath();
  const startAngle = -0.3 + Math.sin(phase * 0.5) * 0.1;
  const endAngle = Math.PI * 1.85 + Math.sin(phase * 0.6) * 0.12;
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, ensoR, startAngle, endAngle);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(28, 25, 23, 0.88)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 4 + smoothEnergy * 5;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.stroke();

  const inkWash = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, ensoR);
  inkWash.addColorStop(0, `rgba(220, 38, 38, ${(0.18 + smoothEnergy * 0.25).toFixed(3)})`);
  inkWash.addColorStop(0.65, 'rgba(68, 64, 60, 0.1)');
  inkWash.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = inkWash;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, ensoR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  const stampSize = radius * (0.28 + smoothEnergy * 0.1);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(cx, cy);
  ctx.rotate(0.08);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#dc2626';
  ctx.shadowColor = '#b91c1c';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
  ctx.fillRect(-stampSize / 2, -stampSize / 2, stampSize, stampSize);

  ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
  ctx.strokeRect(-stampSize * 0.38, -stampSize * 0.38, stampSize * 0.76, stampSize * 0.76);
  ctx.restore();

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawMotorsportGt(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  radius: number,
  phase: number,
  smoothEnergy: number
) {
  ctx.save();
  const gaugeR = radius * 0.8;
  const startA = Math.PI * 0.75;
  const endA = Math.PI * 2.25;

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, gaugeR, startA, endA);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, gaugeR, Math.PI * 1.85, endA);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#ef4444';
  ctx.shadowColor = '#dc2626';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
  ctx.lineWidth = 5;
  ctx.stroke();

  const needleAngle = startA + (endA - startA) * Math.min(1, Math.max(0, 0.15 + smoothEnergy * 0.85));
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
  ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(needleAngle) * (gaugeR - 2), cy + Math.sin(needleAngle) * (gaugeR - 2));
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#ef4444';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.shadowColor = '#f87171';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
  ctx.stroke();

  const hubR = radius * 0.32;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, hubR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#18181b';
  ctx.fill();

  for (let b = 0; b < 6; b++) {
    const bAngle = phase * 3 + (b * Math.PI * 2) / 6;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(bAngle) * hubR, cy + Math.sin(bAngle) * hubR);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#f97316';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawCozyWoodland(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  radius: number,
  phase: number,
  smoothEnergy: number
) {
  ctx.save();
  const aura = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, radius * 1.1);
  aura.addColorStop(0, `rgba(16, 185, 129, ${(0.28 + smoothEnergy * 0.25).toFixed(3)})`);
  aura.addColorStop(0.7, `rgba(245, 158, 11, ${(0.14 + smoothEnergy * 0.15).toFixed(3)})`);
  aura.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = aura;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius * 1.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  const leafR = radius * (0.65 + smoothEnergy * 0.15);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(cx, cy);
  ctx.rotate(Math.sin(phase * 0.8) * 0.2);

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, -leafR);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(leafR * 0.55, -leafR * 0.3, leafR * 0.45, leafR * 0.4);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, leafR * 0.8, 0, leafR * 0.85);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, leafR * 0.8, -leafR * 0.45, leafR * 0.4);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-leafR * 0.55, -leafR * 0.3, 0, -leafR);
  ctx.closePath();

  const leafGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -leafR, 0, leafR);
  leafGrad.addColorStop(0, '#34d399');
  leafGrad.addColorStop(0.6, '#10b981');
  leafGrad.addColorStop(1, '#f59e0b');
  ctx.fillStyle = leafGrad;
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, -leafR * 0.85);
  ctx.lineTo(0, leafR * 0.8);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();

  for (let f = 0; f < 5; f++) {
    const fAngle = phase * 1.2 + (f * Math.PI * 2) / 5;
    const fDist = radius * (0.75 + Math.sin(phase * 2 + f) * 0.18);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx + Math.cos(fAngle) * fDist, cy + Math.sin(fAngle) * fDist, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fde047';
    ctx.shadowColor = '#eab308';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
    ctx.fill();
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawCupertinoSilk(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  radius: number,
  phase: number,
  smoothEnergy: number
) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';

  for (let l = 0; l < 3; l++) {
    const lPhase = phase * 1.1 + (l * Math.PI * 2) / 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    const steps = 36;
    for (let s = 0; s <= steps; s++) {
      const theta = (s / steps) * Math.PI * 2;
      const rVal = radius * (0.52 + Math.sin(theta * 3 + lPhase) * 0.22 * (0.8 + smoothEnergy * 0.4));
      const x = cx + Math.cos(theta) * rVal;
      const y = cy + Math.sin(theta) * rVal;
      if (s === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.lineWidth = radius * 0.18;
    ctx.strokeStyle = l === 0 ? 'rgba(241, 245, 249, 0.65)' : l === 1 ? 'rgba(129, 140, 248, 0.55)' : 'rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.55)';
    ctx.shadowColor = '#818cf8';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawSiriRibbons(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  radius: number,
  phase: number,
  smoothEnergy: number,
  ribbons: RibbonLayerSpec[],
  orbColors: ReturnType<typeof resolveOrbThemeColors>,
  lowPowerEco: boolean,
  _dpr: number
) {
  const outerHalo = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, radius * 0.45, cx, cy, radius * 1.1);
  outerHalo.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)');
  outerHalo.addColorStop(0.75, `${orbColors.haloMid}${(0.22 + smoothEnergy * 0.22).toFixed(3)})`);
  outerHalo.addColorStop(1, orbColors.haloEnd);
  ctx.fillStyle = outerHalo;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius * 1.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';

  const steps = lowPowerEco ? 28 : 44;
  for (let i = 0; i < ribbons.length; i++) {
    const rib = ribbons[i];
    const tPhase = phase * rib.speed + rib.phaseOffset;
    const amp = radius * (0.28 + smoothEnergy * 0.34);

    const cosZ = Math.cos(rib.tiltZ + Math.sin(tPhase * 0.35) * 0.22);
    const sinZ = Math.sin(rib.tiltZ + Math.sin(tPhase * 0.35) * 0.22);
    const cosX = Math.cos(rib.tiltX + Math.cos(tPhase * 0.28) * 0.2);

    const pts: { x: number; y: number }[] = [];
    for (let s = 0; s <= steps; s++) {
      const u = (s / steps) * 2 - 1;
      const env = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - u * u));
      const rawX = u * radius * 0.96;
      const waveY =
        (Math.sin(u * Math.PI * rib.freq1 + tPhase) * 0.62 +
          Math.cos(u * Math.PI * rib.freq2 - tPhase * 1.25) * 0.38) *
        amp *
        env;

      const rx = rawX * cosZ - waveY * sinZ;
      const ry = (rawX * sinZ + waveY * cosZ) * cosX;
      pts.push({ x: cx + rx, y: cy + ry });
    }

    const baseThick = radius * rib.widthFactor * (0.8 + smoothEnergy * 0.35);
    const passes = lowPowerEco
      ? [
          { mult: 1.35, alpha: 0.16 },
          { mult: 0.55, alpha: 0.48 },
        ]
      : [
          { mult: 1.75, alpha: 0.1 },
          { mult: 1.05, alpha: 0.22 },
          { mult: 0.52, alpha: 0.44 },
          { mult: 0.2, alpha: 0.62 },
        ];

    for (const p of passes) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y);
      for (let k = 1; k < pts.length - 1; k++) {
        const xc = (pts[k].x + pts[k + 1].x) * 0.5;
        const yc = (pts[k].y + pts[k + 1].y) * 0.5;
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(pts[k].x, pts[k].y, xc, yc);
      }
      ctx.lineTo(pts[pts.length - 1].x, pts[pts.length - 1].y);
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, baseThick * p.mult);
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${rib.r}, ${rib.g}, ${rib.b}, ${p.alpha})`;
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  const coreRadius = radius * (0.44 + smoothEnergy * 0.22);
  const coreGlow = ctx.createRadialGradient(
    cx + Math.sin(phase * 1.3) * radius * 0.08,
    cy + Math.cos(phase * 1.1) * radius * 0.08,
    0,
    cx,
    cy,
    coreRadius
  );
  coreGlow.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${(0.42 + smoothEnergy * 0.38).toFixed(3)})`);
  coreGlow.addColorStop(0.38, orbColors.coreMid);
  coreGlow.addColorStop(1, orbColors.coreEnd);
  ctx.fillStyle = coreGlow;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, coreRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.restore();

  ctx.save();
  const specGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(
    cx - radius * 0.5,
    cy - radius * 0.92,
    cx + radius * 0.2,
    cy - radius * 0.15
  );
  specGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42)');
  specGrad.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)');
  specGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = specGrad;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(cx - radius * 0.14, cy - radius * 0.52, radius * 0.56, radius * 0.28, -0.24, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

/**
 * Master Astra AI Assistant 60fps Canvas2D Manifestations:
 * - 100% transparent backgrounds with ZERO black circles or bounding edges.
 * - Categorized packs: Naruto Jutsu, Motorsport & F1, Celestial Cosmos, Style Kits, and Apple Siri Orbs.
 */
export const AstraSiriOrbCanvas: React.FC<AstraSiriOrbCanvasProps> = ({
  state,
  audioLevel = 0,
  size = 48,
  lowPowerEco = false,
  style = 'siri_rainbow',
  className = '',
}) => {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
  const stateRef = useRef(state);
  stateRef.current = state;
  const audioRef = useRef(audioLevel);
  audioRef.current = audioLevel;
  const styleRef = useRef(style);
  styleRef.current = style;

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    const dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
    canvas.width = Math.round(size * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(size * dpr);

    let rafId = 0;
    let smoothEnergy = 0.25;
    let phase = 0;
    let lastTs = performance.now();

    const renderFrame = (now: number) => {
      const dt = Math.min(0.05, Math.max(0.004, (now - lastTs) / 1000));
      lastTs = now;

      const curState = stateRef.current;
      const curStyle = styleRef.current || 'siri_rainbow';
      const micLvl = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, audioRef.current));

      const targetEnergy =
        curState === 'listening'
          ? 0.48 + micLvl * 0.65
          : curState === 'speaking'
            ? 0.72 + Math.sin(now * 0.012) * 0.22
            : curState === 'thinking'
              ? 0.64
              : 0.28;

      smoothEnergy += (targetEnergy - smoothEnergy) * Math.min(1, dt * 8);

      const speedMult =
        curState === 'thinking'
          ? 2.15
          : curState === 'speaking'
            ? 1.75
            : curState === 'listening'
              ? 1.35 + micLvl * 1.1
              : 0.72;

      phase += dt * speedMult;

      const w = canvas.width;
      const h = canvas.height;
      const cx = w * 0.5;
      const cy = h * 0.5;
      const radius = Math.min(w, h) * 0.46;

      // 100% TRANSPARENT CANVAS CLEAR
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

      switch (curStyle) {
        // Naruto Shinobi & Jutsu
        case 'naruto_rasengan':
          drawNarutoRasengan(ctx, cx, cy, radius, phase, smoothEnergy);
          break;

        case 'cozy_woodland':
          drawCozyWoodland(ctx, cx, cy, radius, phase, smoothEnergy);
          break;
        case 'cupertino_silk':
          drawCupertinoSilk(ctx, cx, cy, radius, phase, smoothEnergy);
          break;

        // Classic Apple Siri Shaders
        default: {
          const ribbons = resolveRibbonSpecs(curStyle);
          const orbColors = resolveOrbThemeColors(curStyle);
          drawSiriRibbons(ctx, cx, cy, radius, phase, smoothEnergy, ribbons, orbColors, lowPowerEco, dpr);
          break;
        }
      }

      if (!lowPowerEco || curState !== 'idle') {
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(renderFrame);
      }
    };

    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(renderFrame);
    return () => {
      if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
    };
  }, [size, lowPowerEco, style]);

  return (
    <canvas
      ref={canvasRef}
      style={{ width: `${size}px`, height: `${size}px` }}
      aria-hidden="true"
      className={`block shrink-0 select-none pointer-events-none bg-transparent ${className}`}
    />
  );
};

interface ControlCenterPanelProps {

  onChangeVolume: (val: number) => void;
  brightnessLevel: number;

  onToggleKeepAwake: () => void;
  micMuted: boolean;
  onToggleMicMuted: () => void;

  onToggleNightLight: () => void;
  onTriggerToast: (msg: string) => void;

  onUpdatePreferences: (patch: Partial<PillPreferences>) => void;

const AUDIO_OUTPUT_LIST: AudioOutputDevice[] = [

const LAYOUT_LABELS: Record<ControlCenterLayoutMode, string> = {

  circular_orbs: 'Circular Orbs',
  win11_split: 'Win11 Split',
  bento_mixed: 'Mixed Vert+Horiz',
  vertical_pillars: 'Vertical Blocks',
  horizontal_strips: 'Horizontal Strips',
  inline_pills: 'Inline Pills',
  minimal_grid: 'Minimal Grid',

export const ControlCenterPanel: React.FC<ControlCenterPanelProps> = ({
  systemState,
  onUpdateSystemState,
  volumeLevel,
  onChangeVolume,
  brightnessLevel,
  onChangeBrightness,
  audioDevice,
  onChangeAudioDevice,
  keepAwake,
  onToggleKeepAwake,
  micMuted,
  onToggleMicMuted,
  nightLight,
  onToggleNightLight,
  onTriggerToast,
  preferences,
  onUpdatePreferences,
}) => {
  const [submenu, setSubmenu] = useState<ControlSubmenuView>('none');
  const [pageIndex, setPageIndex] = useState(0);
  const [btDevices, setBtDevices] = useState<BluetoothDeviceEntry[]>(INITIAL_BLUETOOTH_DEVICES);
  const [playgroundMode, setPlaygroundMode] = useState(false);
  const [draggedTileId, setDraggedTileId] = useState<ControlTileId | null>(null);

  const palette = resolveThemePalette(
    preferences.themeId,
    preferences.customPrimaryHex,
    preferences.customSecondaryHex
  );
  const isLight = Boolean(palette.isLightSurface);
  const iconMetrics = resolveIconPackMetrics(preferences.iconPack);
  const pillMetrics = resolveInnerPillMetrics(
    preferences.innerPillScale,
    preferences.innerCapsuleRadius
  );

  const isCompactTileMode =
    preferences.controlLayoutMode === 'squarish_blocks' ||
    preferences.controlLayoutMode === 'circular_orbs';

  const effectiveCols: 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 = isCompactTileMode
    ? 6
    : preferences.controlLayoutMode === 'bento_mixed' ||
        preferences.controlLayoutMode === 'horizontal_strips'
      ? 3
      : preferences.controlGridColumns;

  const pages = paginateControlTiles(preferences.controlTiles, effectiveCols, 2);
  const safePage = Math.min(pageIndex, Math.max(0, pages.length - 1));
  const currentTiles = pages[safePage] ?? [];

  const handleHoverSwapTile = (targetId: ControlTileId) => {
    if (!draggedTileId || draggedTileId === targetId) return;
    const list = [...preferences.controlTiles];
    const fromIdx = list.indexOf(draggedTileId);
    const toIdx = list.indexOf(targetId);
    if (fromIdx === -1 || toIdx === -1) return;
    list.splice(fromIdx, 1);
    list.splice(toIdx, 0, draggedTileId);
    onUpdatePreferences({ controlTiles: list });
    playTactilePop('tab');
  };

  const handleDropReorderTile = (targetId: ControlTileId) => {
    if (draggedTileId && draggedTileId !== targetId) {
      handleHoverSwapTile(targetId);
    }
    setDraggedTileId(null);
  };

  const toggleTileSpan = (id: ControlTileId) => {
    const current = preferences.controlTileSizes?.[id] ?? '1x1';
    const next = current === '1x1' ? '2x1' : '1x1';
    onUpdatePreferences({
      controlTileSizes: { ...(preferences.controlTileSizes ?? {}), [id]: next },
    });
    playTactilePop('tab');
  };

  const isTileActive = (id: ControlTileId): boolean => {
    switch (id) {
      case 'wifi':
        return systemState.wifiEnabled && !systemState.airplaneMode;
      case 'bluetooth':
        return systemState.bluetoothEnabled && !systemState.airplaneMode;
      case 'airplane':
        return systemState.airplaneMode;
      case 'accessibility':
        return (
          systemState.liveCaptions ||
          systemState.accessibilityMonoAudio ||
          systemState.accessibilityStickyKeys ||
          systemState.accessibilityColorFilter
        );
      case 'saver':
        return systemState.batterySaver;
      case 'captions':
        return systemState.liveCaptions;
      case 'nightlight':
        return nightLight;
      case 'hotspot':
        return systemState.hotspotEnabled;
      case 'nearby':
        return systemState.nearbyShare !== 'off';
      case 'cast':
        return Boolean(systemState.castDevice);
      case 'project':
        return systemState.projectMode !== 'pc_only';
      case 'dnd':
        return systemState.dndEnabled;
      case 'spatial':
        return systemState.spatialAudio;
      case 'mic':
        return micMuted;
      case 'awake':
        return keepAwake;
      case 'snip':
        return false;
    }
  };

  const getTileCaption = (id: ControlTileId): string => {
    switch (id) {
      case 'wifi':
        return systemState.wifiEnabled && !systemState.airplaneMode
          ? systemState.wifiSsid
          : 'Wi-Fi Off';
      case 'bluetooth':
        if (!systemState.bluetoothEnabled || systemState.airplaneMode) return 'Bluetooth Off';
        return systemState.bluetoothDevice || 'Not connected';
      case 'airplane':
        return systemState.airplaneMode ? 'Radios Off' : 'Off';
      case 'accessibility':
        return systemState.liveCaptions || systemState.accessibilityColorFilter ? 'Active' : 'Menu';
      case 'saver':
        return systemState.batterySaver ? 'Saving power' : 'Balanced';
      case 'captions':
        return systemState.liveCaptions ? 'Captions On' : 'Off';
      case 'nightlight':
        return nightLight ? 'Warm 3400K' : 'Off';
      case 'hotspot':
        return systemState.hotspotEnabled ? 'Sharing 5GHz' : 'Off';
      case 'nearby':
        return systemState.nearbyShare === 'everyone'
          ? 'Everyone'
          : systemState.nearbyShare === 'my_devices'
            ? 'My devices'
            : 'Off';
      case 'cast':
        return systemState.castDevice ? systemState.castDevice.split(' ')[0] : 'Displays';
      case 'project':
        return systemState.projectMode === 'extend'
          ? 'Extend'
          : systemState.projectMode === 'duplicate'
            ? 'Duplicate'
            : 'PC only';
      case 'dnd':
        return systemState.dndEnabled ? 'Quiet On' : 'Off';
      case 'spatial':
        return systemState.spatialAudio ? 'Dolby 3D' : 'Stereo';
      case 'mic':
        return micMuted ? 'Muted' : 'Live';
      case 'awake':
        return keepAwake ? 'Awake On' : 'Auto sleep';
      case 'snip':
        return 'Win+Shift+S';
    }
  };

  const handleTileToggle = (id: ControlTileId) => {
    if (id === 'accessibility' && preferences.featureFlags.controlSubmenuChevrons) {
      playTactilePop('tab');
      setSubmenu('accessibility');
      return;
    }
    if (id === 'cast' && preferences.featureFlags.controlSubmenuChevrons) {
      playTactilePop('tab');
      setSubmenu('cast');
      return;
    }
    if (id === 'project' && preferences.featureFlags.controlSubmenuChevrons) {
      playTactilePop('tab');
      setSubmenu('project');
      return;
    }

    const nextActive = !isTileActive(id);
    playTactilePop(nextActive ? 'toggleOn' : 'toggleOff');

    switch (id) {
      case 'wifi':
        onUpdateSystemState({ wifiEnabled: !systemState.wifiEnabled, airplaneMode: false });
        break;
      case 'bluetooth':
        onUpdateSystemState({ bluetoothEnabled: !systemState.bluetoothEnabled });
        break;
      case 'airplane':
        onUpdateSystemState({
          airplaneMode: !systemState.airplaneMode,
          wifiEnabled: systemState.airplaneMode,
        });
        break;
      case 'accessibility':
        onUpdateSystemState({ liveCaptions: !systemState.liveCaptions });
        break;
      case 'saver':
        onUpdateSystemState({
          batterySaver: !systemState.batterySaver,
          powerMode: !systemState.batterySaver ? 'efficiency' : 'balanced',
        });
        break;
      case 'captions':
        onUpdateSystemState({ liveCaptions: !systemState.liveCaptions });
        break;
      case 'nightlight':
        onToggleNightLight();
        break;
      case 'hotspot':
        onUpdateSystemState({ hotspotEnabled: !systemState.hotspotEnabled });
        break;
      case 'nearby':
        onUpdateSystemState({
          nearbyShare:
            systemState.nearbyShare === 'off'
              ? 'my_devices'
              : systemState.nearbyShare === 'my_devices'
                ? 'everyone'
                : 'off',
        });
        break;
      case 'cast':
        onUpdateSystemState({
          castDevice: systemState.castDevice ? null : AVAILABLE_CAST_DISPLAYS[0].name,
        });
        break;
      case 'project':
        onUpdateSystemState({
          projectMode: systemState.projectMode === 'extend' ? 'pc_only' : 'extend',
        });
        break;
      case 'dnd':
        onUpdateSystemState({ dndEnabled: !systemState.dndEnabled });
        break;
      case 'spatial':
        onUpdateSystemState({ spatialAudio: !systemState.spatialAudio });
        break;
      case 'mic':
        onToggleMicMuted();
        break;
      case 'awake':
        onToggleKeepAwake();
        break;
      case 'snip':
        onTriggerToast('Windows Rectangular Snipping Overlay launched');
        break;
    }
  };

  const openTileSubmenu = (id: ControlTileId) => {
    playTactilePop('tab');
    if (id === 'wifi') setSubmenu('wifi');
    else if (id === 'bluetooth') setSubmenu('bluetooth');
    else if (id === 'accessibility') setSubmenu('accessibility');
    else if (id === 'cast') setSubmenu('cast');
    else if (id === 'project') setSubmenu('project');
  };

  const toggleIncludeTile = (id: ControlTileId) => {
    const exists = preferences.controlTiles.includes(id);
    const updated = exists
      ? preferences.controlTiles.filter((t) => t !== id)
      : [...preferences.controlTiles, id];
    if (updated.length > 0) {
      onUpdatePreferences({ controlTiles: updated });
    }
  };

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------------
   * DRILL-DOWN SUBMENUS (`>` Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Accessibility, Cast, Project, Sound Mixer)
   * ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  if (submenu !== 'none') {
    const subCardClass = (active: boolean) =>
      isLight
        ? active
          ? 'bg-stone-900/[0.08] border-stone-900/25 text-stone-900'
          : 'bg-stone-900/[0.03] hover:bg-stone-900/[0.06] border-stone-900/10 text-stone-800'
        : active
          ? 'bg-white/[0.09] border-white/25 text-white'
          : 'bg-white/[0.03] hover:bg-white/[0.07] border-white/[0.07] text-slate-200';

    const subBtnClass = (active: boolean) =>
      active
        ? palette.onPrimaryTextClass
        : isLight
          ? 'bg-stone-900/10 hover:bg-stone-900/15 text-stone-800'
          : 'bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/18 text-slate-200';

    const subMutedText = isLight ? 'text-stone-500' : 'text-slate-400';
    const subToggleOff = isLight ? 'bg-stone-900/10 text-stone-700' : 'bg-white/10 text-slate-300';

    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col justify-between h-full gap-2">
        <div
          className={`flex items-center justify-between pb-1.5 border-b ${
            isLight ? 'border-stone-900/15' : 'border-white/10'
          }`}
        >
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              playTactilePop('tab');
              setSubmenu('none');
            }}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>
              {submenu === 'wifi'
                ? 'Wi-Fi Networks'
                : submenu === 'bluetooth'
                  ? 'Bluetooth Devices'
                  : submenu === 'accessibility'
                    ? 'Accessibility Quick Controls'
                    : submenu === 'cast'
                      ? 'Cast to Wireless Display'
                      : submenu === 'project'
                        ? 'Project Screen Mode (Win+P)'
                        : 'Sound Output & Per-App Volume Mixer'}
            </span>
          </button>

          {(submenu === 'wifi' || submenu === 'bluetooth') && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                playTactilePop('toggleOn');
                if (submenu === 'wifi') {
                  onUpdateSystemState({
                    wifiEnabled: !systemState.wifiEnabled,
                    airplaneMode: false,
                  });
                } else {
                  onUpdateSystemState({ bluetoothEnabled: !systemState.bluetoothEnabled });
                }
              }}
              style={
                (submenu === 'wifi' ? systemState.wifiEnabled : systemState.bluetoothEnabled)
                  ? { backgroundColor: palette.primaryHex }
                  : undefined
              }
              className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors ${
                (submenu === 'wifi' ? systemState.wifiEnabled : systemState.bluetoothEnabled)
                  ? palette.onPrimaryTextClass
                  : subToggleOff
              }`}
            >
              {(submenu === 'wifi' ? systemState.wifiEnabled : systemState.bluetoothEnabled)
                ? 'On'
                : 'Off'}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {submenu === 'wifi' && (
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto pill-scroll space-y-1.5 pr-1">
            {AVAILABLE_WIFI_NETWORKS.map((net) => {
              const connected = systemState.wifiEnabled && systemState.wifiSsid === net.ssid;
              return (
                <div
                  key={net.ssid}
                  className={`flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border transition-colors ${subCardClass(
                    connected
                  )}`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
                    <Wifi
                      className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0"
                      style={{ color: connected ? palette.primaryHex : '#94a3b8' }}
                    />
                    <div className="min-w-0">

                        {net.secured && <Lock className={`w-2.5 h-2.5 ${subMutedText}`} />}
                      </div>
                      <div className={`text-[10px] ${subMutedText} font-mono tabular-nums`}>
                        {connected ? 'Connected, secured' : 'Available'} Â· {net.band} Â·{' '}
                        {net.signalPct}%
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      playTactilePop('confirm');
                      onUpdateSystemState({
                        wifiEnabled: true,

                        wifiSsid: net.ssid,
                      });
                      onTriggerToast(`Connected to ${net.ssid}`);
                    }}
                    style={connected ? { backgroundColor: palette.primaryHex } : undefined}
                    className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap ${subBtnClass(
                      connected
                    )}`}
                  >
                    {connected ? 'Connected' : 'Connect'}
                  </button>
                </div>

            })}
          </div>

        {submenu === 'bluetooth' && (
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto pill-scroll space-y-1.5 pr-1">
            {btDevices.map((dev) => (
              <div
                key={dev.name}
                className={`flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border transition-colors ${subCardClass(
                  dev.connected && systemState.bluetoothEnabled
                )}`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
                  <Bluetooth
                    className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0"
                    style={{
                      color:
                        dev.connected && systemState.bluetoothEnabled
                          ? palette.primaryHex
                          : '#94a3b8',
                    }}
                  />
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <div className="text-xs font-semibold truncate">{dev.name}</div>
                    <div className={`text-[10px] ${subMutedText} font-mono tabular-nums`}>
                      {dev.category}
                      {dev.batteryPct !== undefined ? ` Â· Battery ${dev.batteryPct}%` : ''}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"

                      bluetoothEnabled: true,
