import React, { useEffect, useId, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { Check, ChevronDown } from 'lucide-react';
import { playTactilePop } from '../utils/audioSynth';

export interface PopdownOption<T extends string = string> {
  value: T;
  label: string;
  sublabel?: string;
  badge?: string;
}

interface CustomPopdownProps<T extends string = string> {
  value: T;
  options: PopdownOption<T>[];
  onChange: (nextValue: T) => void;
  ariaLabel: string;
  prefixIcon?: React.ReactNode;
  accentHex?: string;
  size?: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md';
  disabled?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  align?: 'left' | 'right';
  isLightSurface?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export function CustomPopdown<T extends string = string>({
  value,
  options,
  onChange,
  ariaLabel,
  prefixIcon,
  accentHex = '#22d3ee',
  size = 'sm',
  disabled = false,
  fullWidth = false,
  align = 'left',
  isLightSurface = false,
  className = '',
}: CustomPopdownProps<T>) {
  const listboxId = useId();
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);
  const menuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState<number>(() =>
    Math.max(
      0,
      options.findIndex((o) => o.value === value)
    )
  );
  const [coords, setCoords] = useState<{
    top: number;
    left: number;
    minWidth: number;
    openUpward: boolean;
  }>({ top: 0, left: 0, minWidth: 160, openUpward: false });

  const selectedOption = options.find((o) => o.value === value) ?? options[0];

  const updateMenuPosition = () => {
    const el = triggerRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const estimatedHeight = Math.min(264, options.length * 36 + 14);
    const spaceBelow = window.innerHeight - rect.bottom;
    const openUpward = spaceBelow < estimatedHeight + 12 && rect.top > estimatedHeight;
    const menuWidth = Math.max(rect.width, size === 'xs' ? 158 : 190);

    let left = align === 'right' ? rect.right - menuWidth : rect.left;
    left = Math.max(8, Math.min(left, window.innerWidth - menuWidth - 8));

    const top = openUpward ? rect.top - 6 : rect.bottom + 6;
    setCoords({
      top,
      left,
      minWidth: menuWidth,
      openUpward,
    });
  };

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    updateMenuPosition();
  }, [open, options.length, align, size]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;

    const handlePointerDown = (ev: MouseEvent) => {
      const target = ev.target as Node | null;
      if (
        target &&
        !triggerRef.current?.contains(target) &&
        !menuRef.current?.contains(target)
      ) {
        setOpen(false);
      }
    };

    const handleScrollOrResize = () => updateMenuPosition();

    window.addEventListener('mousedown', handlePointerDown);
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleScrollOrResize);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScrollOrResize, true);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousedown', handlePointerDown);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', handleScrollOrResize);
      window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScrollOrResize, true);
    };
  }, [open]);

  const handleSelect = (val: T) => {
    playTactilePop('tab');
    onChange(val);
    setOpen(false);
    triggerRef.current?.focus();
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (disabled) return;
    if (!open) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
        e.preventDefault();
        setActiveIndex(
          Math.max(
            0,
            options.findIndex((o) => o.value === value)
          )
        );
        setOpen(true);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      setOpen(false);
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setActiveIndex((prev) => (prev + 1) % options.length);
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setActiveIndex((prev) => (prev - 1 + options.length) % options.length);
      return;
    }
    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
      e.preventDefault();
      const chosen = options[activeIndex];
      if (chosen) handleSelect(chosen.value);
    }
  };

  const sizeCls =
    size === 'xs'
      ? 'px-2 py-0.5 text-[10.5px] rounded-lg gap-1'
      : size === 'sm'
        ? 'px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] rounded-xl gap-1.5'
        : 'px-3 py-2 text-xs rounded-xl gap-2';

  const triggerSurfaceCls = isLightSurface
    ? 'bg-stone-900/[0.06] hover:bg-stone-900/[0.11] border-stone-900/18 text-stone-900'
    : 'bg-white/[0.06] hover:bg-white/[0.12] border-white/14 text-slate-100 shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.08)]';

  return (
    <>
      <button
        ref={triggerRef}
        type="button"
        disabled={disabled}
        aria-label={ariaLabel}
        aria-haspopup="listbox"
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-controls={open ? listboxId : undefined}
        onClick={(e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (disabled) return;
          playTactilePop('tab');
          setActiveIndex(
            Math.max(
              0,
              options.findIndex((o) => o.value === value)
            )
          );
          setOpen((prev) => !prev);
        }}
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        style={
          open
            ? {
                borderColor: `${accentHex}99`,
                boxShadow: `0 0 0 1px ${accentHex}33`,
              }
            : undefined
        }
        className={`inline-flex items-center justify-between border font-medium transition-all select-none disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-400 ${sizeCls} ${triggerSurfaceCls} ${
          fullWidth ? 'w-full' : ''
        } ${className}`}
      >
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0 truncate">
          {prefixIcon && <span className="shrink-0 opacity-80">{prefixIcon}</span>}
          <span className="truncate">{selectedOption?.label ?? value}</span>
        </span>
        <ChevronDown
          className={`w-3 h-3 shrink-0 opacity-70 transition-transform duration-150 ${
            open ? 'rotate-180 opacity-100' : ''
          }`}
        />
      </button>

      {open &&
        typeof document !== 'undefined' &&
        createPortal(
          <div
            ref={menuRef}
            id={listboxId}
            role="listbox"
            aria-label={ariaLabel}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            style={{
              position: 'fixed',
              top: `${coords.top}px`,
              left: `${coords.left}px`,
              minWidth: `${coords.minWidth}px`,
              transform: coords.openUpward ? 'translateY(-100%)' : undefined,
            }}
            className="z-[120] max-h-64 overflow-y-auto pill-scroll rounded-2xl p-1.5 bg-[#0b0f19]/95 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/16 shadow-[0_22px_50px_rgba(0,0,0,0.72),inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.14)] text-slate-100"
          >
            {options.map((opt, idx) => {
              const isSelected = opt.value === value;
              const isHighlighted = idx === activeIndex;
              return (
                <button
                  key={opt.value}
                  type="button"
                  role="option"
                  aria-selected={isSelected}
                  onMouseEnter={() => setActiveIndex(idx)}
                  onClick={() => handleSelect(opt.value)}
                  style={
                    isSelected
                      ? {
                          backgroundColor: `${accentHex}24`,
                        }
                      : undefined
                  }
                  className={`w-full flex items-center justify-between gap-2.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-left transition-colors ${
                    isSelected
                      ? 'text-white font-semibold'
                      : isHighlighted
                        ? 'bg-white/[0.09] text-white'
                        : 'text-slate-300 hover:bg-white/[0.07] hover:text-white'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <div className="text-[11.5px] leading-snug truncate flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <span className="truncate">{opt.label}</span>
                      {opt.badge && (
                        <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-white/10 text-[9.5px] font-mono text-slate-300 shrink-0">
                          {opt.badge}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    {opt.sublabel && (
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 truncate">{opt.sublabel}</div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <span className="w-3.5 h-3.5 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                    {isSelected && (
                      <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" style={{ color: accentHex }} />
                    )}
                  </span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>,
          document.body
        )}
    </>
  );
}

                  onOpenFullSettings();
                }}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/16 text-white border border-white/15 transition-all shadow-sm focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-400 whitespace-nowrap"
              >
                <Settings className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Pill Settings</span>
              </button>

                    playTactilePop('confirm');
                    onDownloadWinUIZip();
                  }}
                  style={{ backgroundColor: palette.primaryHex }}
                  className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl transition-all shadow-sm focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-400 whitespace-nowrap ${palette.onPrimaryTextClass}`}
                >
                  <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Download Pill Native (.zip)</span>
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </>
  );
};

=== FILE: src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx ===
import React, { Component, ErrorInfo, ReactNode } from 'react';

interface Props {
  children: ReactNode;
  fallbackTitle?: string;
  onReset?: () => void;
}

interface State {
  hasError: boolean;
  errorMessage: string;
}

export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {
  public state: State = {
    hasError: false,
    errorMessage: '',
  };

  public static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): State {
    return { hasError: true, errorMessage: error?.message || 'Unknown error occurred' };
  }

  public componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
    console.error('ErrorBoundary caught:', error, errorInfo);
  }

  public render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return (
        <div className="w-full h-full min-h-screen bg-[#090b10] text-slate-100 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-8 select-none">
          <div className="max-w-md w-full bg-[#121620] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl text-center space-y-4">
            <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-400 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto text-xl font-bold">
              !
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-white">
              {this.props.fallbackTitle || 'Settings Encountered a Problem'}
            </h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 leading-relaxed font-mono bg-black/30 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-white/5 break-words">
              {this.state.errorMessage}
            </p>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 pt-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  this.setState({ hasError: false, errorMessage: '' });
                  this.props.onReset?.();
                }}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-sky-500 hover:bg-sky-400 text-slate-950 font-semibold text-xs transition-colors"
              >
                Reload &amp; Recover
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }
    return this.props.children;
  }
}

=== FILE: src/components/FluidEffectSlider.tsx ===
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { ControlSliderOrientation, SliderVisualStyle } from '../utils/themeAndSliders';

interface FluidEffectSliderProps {
  value: number;
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  onChange: (nextValue: number) => void;
  styleVariant: SliderVisualStyle;
  primaryHex: string;
  secondaryHex?: string;
  /** Enables continuous 60fps wave/bar animation (e.g. while music is playing or previewing) */
  animateWave?: boolean;
  glowIntensity?: number;
  ariaLabel: string;
  formatTooltip?: (val: number) => string;
  lowPowerEco?: boolean;
  orientation?: ControlSliderOrientation;
  isLightSurface?: boolean;
}

function hexToRgba(hex: string, alpha: number): string {
  const clean = (hex || '#22d3ee').replace('#', '');
  const full =
    clean.length === 3
      ? `${clean[0]}${clean[0]}${clean[1]}${clean[1]}${clean[2]}${clean[2]}`
      : clean.padEnd(6, '0');
  const num = parseInt(full.slice(0, 6), 16);
  const r = (num >> 16) & 255;
  const g = (num >> 8) & 255;
  const b = num & 255;
  return `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, ${alpha.toFixed(3)})`;
}

/**
 * Universal high-craft slider supporting 11 themed visualizers (Liquid Silk Ribbon, Harmonic Bars,
 * Cyberpunk Laser, Retro 16-LED Cassette VU, Motorsport GT RPM Redline, Paper Fountain-Ink Stroke,
 * Botanical Petal Wave, Win11 Cyan, iOS Capsule, Aurora Meniscus, Minimal Hairline) plus both
 * Horizontal and Vertical orientations.
 */
export const FluidEffectSlider: React.FC<FluidEffectSliderProps> = ({
  value,
  min = 0,
  max = 100,
  onChange,
  styleVariant,
  primaryHex,
  secondaryHex = '#a855f7',
  animateWave = false,
  glowIntensity = 0.8,
  ariaLabel,
  formatTooltip,
  lowPowerEco = false,
  orientation = 'horizontal',
  isLightSurface = false,
}) => {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
  const [isHovered, setIsHovered] = useState(false);
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
  const [hoverRatio, setHoverRatio] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const safeSpan = Math.max(0.0001, max - min);
  const clampedRatio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (value - min) / safeSpan));
  const isVertical = orientation === 'vertical';

  const stateRef = useRef({
    ratio: clampedRatio,
    primaryHex,
    secondaryHex,
    animate: animateWave || isDragging,
    hovered: isHovered || isDragging,
    styleVariant,
    glowIntensity,
    lowPowerEco,
    isLightSurface,
  });
  stateRef.current = {
    ratio: clampedRatio,
    primaryHex,
    secondaryHex,
    animate: animateWave || isDragging,
    hovered: isHovered || isDragging,
    styleVariant,
    glowIntensity,
    lowPowerEco,
    isLightSurface,
  };

  const isCanvasMode =
    !isVertical &&
    (styleVariant === 'fused_liquid_ribbon' ||
      styleVariant === 'fused_harmonic_bars' ||
      styleVariant === 'botanical_petal_wave');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isCanvasMode) return;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    let rafId = 0;
    let phase = Math.random() * 8;
    let smoothAmp = animateWave ? 1 : 0.35;
    let lastTs = performance.now();

    const renderFrame = (now: number) => {
      const dt = Math.min(0.05, Math.max(0.001, (now - lastTs) / 1000));
      lastTs = now;

      const st = stateRef.current;
      const targetAmp = st.animate ? (st.lowPowerEco ? 0.55 : 1.0) : 0.32;
      smoothAmp += (targetAmp - smoothAmp) * Math.min(1, dt * 8);
      if (st.animate) {
        phase += dt * (st.lowPowerEco ? 2.0 : 3.4);
      }

      const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
      const cssW = canvas.clientWidth || 220;
      const cssH = canvas.clientHeight || 24;
      const targetW = Math.round(cssW * dpr);
      const targetH = Math.round(cssH * dpr);
      if (canvas.width !== targetW || canvas.height !== targetH) {
        canvas.width = targetW;
        canvas.height = targetH;
      }

      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, cssW, cssH);

      const midY = cssH / 2;
      const padX = 7;
      const usableW = Math.max(12, cssW - padX * 2);
      const headX = padX + usableW * st.ratio;
      const railColor = st.isLightSurface
        ? 'rgba(28, 25, 23, 0.16)'
        : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14)';

      if (st.styleVariant === 'fused_liquid_ribbon' || st.styleVariant === 'botanical_petal_wave') {
        const isPetal = st.styleVariant === 'botanical_petal_wave';
        ctx.fillStyle = railColor;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(
          Math.max(padX, headX - 1),
          midY - 2,
          Math.max(2, padX + usableW - headX + 1),
          4,
          99
        );
        ctx.fill();

        const spineGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(padX, 0, Math.max(padX + 8, headX), 0);
        spineGrad.addColorStop(0, hexToRgba(st.secondaryHex, 0.65));
        spineGrad.addColorStop(0.75, hexToRgba(st.primaryHex, 0.9));
        spineGrad.addColorStop(1, st.isLightSurface ? st.primaryHex : '#ffffff');
        ctx.fillStyle = spineGrad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(padX, midY - 1.75, Math.max(3, headX - padX), 3.5, 99);
        ctx.fill();

        const playedLen = headX - padX;
        if (playedLen > 8) {
          const ribbons = isPetal
            ? [
                { color: st.secondaryHex, freq: 0.09, speed: 1.1, amp: 0.38, alpha: 0.48 },
                { color: st.primaryHex, freq: 0.065, speed: -1.5, amp: 0.44, alpha: 0.58 },
              ]
            : [
                { color: st.secondaryHex, freq: 0.065, speed: 1.4, amp: 0.42, alpha: 0.42 },
                { color: st.primaryHex, freq: 0.05, speed: -1.9, amp: 0.36, alpha: 0.52 },
                { color: '#e2e8f0', freq: 0.082, speed: 2.3, amp: 0.22, alpha: 0.28 },
              ];

          for (const rb of ribbons) {
            ctx.fillStyle = hexToRgba(rb.color, rb.alpha);
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(padX, midY);
            const stepPx = 3;
            for (let lx = 0; lx <= playedLen; lx += stepPx) {
              const t = lx / playedLen;
              const env = Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * (st.hovered ? 1.15 : 0.95);
              const dy =
                Math.sin(lx * rb.freq + phase * rb.speed) *
                (cssH * rb.amp) *
                env *
                smoothAmp;
              ctx.lineTo(padX + lx, midY + dy);
            }
            for (let lx = playedLen; lx >= 0; lx -= stepPx) {
              const t = lx / playedLen;
              const env = Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * (st.hovered ? 1.15 : 0.95);
              const dy =
                Math.cos(lx * rb.freq * 0.9 - phase * rb.speed * 0.8) *
                (cssH * rb.amp * 0.72) *
                env *
                smoothAmp;
              ctx.lineTo(padX + lx, midY - dy * 0.65);
            }
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fill();
          }
        }

        if (st.glowIntensity > 0.05 && !st.isLightSurface) {
          const halo = ctx.createRadialGradient(headX, midY, 1, headX, midY, st.hovered ? 11 : 8);
          halo.addColorStop(0, hexToRgba('#ffffff', 0.9));
          halo.addColorStop(0.45, hexToRgba(st.primaryHex, 0.55 * st.glowIntensity));
          halo.addColorStop(1, hexToRgba(st.primaryHex, 0));
          ctx.fillStyle = halo;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(headX, midY, st.hovered ? 11 : 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }

        ctx.fillStyle = st.isLightSurface ? st.primaryHex : '#ffffff';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(headX, midY, st.hovered ? 4.6 : 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      } else {
        const barCount = Math.max(18, Math.min(38, Math.floor(usableW / 6.5)));
        const step = usableW / barCount;
        const barW = Math.max(2.2, step * 0.56);

        for (let i = 0; i < barCount; i++) {
          const bx = padX + i * step + (step - barW) / 2;
          const barCenterRatio = (i + 0.5) / barCount;
          const isPlayed = barCenterRatio <= st.ratio + 0.005;

          const wave =
            0.3 +
            0.38 * Math.abs(Math.sin(phase * 1.9 + i * 0.52)) +
            0.32 * Math.abs(Math.cos(phase * 1.2 - i * 0.31));
          const maxBarH = cssH * (st.hovered ? 0.84 : 0.72);
          const h = Math.max(
            3.5,
            maxBarH *
              (isPlayed
                ? 0.25 + 0.75 * wave * smoothAmp
                : 0.22 + 0.32 * Math.abs(Math.sin(i * 0.7)))
          );

          if (isPlayed) {
            const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, midY - h / 2, 0, midY + h / 2);
            g.addColorStop(0, st.primaryHex);
            g.addColorStop(1, st.secondaryHex);
            ctx.fillStyle = g;
          } else {
            ctx.fillStyle = railColor;
          }

          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.roundRect(bx, midY - h / 2, barW, h, 99);
          ctx.fill();
        }

        ctx.fillStyle = st.isLightSurface ? '#1c1917' : '#ffffff';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(headX - 1.5, midY - cssH * 0.42, 3, cssH * 0.84, 99);
        ctx.fill();
      }

      if (st.animate || Math.abs(smoothAmp - targetAmp) > 0.015) {
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(renderFrame);
      } else {
        rafId = 0;
      }
    };

    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(renderFrame);
    return () => {
      if (rafId !== 0) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
    };
  }, [
    isCanvasMode,
    styleVariant,
    clampedRatio,
    primaryHex,
    secondaryHex,
    animateWave,
    isHovered,
    isDragging,
    glowIntensity,
    lowPowerEco,
    isLightSurface,
  ]);

  const computeValueFromPointer = (clientX: number, clientY: number): number => {
    if (!containerRef.current) return value;
    const rect = containerRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (isVertical) {
      if (rect.height <= 0) return value;
      const r = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (rect.bottom - clientY) / rect.height));
      return min + r * safeSpan;
    }
    if (rect.width <= 0) return value;
    const r = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (clientX - rect.left) / rect.width));
    return min + r * safeSpan;
  };

  const handlePointerDown = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    setIsDragging(true);
    const next = computeValueFromPointer(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    onChange(Math.round(next));
  };

  const handlePointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!containerRef.current) return;
    const rect = containerRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!isVertical && rect.width > 0) {
      setHoverRatio(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width)));
    }
    if (isDragging) {
      const next = computeValueFromPointer(e.clientX, e.clientY);
      onChange(Math.round(next));
    }
  };

  const handlePointerUp = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (isDragging) {
      e.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
      setIsDragging(false);
    }
  };

  const pctStr = `${(clampedRatio * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
  const activeHover = isHovered || isDragging;

  // Vertical Pillar Slider Rendering (for Vertical Control Center Block Layout)
  if (isVertical) {

        aria-valuenow={Math.round(value)}
        onMouseEnter={() => setIsHovered(true)}
        onMouseLeave={() => setIsHovered(false)}
        onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
        onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
        onPointerUp={handlePointerUp}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          const step = Math.max(1, Math.round(safeSpan * 0.05));
          if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
            e.preventDefault();
            onChange(Math.min(max, Math.round(value + step)));
          } else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
            e.preventDefault();
            onChange(Math.max(min, Math.round(value - step)));
          }
        }}
        className={`relative w-11 h-full min-h-[118px] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden select-none cursor-pointer border transition-transform ${
          activeHover ? 'scale-[1.02]' : ''
        } ${
          isLightSurface
            ? 'bg-stone-900/10 border-stone-900/15'
            : 'bg-white/[0.08] border-white/12'
        }`}
      >
        <div
          style={{
            height: pctStr,
            background: `linear-gradient(0deg, ${hexToRgba(secondaryHex, 0.85)} 0%, ${primaryHex} 100%)`,
          }}
          className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 transition-[height] duration-75"
        />
        <div
          style={{ bottom: pctStr }}
          className="absolute inset-x-2 translate-y-0.5 h-1 rounded-full bg-white/90 shadow pointer-events-none"
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const unplayedBg = isLightSurface ? 'bg-stone-900/15' : 'bg-white/20';

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      role="slider"
      tabIndex={0}
      aria-label={ariaLabel}
      aria-valuemin={min}
      aria-valuemax={max}
      aria-valuenow={Math.round(value)}
      onMouseEnter={() => setIsHovered(true)}
      onMouseLeave={() => {
        setIsHovered(false);
        setHoverRatio(null);
      }}
      onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
      onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
      onPointerUp={handlePointerUp}
      onKeyDown={(e) => {
        const step = Math.max(1, Math.round(safeSpan * 0.04));
        if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
          e.preventDefault();
          onChange(Math.min(max, Math.round(value + step)));
        } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
          e.preventDefault();
          onChange(Math.max(min, Math.round(value - step)));
        }
      }}
      className="relative flex-1 flex items-center select-none cursor-pointer focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-400 rounded-lg min-h-[24px]"
    >
      {activeHover && hoverRatio !== null && formatTooltip && (
        <div
          style={{ left: `${(hoverRatio * 100).toFixed(1)}%` }}

        >
          {formatTooltip(Math.round(min + hoverRatio * safeSpan))}

      {isCanvasMode ? (

        <div className="relative w-full h-5 flex items-center">

            const segColor = !lit

            const redline = idx >= 15;
            return (

=== FILE: src/components/FluidMusicVisualizer.tsx ===
import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { MusicVisualizerStyle } from '../types/pill';

interface FluidMusicVisualizerProps {
  style: MusicVisualizerStyle;
  isPlaying: boolean;
  accentHex: string;
  secondaryHex?: string;
  compact?: boolean;
  lowPowerEco?: boolean;
  onCycleStyle?: () => void;
}

function hexToRgba(hex: string, alpha: number): string {
  const clean = (hex || '#38bdf8').replace('#', '');
  const full =
    clean.length === 3
      ? clean
          .split('')
          .map((c) => c + c)
          .join('')
      : clean;
  const num = parseInt(full || '38bdf8', 16);
  const r = (num >> 16) & 255;
  const g = (num >> 8) & 255;
  const b = num & 255;
  return `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, ${alpha})`;
}

/**
 * Zero-React-re-render 60fps HTML5 Canvas fluid music illustrator.
 * Automatically parks its rAF loop when paused to maintain 0.0% idle CPU usage.
 */
export const FluidMusicVisualizer: React.FC<FluidMusicVisualizerProps> = ({
  style,
  isPlaying,
  accentHex,
  secondaryHex = '#38bdf8',
  compact = false,
  lowPowerEco = false,
  onCycleStyle,
}) => {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
  const propsRef = useRef({ style, isPlaying, accentHex, secondaryHex, compact, lowPowerEco });
  propsRef.current = { style, isPlaying, accentHex, secondaryHex, compact, lowPowerEco };

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    let rafId = 0;
    let phase = 0;
    let smoothEnergy = isPlaying ? 1 : 0.14;
    let lastTs = performance.now();

    const drawFrame = (now: number) => {
      const dt = Math.min(0.05, Math.max(0.001, (now - lastTs) / 1000));
      lastTs = now;

      const {
        style: mode,
        isPlaying: playing,
        accentHex: c1,
        secondaryHex: c2,
        compact: isCompact,
        lowPowerEco: eco,
      } = propsRef.current;

      const targetEnergy = playing ? 1.0 : 0.12;
      smoothEnergy += (targetEnergy - smoothEnergy) * Math.min(1, dt * 8);
      if (playing) {
        phase += dt * (eco ? 2.1 : 3.4);
      }

      const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
      const cssW = canvas.clientWidth || (isCompact ? 22 : 240);
      const cssH = canvas.clientHeight || (isCompact ? 14 : 46);
      const targetW = Math.round(cssW * dpr);
      const targetH = Math.round(cssH * dpr);

      if (canvas.width !== targetW || canvas.height !== targetH) {
        canvas.width = targetW;
        canvas.height = targetH;
      }

      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, cssW, cssH);

      if (isCompact) {
        // 5-bar silky 60fps Dynamic Island mini-spectrum
        const barCount = 5;
        const barW = 2.5;
        const gap = 2;
        const totalW = barCount * barW + (barCount - 1) * gap;
        const startX = (cssW - totalW) / 2;

        for (let i = 0; i < barCount; i++) {
          const wave1 = Math.sin(phase * 2.1 + i * 1.15);
          const wave2 = Math.cos(phase * 1.35 - i * 0.85);
          const raw = 0.25 + 0.75 * Math.abs(wave1 * 0.65 + wave2 * 0.35);
          const h = Math.max(3, raw * smoothEnergy * (cssH - 1));
          const x = startX + i * (barW + gap);
          const y = (cssH - h) / 2;

          const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, y, 0, y + h);
          grad.addColorStop(0, c1);
          grad.addColorStop(1, c2);
          ctx.fillStyle = grad;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.roundRect(x, y, barW, h, 99);
          ctx.fill();
        }
      } else if (mode === 'liquid_ribbon') {
        // Multi-layered translucent harmonic silk ribbons (Apple Music / Siri fluid aesthetic)
        const layers = [
          { color: c1, alpha: 0.55, freq: 0.026, speed: 1.25, amp: 0.38, offset: 0 },
          { color: c2, alpha: 0.45, freq: 0.034, speed: -0.95, amp: 0.32, offset: 1.7 },
          { color: '#ffffff', alpha: 0.24, freq: 0.045, speed: 1.65, amp: 0.22, offset: 3.1 },
        ];
        const midY = cssH * 0.52;

        for (const layer of layers) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(0, midY);
          for (let x = 0; x <= cssW; x += 4) {
            const norm = x / cssW;
            const envelope = Math.sin(norm * Math.PI); // Taper cleanly at both ends
            const yOffset =
              (Math.sin(x * layer.freq + phase * layer.speed + layer.offset) * 0.68 +
                Math.cos(x * layer.freq * 1.6 - phase * 0.8 + layer.offset) * 0.32) *
              cssH *
              layer.amp *
              envelope *
              smoothEnergy;
            ctx.lineTo(x, midY + yOffset);
          }
          for (let x = cssW; x >= 0; x -= 4) {
            const norm = x / cssW;
            const envelope = Math.sin(norm * Math.PI);
            const yOffset =
              (Math.sin(x * layer.freq + phase * layer.speed + layer.offset + 0.9) * 0.55) *
              cssH *
              layer.amp *
              0.55 *
              envelope *
              smoothEnergy;
            ctx.lineTo(x, midY - yOffset);
          }
          ctx.closePath();
          ctx.fillStyle = hexToRgba(layer.color, layer.alpha);
          ctx.fill();
        }
      } else if (mode === 'harmonic_bars') {
        // 28-bar rounded fluid spectrum with continuous sub-pixel interpolation
        const count = 28;
        const gap = 3;
        const barW = Math.max(2.5, (cssW - (count - 1) * gap - 8) / count);
        const startX = 4;

        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
          const norm = i / (count - 1);
          const bell = 0.35 + 0.65 * Math.sin(norm * Math.PI);
          const harmonic =
            Math.abs(
              Math.sin(phase * 1.85 + i * 0.42) * 0.6 +
                Math.cos(phase * 1.15 - i * 0.28) * 0.4
            ) * bell;
          const barH = Math.max(4, (4 + harmonic * (cssH - 10)) * smoothEnergy + 3 * (1 - smoothEnergy));
          const x = startX + i * (barW + gap);
          const y = (cssH - barH) / 2;

          const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, y, 0, y + barH);
          grad.addColorStop(0, c1);
          grad.addColorStop(1, hexToRgba(c2, 0.78));
          ctx.fillStyle = grad;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.roundRect(x, y, barW, barH, 99);
          ctx.fill();
        }
      } else if (mode === 'orbital_aura') {
        // Breathing concentric plasma rings + bilateral pulse waves
        const cx = cssW / 2;
        const cy = cssH / 2;

        for (let rIdx = 0; rIdx < 3; rIdx++) {
          const pulse = 1 + 0.28 * Math.sin(phase * 1.9 - rIdx * 0.9) * smoothEnergy;
          const rx = (28 + rIdx * 26) * pulse;
          const ry = (9 + rIdx * 4.5) * pulse;

          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, rx, Math.min(cssH * 0.46, ry), 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.strokeStyle = hexToRgba(rIdx % 2 === 0 ? c1 : c2, (0.62 - rIdx * 0.16) * (0.4 + 0.6 * smoothEnergy));
          ctx.lineWidth = 2.2 - rIdx * 0.4;
          ctx.stroke();
        }

        const coreGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 1, cx, cy, 24);
        coreGrad.addColorStop(0, hexToRgba(c1, 0.75 * smoothEnergy + 0.15));
        coreGrad.addColorStop(1, hexToRgba(c2, 0));
        ctx.fillStyle = coreGrad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(cx, cy, 24, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      } else if (mode === 'mirrored_wave') {
        // Studio symmetric spline waveform
        const midY = cssH / 2;
        const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, cssW, 0);
        grad.addColorStop(0, hexToRgba(c2, 0.2));
        grad.addColorStop(0.5, c1);
        grad.addColorStop(1, hexToRgba(c2, 0.2));

        ctx.strokeStyle = grad;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let x = 0; x <= cssW; x += 3) {
          const env = Math.pow(Math.sin((x / cssW) * Math.PI), 1.4);
          const y =
            midY +
            Math.sin(x * 0.08 - phase * 2.6) *
              Math.cos(x * 0.025 + phase * 1.1) *
              (cssH * 0.42) *
              env *
              smoothEnergy;
          if (x === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
          else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
        }
        ctx.stroke();
      } else if (mode === 'particle_field') {
        // Luminous acoustic stardust drifting smoothly
        const count = 26;
        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
          const seed = i * 17.37;
          const x = ((seed * 13 + phase * (18 + (i % 5) * 6)) % (cssW - 12)) + 6;
          const yBase = cssH * 0.5;
          const y =
            yBase +
            Math.sin(phase * 1.4 + seed) * (cssH * 0.34) * smoothEnergy;
          const radius = 1.4 + (i % 3) * 0.85 * (0.5 + 0.5 * smoothEnergy);
          ctx.fillStyle = hexToRgba(i % 2 === 0 ? c1 : c2, 0.45 + 0.4 * Math.sin(phase + i));
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }
      } else {
        // Minimal Pulse: Ultra-light dual stereo filament
        const midY = cssH / 2;
        const spanL = (0.2 + 0.72 * Math.abs(Math.sin(phase * 1.5))) * (cssW * 0.44) * smoothEnergy;
        const spanR = (0.2 + 0.72 * Math.abs(Math.cos(phase * 1.35 + 0.6))) * (cssW * 0.44) * smoothEnergy;

        ctx.fillStyle = hexToRgba('#ffffff', 0.08);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(8, midY - 5, cssW - 16, 3, 99);
        ctx.roundRect(8, midY + 2, cssW - 16, 3, 99);
        ctx.fill();

        const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(cssW / 2 - spanL, 0, cssW / 2 + spanR, 0);
        g.addColorStop(0, c2);
        g.addColorStop(0.5, c1);
        g.addColorStop(1, c2);
        ctx.fillStyle = g;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(cssW / 2 - spanL, midY - 5, spanL * 2, 3, 99);
        ctx.roundRect(cssW / 2 - spanR, midY + 2, spanR * 2, 3, 99);
        ctx.fill();
      }

      // Park rAF loop completely once energy settles when paused -> 0.0% idle CPU
      if (playing || Math.abs(smoothEnergy - targetEnergy) > 0.01) {
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
      } else {
        rafId = 0;
      }
    };

    lastTs = performance.now();
    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
    return () => {
      if (rafId !== 0) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
    };
  }, [isPlaying, style, accentHex, secondaryHex, compact, lowPowerEco]);

  if (compact) {
    return (
      <canvas
        ref={canvasRef}
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="w-[22px] h-[14px] block shrink-0"
      />
    );
  }

  if (onCycleStyle) {
    return (
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={onCycleStyle}
        title="Click to switch fluid music illustrator animation"
        aria-label={`Music visualizer (${(style || 'bars').replace(/_/g, ' ')}) â€” click to switch style`}
        className="w-full my-1.5 px-2 py-1 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.03] hover:bg-white/[0.055] border border-white/[0.05] relative overflow-hidden h-11 flex items-center cursor-pointer transition-colors group focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-sky-400"
      >
        <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="w-full h-full block" />
        <span className="absolute right-2 bottom-1 text-[9px] text-slate-400 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity pointer-events-none capitalize">
          {(style || 'bars').replace(/_/g, ' ')} Â· Next
        </span>
      </button>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="my-1.5 px-2 py-1 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/[0.05] relative overflow-hidden h-11 flex items-center">
      <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="w-full h-full block" />
    </div>
  );
};

export const FullSettingsView: React.FC<FullSettingsViewProps> = ({
  preferences,
  onUpdatePreferences,
  onBackToSimulator,
}) => {
  const [section, setSection] = useState<SettingsSectionId>('themes_icons');
  const [isSidebarCollapsed, setIsSidebarCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const [recordingShortcut, setRecordingShortcut] = useState(false);
  const [recordingAgentShortcut, setRecordingAgentShortcut] = useState(false);
  const [astraCategoryFilter, setAstraCategoryFilter] = useState<AstraCategory>('all');

  const [isFullscreen, setIsFullscreen] = useState(false);
  const [testBounce, setTestBounce] = useState(false);
  const [isRazorSlicing, setIsRazorSlicing] = useState(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'F11') {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleToggleFullscreen();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  }, []);

  const handleMinimize = async () => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && '__TAURI_INTERNALS__' in window) {
      try {
        const { invoke } = await import('@tauri-apps/api/core');
        await invoke('minimize_settings_window');
        return;
      } catch {}
      try {
        const { getCurrentWebviewWindow } = await import('@tauri-apps/api/webviewWindow');
        await getCurrentWebviewWindow().minimize();
      } catch {}
    }
  };

  const handleMaximize = async () => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && '__TAURI_INTERNALS__' in window) {
      try {
        const { invoke } = await import('@tauri-apps/api/core');
        await invoke('toggle_maximize_settings_window');
        return;
      } catch {}
      try {
        const { getCurrentWebviewWindow } = await import('@tauri-apps/api/webviewWindow');
        await getCurrentWebviewWindow().toggleMaximize();
      } catch {}
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFullscreen = async () => {
    setIsFullscreen((prev) => !prev);
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && '__TAURI_INTERNALS__' in window) {
      try {
        const { invoke } = await import('@tauri-apps/api/core');
        await invoke('toggle_fullscreen_settings_window');
        return;
      } catch {}
      try {
        const { getCurrentWebviewWindow } = await import('@tauri-apps/api/webviewWindow');
        const win = getCurrentWebviewWindow();
        const cur = await win.isFullscreen();
        await win.setFullscreen(!cur);
      } catch {}
    }
  };

  const handleClose = async () => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && '__TAURI_INTERNALS__' in window) {
      try {
        const { invoke } = await import('@tauri-apps/api/core');
        await invoke('close_settings_window');
        return;
      } catch {}
      try {
        const { getCurrentWebviewWindow } = await import('@tauri-apps/api/webviewWindow');
        await getCurrentWebviewWindow().hide();
      } catch {}
    }
    onBackToSimulator();
  };

  // Interactive preview values so users can drag and test every slider & tile live inside Settings
  const [previewMusicPct, setPreviewMusicPct] = useState(64);
  const [previewVolumePct, setPreviewVolumePct] = useState(74);
  const [previewWifiOn, setPreviewWifiOn] = useState(true);
  const [previewBtOn, setPreviewBtOn] = useState(true);
  const [newCustomTabName, setNewCustomTabName] = useState('');

  const palette = resolveThemePalette(
    preferences.themeId,
    preferences.customPrimaryHex,
    preferences.customSecondaryHex
  );
  const iconMetrics = resolveIconPackMetrics(preferences.iconPack);
  const pillMetrics = resolveInnerPillMetrics(
    preferences.innerPillScale,
    preferences.innerCapsuleRadius
  );

  const recordKeyCombo = (
    e: React.KeyboardEvent,
    targetField: 'toggleShortcut' | 'voiceAgentShortcut',
    stopRecording: () => void
  ) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();

    if (['Alt', 'Control', 'Shift', 'Meta'].includes(e.key)) return;
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      stopRecording();
      return;
    }

    const parts: string[] = [];
    if (e.ctrlKey) parts.push('Ctrl');
    if (e.altKey) parts.push('Alt');
    if (e.shiftKey) parts.push('Shift');
    if (parts.length === 0) parts.push('Alt');

    const keyLabel =
      e.code === 'Space'
        ? 'Space'
        : e.key.length === 1
          ? e.key.toUpperCase()
          : e.key;
    const combo = `${parts.join('+')}+${keyLabel}`;
    onUpdatePreferences({ [targetField]: combo });
    stopRecording();
    playTactilePop('confirm');
  };

  const toggleTabEnabled = (tab: BuiltinPillTab) => {
    const enabledCount = Object.values(preferences.enabledTabs).filter(Boolean).length;
    const currentlyOn = preferences.enabledTabs[tab];
    if (currentlyOn && enabledCount <= 1) return;
    onUpdatePreferences({
      enabledTabs: { ...preferences.enabledTabs, [tab]: !currentlyOn },
    });
    playTactilePop(!currentlyOn ? 'toggleOn' : 'toggleOff');
  };

  const handleAddCustomWidgetTab = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const label = newCustomTabName.trim() || `Deck ${(preferences.customWidgetTabs?.length ?? 0) + 1}`;
    const newTab: CustomWidgetTab = {
      id: `custom_${Date.now().toString(36)}`,
      name: label,
      enabled: true,
      widgets: ['timers', 'network_mini', 'vitals_mini', 'quick_actions'],
      widgetSizes: {
        timers: 'medium',
        network_mini: 'small',
        vitals_mini: 'small',
        quick_actions: 'medium',
      },
    };
    onUpdatePreferences({
      customWidgetTabs: [...(preferences.customWidgetTabs ?? []), newTab],
    });
    setNewCustomTabName('');
    playTactilePop('confirm');
  };

  const toggleFeatureFlag = (key: keyof PillFeatureFlags) => {
    const next = !preferences.featureFlags[key];
    onUpdatePreferences({
      featureFlags: { ...preferences.featureFlags, [key]: next },
    });
    playTactilePop(next ? 'toggleOn' : 'toggleOff');
  };

  const toggleControlTileIncluded = (id: ControlTileId) => {
    const exists = preferences.controlTiles.includes(id);
    const updated = exists
      ? preferences.controlTiles.filter((t) => t !== id)
      : [...preferences.controlTiles, id];
    if (updated.length > 0) {
      onUpdatePreferences({ controlTiles: updated });
      playTactilePop('tab');
    }
  };

  const toggleHomeWidgetIncluded = (id: HomeWidgetId) => {
    const exists = preferences.homeWidgets.includes(id);
    const updated = exists
      ? preferences.homeWidgets.filter((w) => w !== id)
      : [...preferences.homeWidgets, id];
    if (updated.length > 0) {
      onUpdatePreferences({ homeWidgets: updated });
      playTactilePop('tab');
    }
  };

  const NAV_ITEMS: {
    id: SettingsSectionId;
    label: string;
    Icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string; style?: React.CSSProperties }>;
  }[] = [
    { id: 'themes_icons', label: 'Color Themes, Icons & Pills', Icon: Palette },
    { id: 'sliders_music', label: 'Fused Sliders & Visualizers', Icon: Music },
    { id: 'control_designer', label: 'Control Center & > Menus', Icon: Grid },
    { id: 'island_geometry', label: 'Shape, Location & Edge-Hide', Icon: Sliders },
    { id: 'edge_sounds', label: 'Edge Lighting & Soundscapes', Icon: Volume2 },
    { id: 'tabs_manager', label: 'Tabs & Reordering', Icon: Layers },
    { id: 'ai_astra', label: 'Astra AI Copilot & Voice Orb', Icon: Sparkles },
  ];

  return (
    <div
      onMouseLeave={() => {
        if (preferences.closeSettingsOnMouseLeave ?? true) {
          handleClose();
        }
      }}
      className="w-full h-screen flex flex-col bg-[#090b10] text-slate-100 overflow-hidden select-none"
    >
      {/* 1. Custom Titlebar Header with Window Drag Region and Windows 11 Controls */}
      <header
        data-tauri-drag-region
        className="h-10 shrink-0 w-full bg-[#07090e]/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between px-3 select-none z-50"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 pointer-events-auto">
          {/* Official Pill App Icon */}
          <img
            src={getThemeIconUrl(preferences.themeId)}
            alt="The Pill"
            className="w-5 h-5 object-contain shrink-0 drop-shadow select-none"
          />
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-white tracking-tight flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span>The Pill Settings</span>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-400 bg-white/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">v3.0</span>
          </span>

          {/* Sidebar Collapse/Expand Toggle Button */}
          <button
            type="button"
            title={isSidebarCollapsed ? 'Expand sidebar' : 'Collapse sidebar'}
            onClick={() => {
              playTactilePop('tab');
              setIsSidebarCollapsed((v) => !v);
            }}
            className="p-1 ml-1 hover:bg-white/10 rounded-md text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition-colors"
          >
            <PanelLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Windows 11 Window Controls */}
        <div className="flex items-center h-full pointer-events-auto -mr-3">
          <button
            type="button"
            title="Minimize"
            onClick={handleMinimize}
            className="h-10 w-11 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition-colors"
          >
            <Minus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            title="Maximize / Restore"
            onClick={handleMaximize}
            className="h-10 w-11 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition-colors"
          >
            <Square className="w-3 h-3" />
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            title={isFullscreen ? 'Exit Fullscreen (F11)' : 'Enter Fullscreen (F11)'}
            onClick={handleToggleFullscreen}
            className="h-10 w-11 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition-colors"
          >
            {isFullscreen ? <Minimize2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Maximize2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            title="Close"
            onClick={handleClose}
            className="h-10 w-11 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-red-500 hover:text-white text-slate-400 transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* 2. Main Flex Layout (Collapsible Left Sidebar + Scrollable Right Content) */}
      <div className="flex-1 flex flex-row overflow-hidden relative">
        {/* Left Collapsible Navigation Sidebar */}
        <aside
          aria-label="Settings categories"
          className={`h-full flex flex-col justify-between border-r border-white/10 bg-[#07090e]/75 backdrop-blur-md transition-all duration-200 shrink-0 select-none ${
            isSidebarCollapsed ? 'w-16 p-2' : 'w-60 p-3'
          }`}
        >
          <div className="space-y-1">
            {NAV_ITEMS.map((item) => {
              const Icon = item.Icon;
              const active = section === item.id;
              return (
                <button
                  key={item.id}
                  type="button"
                  title={isSidebarCollapsed ? item.label : undefined}
                  onClick={() => {
                    playTactilePop('tab');
                    setSection(item.id);
                  }}
                  style={
                    active
                      ? {
                          backgroundColor: `${palette.primaryHex}22`,
                          borderColor: `${palette.primaryHex}66`,
                        }
                      : undefined
                  }
                  className={`w-full flex items-center rounded-xl text-xs font-medium border transition-colors ${
                    isSidebarCollapsed
                      ? 'justify-center p-2.5'
                      : 'gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 text-left'
                  } ${
                    active
                      ? 'text-white font-semibold shadow-sm'
                      : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/[0.04] border-transparent'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Icon
                    className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0"
                    style={{ color: active ? palette.primaryHex : undefined }}
                  />
                  {!isSidebarCollapsed && <span className="truncate">{item.label}</span>}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* Sidebar Footer */}
          <div className="space-y-1 pt-3 border-t border-white/10">
            <button
              type="button"
              title={isSidebarCollapsed ? 'Back to Desktop' : undefined}
              onClick={handleClose}
              style={{ color: palette.primaryHex }}
              className={`w-full flex items-center rounded-xl text-xs font-medium hover:bg-white/[0.04] transition-colors ${
                isSidebarCollapsed ? 'justify-center p-2.5' : 'gap-2.5 px-3 py-2 text-left'
              }`}
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
              {!isSidebarCollapsed && <span className="truncate">Back to Desktop</span>}
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              title={isSidebarCollapsed ? 'Reset Defaults' : undefined}
              onClick={() => {
                onUpdatePreferences({ ...DEFAULT_PREFERENCES });
                playTactilePop('confirm');
              }}
              className={`w-full flex items-center rounded-xl text-xs font-medium text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-300 hover:bg-rose-500/10 transition-colors ${
                isSidebarCollapsed ? 'justify-center p-2.5' : 'gap-2.5 px-3 py-2 text-left'
              }`}
            >
              <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
              {!isSidebarCollapsed && <span className="truncate">Reset Defaults</span>}
            </button>
          </div>
        </aside>

        {/* Right Active Configuration Pane with Smooth Independent Scrolling */}
        <main className="flex-1 h-full overflow-y-auto pill-scroll p-6 pb-24 bg-[#090b10] select-text">
          <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6">
            {/* Top Settings Header */}
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-5 border-b border-white/10">
              <div>
                <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">
                  Pill for Windows â€” Deep Customization &amp; Studio Settings
                </h1>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                  Every color theme, Aâ€“Z style kit, icon pack, slider style, &gt; Control Center layout, and Home module updates live with interactive previews below.
                </p>
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  onUpdatePreferences({ ...DEFAULT_PREFERENCES });
                  playTactilePop('confirm');
                }}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-medium bg-white/8 hover:bg-white/14 text-slate-200 rounded-xl transition-colors whitespace-nowrap self-start sm:self-auto shrink-0"
              >
                <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Reset All Defaults</span>

function downsampleTo16kPcmBase64(input: Float32Array, inputSampleRate: number): string {
  let samples = input;
  if (inputSampleRate !== 16000 && inputSampleRate > 16000) {
    const ratio = inputSampleRate / 16000;
    const outLen = Math.max(1, Math.round(input.length / ratio));
    const downsampled = new Float32Array(outLen);
    for (let i = 0; i < outLen; i++) {
      const idx = Math.min(input.length - 1, Math.floor(i * ratio));
      downsampled[i] = input[idx];
    }
    samples = downsampled;
  }

  const pcm16 = new Int16Array(samples.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) {
    const s = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, samples[i]));
    pcm16[i] = s < 0 ? s * 0x8000 : s * 0x7fff;
  }
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(pcm16.buffer);
  let binary = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.byteLength; i++) {
    binary += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i]);
  }
  return btoa(binary);
}

function base64Pcm16ToFloat32(base64: string): Float32Array {
  const binary = atob(base64);
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) {
    bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
  }
  const int16 = new Int16Array(bytes.buffer);
  const float32 = new Float32Array(int16.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < int16.length; i++) {
    float32[i] = int16[i] / 32768;
  }
  return float32;
}

function blobToBase64(blob: Blob): Promise<string> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onloadend = () => {
      const result = typeof reader.result === 'string' ? reader.result : '';
      const commaIdx = result.indexOf(',');
      resolve(commaIdx >= 0 ? result.slice(commaIdx + 1) : result);
    };
    reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to read audio file'));
    reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
  });
}

    if (SpeechCtor) {

        rec.onerror = (ev) => {
          if (ev.error && ev.error !== 'no-speech' && ev.error !== 'aborted') {
            setAssistError(`Mic listener notice: ${ev.error}`);
          }
        };

        rec.onend = () => {
