=== FILE: src/utils/audioSynth.ts ===
import { SoundActionKind, SoundProfileId } from '../types/pill';

let sharedAudioCtx: AudioContext | null = null;
let lastSoundTimestamp = 0;
let lastCollapseTimestamp = 0;

let currentProfile: SoundProfileId = 'wooden_marimba';
let currentVolume = 0.55;

export function configureSoundEngine(profile: SoundProfileId, volume: number): void {
  currentProfile = profile;
  currentVolume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, volume));
}

function getAudioContext(): AudioContext | null {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  const Ctx =
    window.AudioContext ||
    (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext?: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext;
  if (!Ctx) return null;
  if (!sharedAudioCtx) {
    sharedAudioCtx = new Ctx({ latencyHint: 'interactive' });
  }
  if (sharedAudioCtx.state === 'suspended') {
    sharedAudioCtx.resume().catch(() => {});
  }
  return sharedAudioCtx;
}

if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  const warmUp = () => {
    try {
      const ctx = getAudioContext();
      if (ctx) {
        if (ctx.state === 'suspended') {
          ctx.resume().catch(() => {});
        }
        // Play 1-frame silent buffer to fully unpause hardware audio pipeline with zero latency
        const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, 1, 22050);
        const src = ctx.createBufferSource();
        src.buffer = buf;
        src.connect(ctx.destination);
        src.start(0);
        console.log(`[AudioEngine] Hardware clock pre-warmed at ${performance.now().toFixed(2)}ms`);
      }
    } catch {}
    window.removeEventListener('pointerdown', warmUp);
    window.removeEventListener('keydown', warmUp);
    window.removeEventListener('pointerenter', warmUp);
    window.removeEventListener('mousemove', warmUp);
  };
  window.addEventListener('pointerdown', warmUp, { passive: true, capture: true });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', warmUp, { passive: true, capture: true });
  window.addEventListener('pointerenter', warmUp, { passive: true, capture: true });
  window.addEventListener('mousemove', warmUp, { passive: true, capture: true });
  // Also try immediate pre-warm on load
  setTimeout(warmUp, 100);
}

/**
 * Studio acoustic feedback synthesizer with warm low-pass filtering,
 * distinct action articulations, 9 themed sound profiles (including Cyber Synth,
 * Retro Cassette, Motorsport GT Paddle, and Zen Garden), and anti-fatigue rate limiting.
 */
export function playTactilePop(
  kind: SoundActionKind = 'expand',
  overrideProfile?: SoundProfileId
): void {
  const profile = overrideProfile ?? currentProfile;
  if (profile === 'silent' || currentVolume <= 0.01) return;

  const nowPerf = typeof performance !== 'undefined' ? performance.now() : Date.now();
  // Enforce crisp single collapse sound (reject duplicate collapse triggers within 500ms unless overrideProfile provided)
  if (!overrideProfile && kind === 'collapse' && nowPerf - lastCollapseTimestamp < 500) return;
  if (kind === 'collapse') lastCollapseTimestamp = nowPerf;
  if (!overrideProfile && nowPerf - lastSoundTimestamp < 15) return;
  lastSoundTimestamp = nowPerf;

  try {
    const ctx = getAudioContext();
    if (!ctx) return;

    if (ctx.state === 'suspended') {
      ctx.resume().catch(() => {});
    }

    const t0 = ctx.currentTime + 0.0005;
    console.log(`[AudioEngine] ðŸ”Š ${kind} | profile: ${profile} | perf: ${nowPerf.toFixed(2)}ms | audioTime: ${t0.toFixed(4)}s`);
    const masterGain = ctx.createGain();
    const filter = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    filter.type = 'lowpass';

    const baseAmp = 0.022 * currentVolume;

    if (profile === 'wooden_marimba') {
      filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(920, t0);
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      osc.type = 'triangle';

      const freqMap: Record<SoundActionKind, [number, number, number]> = {
        expand: [293.66, 369.99, 0.055],
        collapse: [329.63, 246.94, 0.05],
        tab: [392.0, 440.0, 0.032],
        toggleOn: [349.23, 440.0, 0.042],
        toggleOff: [349.23, 293.66, 0.04],
        drop: [261.63, 523.25, 0.075],
        notification: [440.0, 554.37, 0.09],
        confirm: [392.0, 587.33, 0.07],
      };

      const [fStart, fEnd, dur] = freqMap[kind];
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(fStart, t0);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(fEnd, t0 + dur);

      masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0005, t0);
      masterGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(baseAmp, t0 + 0.006);
      masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0004, t0 + dur + 0.015);

      osc.connect(filter);
      filter.connect(masterGain);
      masterGain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.start(t0);
      osc.stop(t0 + dur + 0.02);
    } else if (profile === 'velvet_droplet') {
      filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(680, t0);
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      osc.type = 'sine';

      const [fStart, fEnd, dur]: [number, number, number] =
        kind === 'collapse' || kind === 'toggleOff'
          ? [280, 175, 0.055]
          : kind === 'tab'
            ? [310, 360, 0.03]
            : kind === 'drop' || kind === 'confirm'
              ? [230, 460, 0.08]
              : [210, 340, 0.06];

      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(fStart, t0);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(fEnd, t0 + dur);

      masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0005, t0);
      masterGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(baseAmp * 1.1, t0 + 0.008);
      masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0004, t0 + dur + 0.02);

      osc.connect(filter);
      filter.connect(masterGain);
      masterGain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.start(t0);
      osc.stop(t0 + dur + 0.025);
    } else if (profile === 'brushed_glass') {
      filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(1450, t0);
      const osc1 = ctx.createOscillator();
      const osc2 = ctx.createOscillator();
      osc1.type = 'sine';
      osc2.type = 'sine';

      const root =
        kind === 'collapse' || kind === 'toggleOff'
          ? 440
          : kind === 'tab'
            ? 523.25
            : kind === 'confirm' || kind === 'notification'
              ? 587.33
              : 493.88;

      const dur = kind === 'tab' ? 0.038 : 0.075;
      osc1.frequency.setValueAtTime(root, t0);
      osc2.frequency.setValueAtTime(root * 1.498, t0);

      masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0004, t0);
      masterGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(baseAmp * 0.68, t0 + 0.008);
      masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0003, t0 + dur + 0.025);

      osc1.connect(filter);
      osc2.connect(filter);
      filter.connect(masterGain);
      masterGain.connect(ctx.destination);

      osc1.start(t0);
      osc2.start(t0);
      osc1.stop(t0 + dur + 0.03);
      osc2.stop(t0 + dur + 0.03);
    } else if (profile === 'cyber_synth') {
      // Crisp filtered synth chirp for Cyberpunk HUD
      filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(1850, t0);
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      osc.type = 'sawtooth';
      const [f0, f1, dur]: [number, number, number] =
        kind === 'collapse' || kind === 'toggleOff'
          ? [520, 240, 0.048]
          : kind === 'tab'
            ? [660, 880, 0.028]
            : kind === 'confirm'
              ? [440, 880, 0.065]
              : [360, 720, 0.055];
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(f0, t0);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(f1, t0 + dur);

      masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0004, t0);
      masterGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(baseAmp * 0.6, t0 + 0.004);
      masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0003, t0 + dur + 0.015);

      osc.connect(filter);
      filter.connect(masterGain);
      masterGain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.start(t0);
      osc.stop(t0 + dur + 0.02);
    } else if (profile === 'retro_cassette') {
      // Warm analog cassette deck latch & phosphor pip
      filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(760, t0);
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      osc.type = 'square';
      const startHz = kind === 'collapse' || kind === 'toggleOff' ? 196 : 246.94;
      const endHz = kind === 'tab' ? 329.63 : 164.81;
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(startHz, t0);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(endHz, t0 + 0.034);

      masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(baseAmp * 0.55, t0);
      masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0003, t0 + 0.038);

      osc.connect(filter);
      filter.connect(masterGain);
      masterGain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.start(t0);
      osc.stop(t0 + 0.042);
    } else if (profile === 'mechanical_gt') {
      // Carbon paddle-shift micro detent click
      filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(1200, t0);
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      osc.type = 'triangle';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(kind === 'toggleOff' ? 150 : 210, t0);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(68, t0 + 0.022);

      masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(baseAmp * 1.25, t0);
      masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0004, t0 + 0.026);

      osc.connect(filter);
      filter.connect(masterGain);
      masterGain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.start(t0);
      osc.stop(t0 + 0.03);
    } else if (profile === 'zen_garden') {
      // Soft bamboo & ceramic wind-bell harmonic for Paper & Sakura kits
      filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(1600, t0);
      const osc1 = ctx.createOscillator();
      const osc2 = ctx.createOscillator();
      osc1.type = 'sine';
      osc2.type = 'triangle';
      const baseHz = kind === 'collapse' || kind === 'toggleOff' ? 392 : 523.25;
      osc1.frequency.setValueAtTime(baseHz, t0);
      osc2.frequency.setValueAtTime(baseHz * 2.0, t0);

      masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0004, t0);
      masterGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(baseAmp * 0.65, t0 + 0.01);
      masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0003, t0 + 0.095);

      osc1.connect(filter);
      osc2.connect(filter);
      filter.connect(masterGain);
      masterGain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc1.start(t0);
      osc2.start(t0);
      osc1.stop(t0 + 0.1);
      osc2.stop(t0 + 0.1);
    } else if (profile === 'naruto_shinobi') {
      // Authentic Naruto Shinobi Jutsu acoustic synthesis: Rasengan chakra whistle, Chidori snap, Sharingan ocular chime
      if (kind === 'expand') {
        // Rasengan Chakra Vortex spin
        filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(2400, t0);
        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
        osc.type = 'sawtooth';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(260, t0);
        osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(840, t0 + 0.08);

        masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, t0);
        masterGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(baseAmp * 0.95, t0 + 0.02);
        masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0003, t0 + 0.085);

        osc.connect(filter);
        filter.connect(masterGain);
        masterGain.connect(ctx.destination);
        osc.start(t0);
        osc.stop(t0 + 0.09);
      } else if (kind === 'collapse') {
        // Chidori lightning chirp snap
        filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(3200, t0);
        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
        osc.type = 'square';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(740, t0);
        osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(180, t0 + 0.04);

        masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(baseAmp * 0.85, t0);
        masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0003, t0 + 0.045);

        osc.connect(filter);
        filter.connect(masterGain);
        masterGain.connect(ctx.destination);
        osc.start(t0);
        osc.stop(t0 + 0.05);
      } else {
        // Sharingan ocular chime & hand-seal puff
        filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(2800, t0);
        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
        osc.type = 'sine';
        const chimeHz = kind === 'toggleOn' ? 880 : kind === 'tab' ? 587.33 : 440;
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(chimeHz, t0);
        osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(chimeHz * 1.5, t0 + 0.06);

        masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(baseAmp * 0.9, t0);
        masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0002, t0 + 0.075);

        osc.connect(filter);
        filter.connect(masterGain);
        masterGain.connect(ctx.destination);
        osc.start(t0);
        osc.stop(t0 + 0.08);
      }
    } else if (profile === 'taptic_thump') {
      filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(220, t0);
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      osc.type = 'sine';
      const startHz = kind === 'collapse' || kind === 'toggleOff' ? 92 : 118;
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(startHz, t0);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(48, t0 + 0.028);

      masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(baseAmp * 1.4, t0);
      masterGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0004, t0 + 0.032);

      osc.connect(filter);
      filter.connect(masterGain);
      masterGain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.start(t0);
      osc.stop(t0 + 0.036);
    }
  } catch {
    // Gracefully ignore in restricted headless audio contexts
  }
}

export function formatDurationClock(totalSeconds: number): string {
  const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.floor(totalSeconds));
  const minutes = Math.floor(clamped / 60);
  const seconds = clamped % 60;
  return `${minutes}:${seconds.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

export function formatStopwatchClock(elapsedMs: number): string {
  const totalCs = Math.max(0, Math.floor(elapsedMs / 10));
  const cs = totalCs % 100;
  const totalSec = Math.floor(totalCs / 100);
  const sec = totalSec % 60;
  const min = Math.floor(totalSec / 60);
  return `${min.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${sec.toString().padStart(2, '0')}.${cs
    .toString()
    .padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

=== FILE: src/utils/customizationLogic.ts ===
import type { BuiltinPillTab, PillPreferences, PillTab } from '../types/pill';

export type ClipboardCategory =
  | 'text'
  | 'code'
  | 'image'
  | 'video'
  | 'audio'
  | 'document'
  | 'archive'
  | 'color'
  | 'link'
  | 'binary';

export interface ClassifiedClipMeta {
  category: ClipboardCategory;
  badgeCode: string;
  accentHex?: string;
}

const IMAGE_EXTS = new Set(['png', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'gif', 'webp', 'svg', 'bmp', 'ico', 'avif', 'heic', 'psd', 'fig']);
const VIDEO_EXTS = new Set(['mp4', 'mkv', 'webm', 'mov', 'avi', 'm4v']);
const AUDIO_EXTS = new Set(['mp3', 'wav', 'flac', 'ogg', 'm4a', 'aac', 'opus']);
const ARCHIVE_EXTS = new Set(['zip', 'rar', '7z', 'tar', 'gz', 'bz2', 'xz', 'iso', 'dmg', 'msix']);
const DOC_EXTS = new Set(['pdf', 'doc', 'docx', 'xls', 'xlsx', 'ppt', 'pptx', 'csv', 'md', 'txt', 'rtf', 'epub']);
const CODE_EXTS = new Set([
  'cs', 'csproj', 'hlsl', 'ts', 'tsx', 'js', 'jsx', 'py', 'rs', 'go', 'cpp', 'c', 'h',
  'java', 'kt', 'swift', 'json', 'yaml', 'yml', 'toml', 'xml', 'html', 'css', 'sql', 'ps1', 'sh',
]);

const HEX_COLOR_RE = /^#([0-9a-fA-F]{3}|[0-9a-fA-F]{6}|[0-9a-fA-F]{8})$/;
const RGB_COLOR_RE = /^rgba?\(\s*\d+\s*,\s*\d+\s*,\s*\d+/i;
const URL_RE = /^https?:\/\/[^\s]+$/i;

/**
 * Classifies any copied text, code snippet, color, URL, or A-to-Z file extension
 * so Universal Clipboard can display accurate previews and filter categories.
 */
export function classifyClipboardPayload(
  rawTextOrFilename: string,
  mimeType?: string
): ClassifiedClipMeta {
  const trimmed = rawTextOrFilename.trim();

  if (mimeType) {
    if (mimeType.startsWith('image/')) return { category: 'image', badgeCode: 'IMG' };
    if (mimeType.startsWith('video/')) return { category: 'video', badgeCode: 'VID' };
    if (mimeType.startsWith('audio/')) return { category: 'audio', badgeCode: 'AUD' };
    if (mimeType === 'application/pdf') return { category: 'document', badgeCode: 'PDF' };
    if (mimeType.includes('zip') || mimeType.includes('compressed')) {
      return { category: 'archive', badgeCode: 'ZIP' };
    }
  }

  // Check hex / rgb color
  if (HEX_COLOR_RE.test(trimmed)) {
    return { category: 'color', badgeCode: 'HEX', accentHex: trimmed };
  }
  if (RGB_COLOR_RE.test(trimmed)) {
    return { category: 'color', badgeCode: 'RGB', accentHex: trimmed };
  }

  // Check URL
  if (URL_RE.test(trimmed)) {
    return { category: 'link', badgeCode: 'URL' };
  }

  // Check file extension (A to Z support)
  const dotIdx = trimmed.lastIndexOf('.');
  if (dotIdx > 0 && dotIdx < trimmed.length - 1 && !trimmed.includes(' ') && !trimmed.includes('\n')) {
    const ext = trimmed.slice(dotIdx + 1).toLowerCase();
    const upper = ext.toUpperCase().slice(0, 4);
    if (IMAGE_EXTS.has(ext)) return { category: 'image', badgeCode: upper };
    if (VIDEO_EXTS.has(ext)) return { category: 'video', badgeCode: upper };
    if (AUDIO_EXTS.has(ext)) return { category: 'audio', badgeCode: upper };
    if (ARCHIVE_EXTS.has(ext)) return { category: 'archive', badgeCode: upper };
    if (DOC_EXTS.has(ext)) return { category: 'document', badgeCode: upper };
    if (CODE_EXTS.has(ext)) return { category: 'code', badgeCode: upper };
    if (/^[a-z0-9]{1,6}$/.test(ext)) {
      return { category: 'binary', badgeCode: upper };
    }
  }

  // Heuristic for code snippets
  if (
    trimmed.includes('function ') ||
    trimmed.includes('const ') ||
    trimmed.includes('public ') ||
    trimmed.includes('import ') ||
    trimmed.startsWith('{') ||
    trimmed.includes('dotnet ') ||
    trimmed.includes('=>')
  ) {
    return { category: 'code', badgeCode: 'CODE' };
  }

  return { category: 'text', badgeCode: 'TXT' };
}

/**
 * Reorders an ordered array of tab/tile IDs cleanly without mutating the input array.
 */
export function moveOrderedItem<T>(items: readonly T[], index: number, direction: -1 | 1): T[] {
  const targetIndex = index + direction;
  if (index < 0 || index >= items.length || targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= items.length) {
    return [...items];
  }
  const copy = [...items];
  const [picked] = copy.splice(index, 1);
  copy.splice(targetIndex, 0, picked);
  return copy;
}

export interface BatteryEtaEstimate {
  minutesToFull: number | null;
  minutesRemainingOnBattery: number | null;
  formattedEta: string;
}

/**
 * Computes realistic battery time-to-full ETA (when charging at wattageW)
 * or remaining runtime (when discharging at loadW) for a given Wh battery pack.
 */
export function computeBatteryEta(
  batteryPct: number,
  isCharging: boolean,
  wattageW: number,
  capacityWh = 68
): BatteryEtaEstimate {
  const clampedPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, batteryPct));

  if (isCharging) {
    if (clampedPct >= 100) {
      return {
        minutesToFull: 0,
        minutesRemainingOnBattery: null,
        formattedEta: 'Fully charged',
      };
    }
    const remainingWh = ((100 - clampedPct) / 100) * capacityWh;
    // Account for CC/CV taper above 80% state of charge
    const taperFactor = clampedPct > 80 ? 0.62 : 0.88;
    const effectiveWatts = Math.max(5, wattageW * taperFactor);
    const mins = Math.max(1, Math.round((remainingWh / effectiveWatts) * 60));
    const h = Math.floor(mins / 60);
    const m = mins % 60;
    return {
      minutesToFull: mins,
      minutesRemainingOnBattery: null,
      formattedEta: h > 0 ? `${h}h ${m}m to full` : `${m} min to 100%`,
    };
  }

  const availableWh = (clampedPct / 100) * capacityWh;
  const drainW = Math.max(4, wattageW);
  const minsLeft = Math.max(1, Math.round((availableWh / drainW) * 60));
  const h = Math.floor(minsLeft / 60);
  const m = minsLeft % 60;
  return {
    minutesToFull: null,
    minutesRemainingOnBattery: minsLeft,
    formattedEta: h > 0 ? `${h}h ${m}m remaining` : `${m}m remaining`,
  };
}

/**
 * Matches a KeyboardEvent descriptor against a stored shortcut like "Alt+L" or "Alt+Space".
 */
export function matchesShortcutCombo(
  event: { altKey: boolean; ctrlKey: boolean; shiftKey: boolean; metaKey: boolean; code: string; key: string },
  combo: string
): boolean {
  const parts = combo.split('+').map((p) => p.trim().toLowerCase());
  const wantAlt = parts.includes('alt');
  const wantCtrl = parts.includes('ctrl') || parts.includes('control');
  const wantShift = parts.includes('shift');
  const mainKey = parts.find(
    (p) => p !== 'alt' && p !== 'ctrl' && p !== 'control' && p !== 'shift'
  );
  if (!mainKey) return false;
  if (event.altKey !== wantAlt || event.ctrlKey !== wantCtrl || event.shiftKey !== wantShift) {
    return false;
  }

  if (mainKey === 'space') {
    return event.code === 'Space' || event.key === ' ';
  }
  return (
    event.key.toLowerCase() === mainKey ||
    event.code.toLowerCase() === `key${mainKey}`
  );
}

/**
 * Checks whether a specific tab is enabled in current preferences.
 */
export function isTabEnabledInPrefs(tab: PillTab, prefs: PillPreferences): boolean {
  if (!prefs || !tab || typeof tab !== 'string') return false;
  if (tab.startsWith('custom_')) {
    return Boolean(prefs.customWidgetTabs?.some((ct) => ct.id === tab && ct.enabled));
  }
  const builtin = tab as BuiltinPillTab;
  if (builtin === 'ai' && !prefs.aiEnabled) return false;
  return Boolean(prefs.enabledTabs?.[builtin]);
}

=== FILE: src/utils/springPhysics.ts ===
export interface SpringConfig {
  stiffness: number;
  damping: number;
  mass: number;
}

export interface SpringState1D {
  position: number;
  velocity: number;
}

export enum SpringPresetId {
  LiquidSilk = 'liquid_silk',
  Fluid = 'fluid',
  Snappy = 'snappy',
  ElasticDrop = 'elastic_drop',
  Calm = 'calm',
  ZeroGravity = 'zero_gravity',
}

export const SPRING_PRESETS: Record<SpringPresetId, SpringConfig> = {
  [SpringPresetId.LiquidSilk]: {
    stiffness: 440,
    damping: 30,
    mass: 0.82,
  },
  [SpringPresetId.Fluid]: {
    stiffness: 480,
    damping: 28,
    mass: 0.80,
  },
  [SpringPresetId.Snappy]: {
    stiffness: 580,
    damping: 36,
    mass: 0.72,
  },
  [SpringPresetId.ElasticDrop]: {
    stiffness: 420,
    damping: 22,
    mass: 0.78,
  },
  [SpringPresetId.Calm]: {
    stiffness: 340,
    damping: 36,
    mass: 0.95,
  },
  [SpringPresetId.ZeroGravity]: {
    stiffness: 240,
    damping: 24,
    mass: 0.90,
  },
};

const MAX_DT = 0.064;
const SUBSTEP_DT = 0.004;
const REST_VELOCITY_EPSILON = 0.08;
const REST_DISPLACEMENT_EPSILON = 0.05;

/**
 * Advances a 1D damped harmonic oscillator (m*x'' + c*x' + k*(x - target) = 0)
 * using sub-stepped symplectic Euler integration for unconditional frame-rate stability.
 */
export function stepSpring1D(
  state: SpringState1D,
  target: number,
  config: SpringConfig,
  dtSeconds: number
): SpringState1D {
  const safeDt = Math.min(Math.max(dtSeconds, 0), MAX_DT);
  if (safeDt === 0) {
    return { position: state.position, velocity: state.velocity };
  }

  const mass = Math.max(config.mass, 0.05);
  const stiffness = Math.max(config.stiffness, 1);
  const damping = Math.max(config.damping, 0.1);

  let pos = state.position;
  let vel = state.velocity;

  let remaining = safeDt;
  while (remaining > 0) {
    const h = Math.min(remaining, SUBSTEP_DT);
    const displacement = pos - target;
    const springForce = -stiffness * displacement;
    const dampingForce = -damping * vel;
    const acceleration = (springForce + dampingForce) / mass;

    vel += acceleration * h;
    pos += vel * h;
    remaining -= h;
  }

  if (
    Math.abs(vel) < REST_VELOCITY_EPSILON &&
    Math.abs(pos - target) < REST_DISPLACEMENT_EPSILON
  ) {
    return { position: target, velocity: 0 };
  }

  return { position: pos, velocity: vel };
}

export function isSpringAtRest(state: SpringState1D, target: number): boolean {
  return (
    Math.abs(state.velocity) <= REST_VELOCITY_EPSILON &&
    Math.abs(state.position - target) <= REST_DISPLACEMENT_EPSILON
  );
}

export interface LiquidDeformation {
  scaleX: number;
  scaleY: number;
}

/**
 * Computes incompressible fluid squash-and-stretch deformation (scaleX * scaleY â‰ˆ 1)
 * driven by instantaneous horizontal and vertical expansion velocities.
 */
export function computeLiquidDeformation(
  velocityWidth: number,
  velocityHeight: number,
  maxStretch = 0.065
): LiquidDeformation {
  const normalizedW = Math.tanh(velocityWidth / 1800) * maxStretch;
  const normalizedH = Math.tanh(velocityHeight / 1400) * maxStretch;

  const netHorizontalStrain = normalizedW - normalizedH * 0.45;
  const clampedStrain = Math.max(-maxStretch, Math.min(maxStretch, netHorizontalStrain));

  const scaleX = 1 + clampedStrain;
  const scaleY = 1 / scaleX;

  return {
    scaleX: Number(scaleX.toFixed(5)),
    scaleY: Number(scaleY.toFixed(5)),
  };
}

export interface MetaballBridgeMetrics {
  detachmentRatio: number;
  neckThicknessPx: number;
}

export function computeMetaballBridge(
  edgeGapPx: number,
  pinchOffGapPx = 14
): MetaballBridgeMetrics {
  if (edgeGapPx <= 0) {
    return { detachmentRatio: 0, neckThicknessPx: 22 };
  }
  if (edgeGapPx >= pinchOffGapPx) {
    return { detachmentRatio: 1, neckThicknessPx: 0 };
  }
  const ratio = edgeGapPx / pinchOffGapPx;
  const smooth = ratio * ratio * (3 - 2 * ratio);
  const neckThicknessPx = Math.max(0, (1 - smooth) * 20);
  return {
    detachmentRatio: Number(smooth.toFixed(4)),
    neckThicknessPx: Number(neckThicknessPx.toFixed(2)),
  };
}

export enum PillSizeScale {
  Small = 'small',
  Medium = 'medium',
  Large = 'large',
}

export enum PillShapeStyle {
  DynamicPill = 'dynamic_pill',
  TopBezelPill = 'top_bezel_pill',
  SuperellipseSquircle = 'squircle',
  MinimalistBar = 'minimal_bar',
  SplitDualCapsule = 'split_capsule',
}

export enum PillAnchorPosition {
  TopCenter = 'top_center',
  TopLeft = 'top_left',
  TopRight = 'top_right',
  BottomTaskbar = 'bottom_taskbar',
}

export interface PillGeometryInput {
  isExpanded: boolean;
  isLauncherOpen: boolean;
  activeTab: string;
  transientKind: 'none' | 'call' | 'agent' | 'volume' | 'brightness' | 'battery' | 'download';
  hasPrimaryActivity: boolean;
  hasSecondaryDroplet: boolean;
  isHovered: boolean;
  isDragOver: boolean;
  sizeScale: PillSizeScale;
  isElongated: boolean;
  isFloatingPill?: boolean;
  shapeStyle?: PillShapeStyle;
  anchorPosition?: PillAnchorPosition;
  floatingOffsetPx?: number;
  isStealthHidden?: boolean;
  isAstraActive?: boolean;
  astraMode?: 'orb_only' | 'orb_with_captions' | 'orb_with_chat';
  astraExpandedResult?: boolean;
}

export interface PillGeometryOutput {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  borderRadius: number;
  topOffset: number;
  satelliteGap: number;
  satelliteSize: number;
  isDockedFlushTop: boolean;
}

const SCALE_MULTIPLIER: Record<PillSizeScale, number> = {
  [PillSizeScale.Small]: 0.92,
  [PillSizeScale.Medium]: 1.0,
  [PillSizeScale.Large]: 1.09,
};

/**
 * Pure deterministic layout solver for all Dynamic Island / Pill shapes, anchor positions,
 * stealth edge-hide mode, In-Pill Astra morphing, transient HUDs, and expanded workspaces.
 */
export function resolvePillGeometry(input: PillGeometryInput): PillGeometryOutput {
  const mult = SCALE_MULTIPLIER[input.sizeScale] ?? 1.0;

  // Backward compatibility with boolean isFloatingPill if shapeStyle omitted
  const effectiveShape =
    input.shapeStyle ??
    (input.isFloatingPill === false
      ? PillShapeStyle.TopBezelPill
      : PillShapeStyle.DynamicPill);

  const anchor = input.anchorPosition ?? PillAnchorPosition.TopCenter;
  const isDockedFlushTop =
    (effectiveShape === PillShapeStyle.TopBezelPill || (effectiveShape as string) === 'top_bezel_ledge') &&
    anchor !== PillAnchorPosition.BottomTaskbar;

  const defaultOffset = isDockedFlushTop ? 0 : (input.floatingOffsetPx ?? 12);

  // 0. Stealth Auto-Hide until edge touch or keyboard shortcut (Astra summon overrides stealth!)
  if (
    input.isStealthHidden &&
    !input.isExpanded &&
    !input.isAstraActive &&
    input.transientKind === 'none'
  ) {
    const h = 6;
    return {
      width: Math.round(140 * mult),
      height: h,
      borderRadius: Math.round(h / 2),
      topOffset: anchor === PillAnchorPosition.BottomTaskbar ? 52 : -48,
      satelliteGap: 0,
      satelliteSize: 0,
      isDockedFlushTop: false,
    };
  }

  const computeCornerRadius = (h: number, expanded: boolean): number => {
    if (effectiveShape === PillShapeStyle.SuperellipseSquircle) {
      return expanded ? 24 : 14;
    }
    if (effectiveShape === PillShapeStyle.MinimalistBar) {
      return expanded ? 12 : 7;
    }
    if (effectiveShape === PillShapeStyle.TopBezelPill || (effectiveShape as string) === 'top_bezel_ledge') {
      return expanded ? 28 : Math.round(h / 2);
    }
    return expanded ? 34 : Math.round(h / 2);
  };

  // 0.5 In-Pill Astra (à°…à°¸à±à°¤à±à°°à°‚) Morph â€” Uses the existing Pill directly instead of a separate box!
  if (input.isAstraActive && !input.isExpanded) {
    if (input.astraMode === 'orb_only') {
      const baseW = input.astraExpandedResult ? 420 : 70;
      const baseH = input.astraExpandedResult ? 138 : 70;
      const h = Math.round(baseH * mult);
      return {
        width: Math.round(baseW * mult),
        height: h,
        borderRadius: input.astraExpandedResult ? computeCornerRadius(h, true) : Math.round(h / 2),
        topOffset: defaultOffset,
        satelliteGap: 0,
        satelliteSize: 0,
        isDockedFlushTop,
      };
    }

    if (input.astraMode === 'orb_with_captions') {
      const baseW = input.astraExpandedResult ? 460 : 420;
      const baseH = input.astraExpandedResult ? 144 : 58;
      const h = Math.round(baseH * mult);
      return {
        width: Math.round(baseW * mult),
        height: h,
        borderRadius: computeCornerRadius(h, true),
        topOffset: defaultOffset,
        satelliteGap: 0,
        satelliteSize: 0,
        isDockedFlushTop,
      };
    }

    const baseW = 504;
    const baseH = input.astraExpandedResult ? 308 : 228;
    const h = Math.round(baseH * mult);
    return {
      width: Math.round(baseW * mult),
      height: h,
      borderRadius: computeCornerRadius(h, true),
      topOffset: defaultOffset,
      satelliteGap: 0,
      satelliteSize: 0,
      isDockedFlushTop,
    };
  }

  // 1. Dragging files near or over the Island swells it into a magnetic drop pocket
  if (input.isDragOver && !input.isExpanded) {
    const h = Math.round(88 * mult);
    return {
      width: Math.round(368 * mult),
      height: h,
      borderRadius: computeCornerRadius(h, true),
      topOffset: defaultOffset,
      satelliteGap: 0,
      satelliteSize: 0,
      isDockedFlushTop,
    };
  }

  // 2. Full Expanded Interactive Island
  if (input.isExpanded) {
    const baseWidth = input.isElongated ? 748 : 684;
    let baseHeight = 368;
    if (input.isLauncherOpen) {
      baseHeight = 358;
    } else if (input.activeTab === 'home' || input.activeTab.startsWith('custom_')) {
      baseHeight = 368;
    } else if (input.activeTab === 'control') {
      baseHeight = 388;
    } else if (input.activeTab === 'ai') {
      baseHeight = 422;
    } else if (input.activeTab === 'monitor') {
      baseHeight = 414;
    } else if (input.activeTab === 'clipboard') {
      baseHeight = 426;
    } else if (input.activeTab === 'tray') {
      baseHeight = 338;
    } else if (input.activeTab === 'mirror') {
      baseHeight = 312;
    } else if (input.activeTab === 'notes') {
      baseHeight = 348;
    }

    const h = Math.round(baseHeight * mult);
    return {
      width: Math.round(baseWidth * mult),
      height: h,
      borderRadius: computeCornerRadius(h, true),
      topOffset: defaultOffset,
      satelliteGap: 0,
      satelliteSize: 0,
      isDockedFlushTop,
    };
  }

  // 3. High-priority Transient System Interrupts
  if (input.transientKind === 'call') {
    const h = Math.round(68 * mult);
    return {
      width: Math.round(416 * mult),
      height: h,
      borderRadius: computeCornerRadius(h, false),
      topOffset: defaultOffset,
      satelliteGap: 0,
      satelliteSize: 0,
      isDockedFlushTop,
    };
  }

  if (input.transientKind === 'agent') {
    const h = Math.round(74 * mult);
    return {
      width: Math.round(452 * mult),
      height: h,
      borderRadius: computeCornerRadius(h, false),
      topOffset: defaultOffset,
      satelliteGap: 0,
      satelliteSize: 0,
      isDockedFlushTop,
    };
  }

  if (input.transientKind === 'battery') {
    const h = Math.round(48 * mult);
    return {
      width: Math.round(356 * mult),
      height: h,
      borderRadius: computeCornerRadius(h, false),
      topOffset: defaultOffset,
      satelliteGap: 0,
      satelliteSize: 0,
      isDockedFlushTop,
    };
  }

  if (
    input.transientKind === 'volume' ||
    input.transientKind === 'brightness' ||
    input.transientKind === 'download'
  ) {
    const h = Math.round(44 * mult);
    return {
      width: Math.round(308 * mult),
      height: h,
      borderRadius: computeCornerRadius(h, false),
      topOffset: defaultOffset,
      satelliteGap: 0,
      satelliteSize: 0,
      isDockedFlushTop,
    };
  }

  // 4. Compact Live Activity State (with optional liquid-split secondary droplet)
  const forceSplit = effectiveShape === PillShapeStyle.SplitDualCapsule;
  if (input.hasPrimaryActivity) {
    const isMinimal = effectiveShape === PillShapeStyle.MinimalistBar;
    const baseW = isMinimal ? 272 : 258;
    const baseH = isMinimal ? 28 : 37;
    const h = Math.round(baseH * mult);
    const showSat = input.hasSecondaryDroplet || forceSplit;
    return {
      width: Math.round(baseW * mult),
      height: h,
      borderRadius: computeCornerRadius(h, false),
      topOffset: defaultOffset,
      satelliteGap: showSat ? 10 : 0,
      satelliteSize: showSat ? h : 0,
      isDockedFlushTop,
    };
  }

  // 5. Quiet Idle Capsule
  const isMinimalIdle = effectiveShape === PillShapeStyle.MinimalistBar;
  const idleW = isMinimalIdle ? 164 : 176;
  const idleH = isMinimalIdle ? 24 : 33;
  const h = Math.round(idleH * mult);
  return {
    width: Math.round(idleW * mult),
    height: h,
    borderRadius: computeCornerRadius(h, false),
    topOffset: defaultOffset,
    satelliteGap: forceSplit ? 10 : 0,
    satelliteSize: forceSplit ? h : 0,
    isDockedFlushTop,
  };
}

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {
  COMPLETE_STYLE_KITS,
  getReadableForegroundClass,
  paginateControlTiles,
  resolveIconPackMetrics,
  resolveInnerPillMetrics,
  resolveThemePalette,
  resolveTileSurfaceClasses,
} from './themeAndSliders';

test('resolveThemePalette returns Windows 11 Cyan, Paper Editorial light surface, and sanitizes custom hex palettes', () => {
  const win11 = resolveThemePalette('win11_cyan');
  assert.equal(win11.primaryHex, '#22d3ee');
  assert.equal(win11.onPrimaryTextClass, 'text-slate-950');

  const paper = resolveThemePalette('paper_editorial');
  assert.equal(paper.isLightSurface, true);
  assert.equal(paper.onPrimaryTextClass, 'text-white');

  const custom = resolveThemePalette('custom_hex', '#0f8', 'invalid-hex');
  assert.equal(custom.primaryHex, '#00ff88');
  assert.equal(custom.secondaryHex, '#a855f7');
  assert.equal(custom.onPrimaryTextClass, 'text-slate-950');
});

test('COMPLETE_STYLE_KITS covers Cyberpunk, Retro, Paper, Animals, Botanical Flowers, and Motorsport Cars', () => {
  const ids = COMPLETE_STYLE_KITS.map((k) => k.id);
  assert.ok(ids.includes('cyberpunk_neon'));
  assert.ok(ids.includes('retro_synth_crt'));
  assert.ok(ids.includes('paper_editorial'));
  assert.ok(ids.includes('cozy_animals'));
  assert.ok(ids.includes('botanical_sakura'));
  assert.ok(ids.includes('motorsport_gt'));

  const cyberTile = resolveTileSurfaceClasses('chamfer_cyber', false, false);
  assert.ok(cyberTile.includes('clip-path'));
  const lightPaperTile = resolveTileSurfaceClasses('paper_sketch', false, true);
  assert.ok(lightPaperTile.includes('text-stone-900'));
});

test('getReadableForegroundClass selects high-contrast ink for bright vs deep accents', () => {
  assert.equal(getReadableForegroundClass('#22d3ee'), 'text-slate-950');
  assert.equal(getReadableForegroundClass('#1e1b4b'), 'text-white');
});

test('resolveIconPackMetrics and resolveInnerPillMetrics map distinct stroke and radius tokens', () => {
  const solid = resolveIconPackMetrics('apple_solid');
  const minimal = resolveIconPackMetrics('minimal_mono');
  assert.ok(solid.strokeWidth > minimal.strokeWidth);
  assert.equal(solid.solidActiveBadge, true);

  const pillPlush = resolveInnerPillMetrics('plush', 'pill_capsule');
  assert.equal(pillPlush.radiusClass, 'rounded-full');
  assert.equal(pillPlush.tileHeightClass, 'h-12');
});

test('paginateControlTiles splits tiles into Windows 11 3x2 pages accurately', () => {
  const tiles = ['wifi', 'bt', 'airplane', 'acc', 'saver', 'captions', 'nightlight', 'cast', 'project'];
  const pages = paginateControlTiles(tiles, 3, 2);
  assert.equal(pages.length, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(pages[0], ['wifi', 'bt', 'airplane', 'acc', 'saver', 'captions']);
  assert.deepEqual(pages[1], ['nightlight', 'cast', 'project']);
});

function sanitizeHexColor(input: string, fallback: string): string {
  const trimmed = (input || '').trim();
  if (/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(trimmed)) return trimmed;
  if (/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{3}$/.test(trimmed)) {
    const r = trimmed[1];
    const g = trimmed[2];
    const b = trimmed[3];
    return `#${r}${r}${g}${g}${b}${b}`;
  }
  return fallback;
}

/**
 * Computes relative luminance of a #RRGGBB color to choose dark vs light foreground text.
 */
export function getReadableForegroundClass(hexColor: string): 'text-slate-950' | 'text-white' {
  const clean = sanitizeHexColor(hexColor, '#22d3ee').slice(1);
  const r = parseInt(clean.slice(0, 2), 16) / 255;
  const g = parseInt(clean.slice(2, 4), 16) / 255;
  const b = parseInt(clean.slice(4, 6), 16) / 255;
  const luminance = 0.2126 * r + 0.7152 * g + 0.0722 * b;
  return luminance > 0.48 ? 'text-slate-950' : 'text-white';
}

export function resolveThemePalette(
  themeId: PillThemeId,
  customPrimaryHex = '#22d3ee',
  customSecondaryHex = '#a855f7'
): ThemePalette {
  if (themeId === 'custom_hex') {
    const primary = sanitizeHexColor(customPrimaryHex, '#22d3ee');
    const secondary = sanitizeHexColor(customSecondaryHex, '#a855f7');
    return {
      id: 'custom_hex',
      name: 'Custom Studio Palette',
      subtitle: 'User-defined primary and harmonic secondary accent colors',
      primaryHex: primary,
      secondaryHex: secondary,
      onPrimaryTextClass: getReadableForegroundClass(primary),
      surfaceTintHex: '#0a0f18',
      motifName: 'Custom Studio',
    };
  }
  return PILL_THEMES[themeId] ?? PILL_THEMES.win11_cyan;
}

export function resolveTileSurfaceClasses(
  tileSurfaceStyle: TileSurfaceStyle,
  isActive: boolean,
  isLightSurface = false
): string {
  if (isLightSurface) {
    return isActive
      ? 'shadow-sm ring-1 ring-stone-900/15'
      : 'bg-stone-900/[0.06] hover:bg-stone-900/[0.11] border-stone-900/15 text-stone-900';
  }

  switch (tileSurfaceStyle) {
    case 'chamfer_cyber':
      return isActive
        ? '[clip-path:polygon(0_0,calc(100%-8px)_0,100%_8px,100%_100%,8px_100%,0_calc(100%-8px))]'
        : 'bg-[#161229]/90 hover:bg-[#1f1938] border-cyan-400/25 text-slate-100 [clip-path:polygon(0_0,calc(100%-8px)_0,100%_8px,100%_100%,8px_100%,0_calc(100%-8px))]';
    case 'retro_bevel':
      return isActive
        ? 'shadow-[inset_0_2px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.35),inset_0_-2px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.35)]'
        : 'bg-[#281f18] hover:bg-[#33271e] border-amber-500/25 text-amber-50 shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.12),0_2px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.65)]';
    case 'paper_sketch':
      return isActive
        ? 'shadow-[2px_2px_0_rgba(28,25,23,0.45)]'
        : 'bg-white/[0.06] hover:bg-white/[0.11] border-white/20 text-slate-100';
    case 'carbon_gt':
      return isActive
        ? 'ring-1 ring-red-400/50'
        : 'bg-[radial-gradient(#2a2e39_1px,transparent_1px)] [background-size:6px_6px] bg-[#181b22] hover:bg-[#20242d] border-white/12 text-slate-100';
    case 'pebble_organic':
      return isActive
        ? 'shadow-sm'
        : 'bg-white/[0.06] hover:bg-white/[0.11] border-white/12 text-slate-100';
    case 'fluent_glass':
    default:
      return isActive
        ? ''
        : 'bg-[#2b2f3a]/85 hover:bg-[#343946] border-white/[0.08] text-slate-100';
  }
}

export interface InnerPillMetrics {
  tileHeightClass: string;
  tilePaddingClass: string;
  radiusClass: string;
  iconBoxClass: string;
  labelSizeClass: string;
}

export function resolveInnerPillMetrics(
  scale: InnerPillScale,
  radius: InnerCapsuleRadius
): InnerPillMetrics {
  const radiusClass =
    radius === 'pill_capsule'
      ? 'rounded-full'
      : radius === 'squircle_soft'
        ? 'rounded-2xl'
        : 'rounded-xl';

  if (scale === 'compact') {
    return {
      tileHeightClass: 'h-9',
      tilePaddingClass: 'px-2 py-1',
      radiusClass,
      iconBoxClass: 'w-6 h-6',
      labelSizeClass: 'text-[11px]',
    };
  }
  if (scale === 'plush') {
    return {
      tileHeightClass: 'h-12',
      tilePaddingClass: 'px-3.5 py-2.5',
      radiusClass,
      iconBoxClass: 'w-8 h-8',
      labelSizeClass: 'text-xs',
    };
  }
  return {
    tileHeightClass: 'h-11',
    tilePaddingClass: 'px-2.5 py-1.5',
    radiusClass,
    iconBoxClass: 'w-7 h-7',
    labelSizeClass: 'text-xs',
  };
}

/**
 * Splits Control Center tiles into pages based on columns and rows per page.
 */
export function paginateControlTiles<T>(
  tiles: readonly T[],
  columns: 3 | 4 | 5 | 6,
  rowsPerPage = 2
): T[][] {
  const pageSize = Math.max(1, columns * rowsPerPage);
  if (tiles.length === 0) return [[]];
  const pages: T[][] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < tiles.length; i += pageSize) {
    pages.push(tiles.slice(i, i + pageSize));
  }
  return pages;
}

/**
 * Deterministic CSS box-shadow generator for Dynamic Island perimeter edge lighting.
 */
export function resolveEdgeGlowCss(
  profile: EdgeLightProfile,
  intensity: number,
  trackAccent = '#38bdf8',
  trackSecondary = '#f59e0b'
): string | undefined {
  if (profile === 'off' || intensity <= 0.02) return undefined;
  const a1 = Math.min(0.85, intensity * 0.65).toFixed(2);
  const a2 = Math.min(0.65, intensity * 0.42).toFixed(2);
  const spread1 = Math.round(14 + intensity * 14);
  const spread2 = Math.round(28 + intensity * 24);

  switch (profile) {
    case 'album_adaptive':
      return `0 0 ${spread1}px ${trackAccent}${Math.round(Number(a1) * 255)
        .toString(16)
        .padStart(2, '0')}, 0 0 ${spread2}px ${trackSecondary}${Math.round(Number(a2) * 255)
        .toString(16)
        .padStart(2, '0')}`;
    case 'apple_aura':
      return `0 -2px ${spread1}px rgba(56,189,248,${a1}), -6px 4px ${spread2}px rgba(217,70,239,${a2}), 6px 4px ${spread2}px rgba(251,191,36,${a2})`;
    case 'northern_aurora':
      return `0 0 ${spread1}px rgba(52,211,153,${a1}), 0 4px ${spread2}px rgba(34,211,238,${a2})`;
    case 'solar_amber':
      return `0 0 ${spread1}px rgba(251,191,36,${a1}), 0 4px ${spread2}px rgba(244,63,94,${a2})`;
    case 'glacial_ice':
      return `0 0 ${spread1}px rgba(186,230,253,${a1}), 0 4px ${spread2}px rgba(59,130,246,${a2})`;
    case 'crimson_pulse':
      return `0 0 ${spread1}px rgba(251,113,133,${a1}), 0 4px ${spread2}px rgba(220,38,38,${a2})`;
    default:
      return undefined;
  }
}

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { computeCrc32, createZipArchive } from './zipBuilder';

test('computeCrc32 matches standard IEEE 802.3 check value for 123456789', () => {
  const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode('123456789');
  const crc = computeCrc32(bytes);
  assert.equal(crc, 0xcbf43926);
});

test('createZipArchive writes valid PKZIP local headers, central directory, and EOCD signature', () => {
  const archive = createZipArchive([
    { path: 'Pill.WinUI/Program.cs', content: 'using System;\nConsole.WriteLine("OK");' },
    { path: 'Pill.WinUI/Shaders/Liquid.hlsl', content: 'float4 main() : SV_TARGET { return 1; }' },
  ]);

  const view = new DataView(archive.buffer);
  // First 4 bytes must be Local File Header signature 0x04034b50
  assert.equal(view.getUint32(0, true), 0x04034b50);

  // Last 22 bytes must start with End of Central Directory signature 0x06054b50
  const eocdOffset = archive.byteLength - 22;
  assert.equal(view.getUint32(eocdOffset, true), 0x06054b50);
  // Total entry count in EOCD must be 2
  assert.equal(view.getUint16(eocdOffset + 10, true), 2);
});

=== FILE: src/utils/zipBuilder.ts ===
export interface ZipFileEntry {
  path: string;
  content: string | Uint8Array;
}

const CRC32_TABLE = (() => {
  const table = new Uint32Array(256);
  for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
    let c = i;
    for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
      c = c & 1 ? 0xedb88320 ^ (c >>> 1) : c >>> 1;
    }
    table[i] = c >>> 0;
  }
  return table;
})();

export function computeCrc32(bytes: Uint8Array): number {
  let crc = 0xffffffff;
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
    const index = (crc ^ bytes[i]) & 0xff;
    crc = (crc >>> 8) ^ CRC32_TABLE[index];
  }
  return (crc ^ 0xffffffff) >>> 0;
}

function writeUint16LE(view: DataView, offset: number, value: number): void {
  view.setUint16(offset, value & 0xffff, true);
}

function writeUint32LE(view: DataView, offset: number, value: number): void {
  view.setUint32(offset, value >>> 0, true);
}

/**
 * Generates a standards-compliant PKZIP (Store / Method 0) binary archive in memory.
 * Used both by the Pill File Tray ("Export as ZIP") and the Native WinUI 3 Project exporter.
 */
export function createZipArchive(entries: ZipFileEntry[]): Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer> {
  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  const prepared = entries.map((entry) => {
    const cleanPath = entry.path.replace(/^\/+/, '');
    const nameBytes = encoder.encode(cleanPath);
    const dataBytes =
      typeof entry.content === 'string' ? encoder.encode(entry.content) : entry.content;
    const crc = computeCrc32(dataBytes);
    return { nameBytes, dataBytes, crc };
  });

  let localSectionBytes = 0;
  let centralDirectoryBytes = 0;

  for (const item of prepared) {
    localSectionBytes += 30 + item.nameBytes.length + item.dataBytes.length;
    centralDirectoryBytes += 46 + item.nameBytes.length;
  }

  const totalBytes = localSectionBytes + centralDirectoryBytes + 22;
  const output = new Uint8Array(totalBytes);
  const view = new DataView(output.buffer);

  const dosTime = (12 << 11) | (0 << 5) | 0;
  const dosDate = ((2026 - 1980) << 9) | (11 << 5) | 11;

  let localOffset = 0;
  const offsets: number[] = [];

  for (const item of prepared) {
    offsets.push(localOffset);
    // Local file header signature (0x04034b50)
    writeUint32LE(view, localOffset, 0x04034b50);
    writeUint16LE(view, localOffset + 4, 20); // Version needed: 2.0
    writeUint16LE(view, localOffset + 6, 0x0800); // UTF-8 filename flag
    writeUint16LE(view, localOffset + 8, 0); // Store method (uncompressed)
    writeUint16LE(view, localOffset + 10, dosTime);
    writeUint16LE(view, localOffset + 12, dosDate);
    writeUint32LE(view, localOffset + 14, item.crc);
    writeUint32LE(view, localOffset + 18, item.dataBytes.length);
    writeUint32LE(view, localOffset + 22, item.dataBytes.length);
    writeUint16LE(view, localOffset + 26, item.nameBytes.length);
    writeUint16LE(view, localOffset + 28, 0);

    output.set(item.nameBytes, localOffset + 30);
    output.set(item.dataBytes, localOffset + 30 + item.nameBytes.length);
    localOffset += 30 + item.nameBytes.length + item.dataBytes.length;
  }

  const centralStart = localOffset;
  let centralCursor = centralStart;

  for (let i = 0; i < prepared.length; i++) {
    const item = prepared[i];
    // Central directory file header signature (0x02014b50)
    writeUint32LE(view, centralCursor, 0x02014b50);
    writeUint16LE(view, centralCursor + 4, 20);
    writeUint16LE(view, centralCursor + 6, 20);
    writeUint16LE(view, centralCursor + 8, 0x0800);
    writeUint16LE(view, centralCursor + 10, 0);
    writeUint16LE(view, centralCursor + 12, dosTime);
    writeUint16LE(view, centralCursor + 14, dosDate);
    writeUint32LE(view, centralCursor + 16, item.crc);
    writeUint32LE(view, centralCursor + 20, item.dataBytes.length);
    writeUint32LE(view, centralCursor + 24, item.dataBytes.length);
    writeUint16LE(view, centralCursor + 28, item.nameBytes.length);
    writeUint16LE(view, centralCursor + 30, 0);
    writeUint16LE(view, centralCursor + 32, 0);
    writeUint16LE(view, centralCursor + 34, 0);
    writeUint16LE(view, centralCursor + 36, 0);
    writeUint32LE(view, centralCursor + 38, 0);
    writeUint32LE(view, centralCursor + 42, offsets[i]);

    output.set(item.nameBytes, centralCursor + 46);
    centralCursor += 46 + item.nameBytes.length;
  }

  // End of central directory record (0x06054b50)
  writeUint32LE(view, centralCursor, 0x06054b50);
  writeUint16LE(view, centralCursor + 4, 0);
  writeUint16LE(view, centralCursor + 6, 0);
  writeUint16LE(view, centralCursor + 8, prepared.length);
  writeUint16LE(view, centralCursor + 10, prepared.length);
  writeUint32LE(view, centralCursor + 12, centralDirectoryBytes);
  writeUint32LE(view, centralCursor + 16, centralStart);
  writeUint16LE(view, centralCursor + 20, 0);

  return output;
}
